1301.g: ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਰਿਦ ਭਇਅੰਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
1301.t: gun rama(n)t dhookh naaseh ridh bhia(n)t saa(n)t ||3||
1301.e: Uttering His Glorious Praises, suffering is eradicated, and the heart becomes tranquil and calm. ||3||

1301.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
1301.t: a(n)mritaa ras peeau rasanaa naanak har ra(n)g raat ||4||4||15||
1301.e: Drink in the Sweet, Sublime Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak, and be imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||4||15||

1301.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1301.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1301.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1301.g: ਸਾਜਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਆਉ ਮੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1301.t: saajanaa sa(n)t aau merai ||1|| rahaau ||
1301.e: O friends, O Saints, come to me. ||1||Pause||

1301.g: ਆਨਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਸਮਲਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਰੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
1301.t: aanadhaa gun gai ma(n)gal kasamalaa miT jaeh parerai ||1||
1301.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with pleasure and joy, the sins will be erased and thrown away. ||1||

1301.g: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਧਰਉ ਮਾਥੈ ਚਾਂਦਨਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ॥੨॥
1301.t: sa(n)t charan dharau maathai chaa(n)dhanaa gireh hoi a(n)dherai ||2||
1301.e: Touch your forehead to the feet of the Saints, and your dark household shall be illumined. ||2||

1301.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
1301.t: sa(n)t prasaadh kamal bigasai gobi(n)dh bhajau pekh nerai ||3||
1301.e: By the Grace of the Saints, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. Vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, and see Him near at hand. ||3||

1301.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਏ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਹ ਬੇਰੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
1301.t: prabh kirapaa te sa(n)t paae vaar vaar naanak uh berai ||4||5||16||
1301.e: By the Grace of God, I have found the Saints. Over and over again, Nanak is a sacrifice to that moment. ||4||5||16||

1301.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1301.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1301.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1301.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
1301.t: charan saran gopaal teree ||
1301.e: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet, O Lord of the World.

1301.g: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਧੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਾਟਿ ਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1301.t: moh maan dhoh bharam raakh leejai kaaT beree ||1|| rahaau ||
1301.e: Save me from emotional attachment, pride, deception and doubt; please cut away these ropes which bind me. ||1||Pause||

1301.g: ਬੂਡਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
1301.t: booddat sa(n)saar saagar ||
1301.e: I am drowning in the world-ocean.

1301.g: ਉਧਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰ ॥੧॥
1301.t: audhare har simar ratanaagar ||1||
1301.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the Source of Jewels, I am saved. ||1||

1301.g: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
1301.t: seetalaa har naam teraa ||
1301.e: Your Name, Lord, is cooling and soothing.

1301.g: ਪੂਰਨੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
1301.t: poorano Thaakur prabh meraa ||2||
1301.e: God, my Lord and Master, is Perfect. ||2||

1301.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ॥
1301.t: dheen dharadh nivaar taaran ||
1301.e: You are the Deliverer, the Destroyer of the sufferings of the meek and the poor.

1301.g: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ॥੩॥
1301.t: har kirapaa nidh patit udhaaran ||3||
1301.e: The Lord is the Treasure of Mercy, the Saving Grace of sinners. ||3||

1301.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਦੂਖ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
1301.t: koT janam dhookh kar paio ||
1301.e: I have suffered the pains of millions of incarnations.

1301.g: ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
1301.t: sukhee naanak gur naam dhiraRaio ||4||6||17||
1301.e: Nanak is at peace; the Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. ||4||6||17||

1301.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1301.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1301.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1301.g: ਧਨਿ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
1301.t: dhan uh preet charan sa(n)g laagee ||
1301.e: Blessed is that love, which is attuned to the Lord's Feet.

1301.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1301.t: koT jaap taap sukh paae aai mile pooran baddabhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
1301.e: The peace which comes from millions of chants and deep meditations is obtained by perfect good fortune and destiny. ||1||Pause||

1301.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
1301.t: moh anaath dhaas jan teraa avar oT sagalee moh tiaagee ||
1301.e: I am Your helpless servant and slave; I have given up all other support.

1301.g: ਭੋਰ ਭਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
1301.t: bhor bharam kaaTe prabh simarat giaan a(n)jan mil sovat jaagee ||1||
1301.e: Every trace of doubt has been eradicated, remembering God in meditation. I have applied the ointment of spiritual wisdom, and awakened from my sleep. ||1||

1301.g: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਡੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਤਨਾਗੀ ॥
1301.t: too athaahu at baddo suaamee kirapaa si(n)dh pooran ratanaagee ||
1301.e: You are Unfathomably Great and Utterly Vast, O my Lord and Master, Ocean of Mercy, Source of Jewels.

1301.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਆਨਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੮॥
1301.t: naanak jaachak har har naam maa(n)gai masatak aan dhario prabh paagee ||2||7||18||
1301.e: Nanak, the beggar, begs for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; he rests his forehead upon God's Feet. ||2||7||18||

1301.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1301.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1301.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1301.g: ਕੁਚਿਲ ਕਠੋਰ ਕਪਟ ਕਾਮੀ ॥
1301.t: kuchil kaThor kapaT kaamee ||
1301.e: I am filthy, hard-hearted, deceitful and obsessed with sexual desire.

1301.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1301.t: jiau jaaneh tiau taar suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
1301.e: Please carry me across, as You wish, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

1301.g: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
1301.t: too samarath saran jog too raakheh apanee kal dhaar ||1||
1301.e: You are All-powerful and Potent to grant Sanctuary. Exerting Your Power, You protect us. ||1||

1301.g: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਨ ਬਿਧੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਰ ॥
1301.t: jaap taap nem such sa(n)jam naahee in bidhe chhuTakaar ||
1301.e: Chanting and deep meditation, penance and austere self-discipline, fasting and purification - salvation does not come by any of these means.

1301.g: ਗਰਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੯॥
1301.t: garat ghor a(n)dh te kaaddahu prabh naanak nadhar nihaar ||2||8||19||
1301.e: Please lift me up and out of this deep, dark ditch; O God, please bless Nanak with Your Glance of Grace. ||2||8||19||

1301.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
1301.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
1301.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

1301.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1301.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1301.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1301.g: ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
1301.t: naarain narapat namasakaarai ||
1301.e: The one who bows in humble reverence to the Primal Lord, the Lord of all beings

1301.g: ਐਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1301.t: aaise gur kau bal bal jaieeaai aap mukat moh taarai ||1|| rahaau ||
1301.e: - I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to such a Guru; He Himself is liberated, and He carries me across as well. ||1||Pause||

1301.g: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਰੈ ॥
1301.t: kavan kavan kavan gun kaheeaai a(n)t nahee kachh paarai ||
1301.e: Which, which, which of Your Glorious Virtues should I chant? There is no end or limitation to them.

1301.g: ਲਾਖ ਲਾਖ ਲਾਖ ਕਈ ਕੋਰੈ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਐਸੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
1301.t: laakh laakh laakh kiee korai ko hai aaiso beechaarai ||1||
1301.e: There are thousands, tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, many millions of them, but those who contemplate them are very rare. ||1||

1302.g: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੀ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਲ ਰੰਗਾਰੈ ॥
1302.t: bisam bisam bisam hee bhiee hai laal gulaal ra(n)gaarai ||
1302.e: I am wonder-struck, wonder-struck, wonder-struck and amazed, dyed in the deep crimson color of my Beloved.

1302.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਸੁ ਆਈ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਖਿ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮੁਸਕਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
1302.t: kahu naanak sa(n)tan ras aaiee hai jiau chaakh goo(n)gaa musakaarai ||2||1||20||
1302.e: Says Nanak, the Saints savor this sublime essence, like the mute, who tastes the sweet candy, but only smiles. ||2||1||20||

1302.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1302.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1302.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1302.g: ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ॥
1302.t: n jaanee sa(n)tan prabh bin aan ||
1302.e: The Saints do not know any other except God.

1302.g: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1302.t: uooch neech sabh pekh samaano mukh bakano man maan ||1|| rahaau ||
1302.e: They look upon all equally, the high and the low; they speak of Him with their mouths, and honor Him in their minds. ||1||Pause||

1302.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
1302.t: ghaT ghaT poor rahe sukh saagar bhai bha(n)jan mere praan ||
1302.e: He is pervading and permeating each and every heart; He is the Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of fear. He is my praanaa - the Breath of Life.

1302.g: ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਨਾਸਿਓ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਨ ॥੧॥
1302.t: maneh pragaas bhio bhram naasio ma(n)tr dheeo gur kaan ||1||
1302.e: My mind was enlightened, and my doubt was dispelled, when the Guru whispered His Mantra into my ears. ||1||

1302.g: ਕਰਤ ਰਹੇ ਕ੍ਰਤਗੵ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਗੵਿਾਨ ॥
1302.t: karat rahe karatagaye karunaa mai a(n)tarajaamee giyeaan ||
1302.e: He is All-powerful, the Ocean of Mercy, the All-knowing Searcher of Hearts.

1302.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਾਂਗਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
1302.t: aaTh pahar naanak jas gaavai maa(n)gan kau har dhaan ||2||2||21||
1302.e: Twenty-four hours a day Nanak sings His Praises, and begs for the Gift of the Lord. ||2||2||21||

1302.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1302.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1302.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1302.g: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਕਈ ਕੇਤੈ ॥
1302.t: kahan kahaavan kau kiee ketai ||
1302.e: Many speak and talk about God.

1302.g: ਐਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਤਤ ਜੋਗ ਕਉ ਬੇਤੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1302.t: aaiso jan biralo hai sevak jo tat jog kau betai ||1|| rahaau ||
1302.e: But one who understands the essence of Yoga - such a humble servant is very rare||1||Pause||

1302.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੀ ਨੇਤੈ ॥
1302.t: dhukh naahee sabh sukh hee hai re ekai ekee netai ||
1302.e: He has no pain - he is totally at peace. With his eyes, he sees only the One Lord.

1302.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਭਲਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਹਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਸਭ ਜੇਤੈ ॥੧॥
1302.t: buraa nahee sabh bhalaa hee hai re haar nahee sabh jetai ||1||
1302.e: No one seems evil to him - all are good. There is no defeat - he is totally victorious. ||1||

1302.g: ਸੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਖੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਤੈ ॥
1302.t: sog naahee sadhaa harakhee hai re chhodd naahee kichh letai ||
1302.e: He is never in sorrow - he is always happy; but he gives this up, and does not take anything.

1302.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਰਮਤੈ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
1302.t: kahu naanak jan har har har hai kat aavai kat ramatai ||2||3||22||
1302.e: Says Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is himself the Lord, Har, Har; he does not come and go in reincarnation. ||2||3||22||

1302.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1302.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1302.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1302.g: ਹੀਏ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1302.t: he'ee ko preetam bisar na jai ||
1302.e: I pray that my heart may never forget my Beloved.

1302.g: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਗਲਤ ਭਏ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗੇ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਮੋਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1302.t: tan man galat bhe teh sa(n)ge mohanee moh rahee moree mai ||1|| rahaau ||
1302.e: My body and mind are blended with Him, but the Enticer, Maya, is enticing me, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

1302.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਉ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਹਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਤੇਊ ਤੇਊ ਗਹੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਟਕਾਇ ॥
1302.t: jai jai peh kahau birathaa hau apunee teuoo teuoo gahe rahe aTakai ||
1302.e: Those unto whom I tell my pain and frustration - they themselves are caught and stuck.

1302.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕੀ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗੰਠਿ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
1302.t: anik bhaa(n)t kee ekai jaalee taa kee ga(n)Th nahee chhorai ||1||
1302.e: In all sorts of ways, Maya has cast the net; the knots cannot be loosened. ||1||

1302.g: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਆਇਓ ਸੰਤਨ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
1302.t: firat firat naanak dhaas aaio sa(n)tan hee saranai ||
1302.e: Wandering and roaming, slave Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Saints.

1302.g: ਕਾਟੇ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੀਓ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੩॥
1302.t: kaaTe agiaan bharam moh maiaa leeo ka(n)Th lagai ||2||4||23||
1302.e: The bonds of ignorance, doubt, emotional attachment and the love of Maya have been cut; God hugs me close in His Embrace. ||2||4||23||

1302.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1302.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1302.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1302.g: ਆਨਦ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
1302.t: aanadh ra(n)g binodh hamaarai ||
1302.e: My home is filled with ecstasy, pleasure and joy.

1302.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1302.t: naamo gaavan naam dhiaavan naam hamaare praan adhaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
1302.e: I sing the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. The Naam is the Support of my breath of life. ||1||Pause||

1302.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
1302.t: naamo giaan naam isanaanaa har naam hamaare kaaraj savaarai ||
1302.e: The Naam is spiritual wisdom, the Naam is my purifying bath. The Naam resolves all my affairs.

1302.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਡਾਈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
1302.t: har naamo sobhaa naam baddaiee bhaujal bikham naam har taarai ||1||
1302.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glorious grandeur; the Naam is glorious greatness. The Name of the Lord carries me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

1302.g: ਅਗਮ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਾਲ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਰੈ ॥
1302.t: agam padhaarath laal amolaa bhio paraapat gur charanaarai ||
1302.e: The Unfathomable Treasure, the Priceless Gem - I have received it, through the Guru's Feet.

1302.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਦਰਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੪॥
1302.t: kahu naanak prabh bhe kirapaalaa magan bhe heearai dharasaarai ||2||5||24||
1302.e: Says Nanak, God has become Merciful; my heart is intoxicated by the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||2||5||24||

1302.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1302.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1302.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1302.g: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
1302.t: saajan meet suaamee nero ||
1302.e: My Friend, my Best Friend, my Lord and Master, is near.

1302.g: ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਭਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਥੋਰੈ ਕਾਜ ਬੁਰੋ ਕਹ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1302.t: pekhat sunat sabhan kai sa(n)ge thorai kaaj buro keh fero ||1|| rahaau ||
1302.e: He sees and hears everything; He is with everyone. You are here for such short time - why do you do evil? ||1||Pause||

1302.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੇਤੋ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਕਛੂ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ॥
1302.t: naam binaa jeto lapaTaio kachhoo nahee naahee kachh tero ||
1302.e: Except for the Naam, whatever you are involved with is nothing - nothing is yours.

1302.g: ਆਗੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵਤ ਸਭ ਪਰਗਟ ਈਹਾ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
1302.t: aagai dhirasaT aavat sabh paragaT ieehaa mohio bharam a(n)dhero ||1||
1302.e: Hereafter, everything is revealed to your gaze; but in this world, all are enticed by the darkness of doubt. ||1||

1302.g: ਅਟਕਿਓ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਬਿਸੇਰੋ ॥
1302.t: aTakio sut banitaa sa(n)g maiaa dhevanahaar dhaataar bisero ||
1302.e: People are caught in Maya, attached to their children and spouses. They have forgotten the Great and Generous Giver.

1303.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਰੋਸਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੫॥
1303.t: kahu naanak ekai bhaarosau ba(n)dhan kaaTanahaar gur mero ||2||6||25||
1303.e: Says Nanak, I have one article of faith; my Guru is the One who releases me from bondage. ||2||6||25||

1303.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1303.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1303.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1303.g: ਬਿਖੈ ਦਲੁ ਸੰਤਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਗਾਹਿਓ ॥
1303.t: bikhai dhal sa(n)tan tum(h)rai gaahio ||
1303.e: Your Saints have overwhelmed the wicked army of corruption.

1303.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1303.t: tumaree Tek bharosaa Thaakur saran tum(h)aaree aahio ||1|| rahaau ||
1303.e: They take Your Support and place their faith in You, O my Lord and Master; they seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

1303.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਿਟਾਹਿਓ ॥
1303.t: janam janam ke mahaa paraachhat dharasan bheT miTaahio ||
1303.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the terrible sins of countless lifetimes are erased.

1303.g: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਨਦ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
1303.t: bhio pragaas anadh ujeeaaraa sahaj samaadh samaahio ||1||
1303.e: I am illumined, enlightened and filled with ecstasy. I am intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi. ||1||

1303.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਥਾਹਿਓ ॥
1303.t: kaun kahai tum te kachh naahee tum samarath athaahio ||
1303.e: Who says that You cannot do everything? You are Infinitely All-powerful.

1303.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਿਓ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੬॥
1303.t: kirapaa nidhaan ra(n)g roop ras naam naanak lai laahio ||2||7||26||
1303.e: O Treasure of Mercy, Nanak savors Your Love and Your Blissful Form, earning the Profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||26||

1303.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1303.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1303.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1303.g: ਬੂਡਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
1303.t: booddat praanee har jap dheerai ||
1303.e: The drowning mortal is comforted and consoled, meditating on the Lord.

1303.g: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੀਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1303.t: binasai moh bharam dhukh peerai ||1|| rahaau ||
1303.e: He is rid of emotional attachment, doubt, pain and suffering. ||1||Pause||

1303.g: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
1303.t: simarau dhin rain gur ke charanaa ||
1303.e: I meditate in remembrance, day and night, on the Guru's Feet.

1303.g: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
1303.t: jat kat pekhau tumaree saranaa ||1||
1303.e: Wherever I look, I see Your Sanctuary. ||1||

1303.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
1303.t: sa(n)t prasaadh har ke gun gaiaa ||
1303.e: By the Grace of the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

1303.g: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੭॥
1303.t: gur bheTat naanak sukh paiaa ||2||8||27||
1303.e: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has found peace. ||2||8||27||

1303.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1303.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1303.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1303.g: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
1303.t: simarat naam maneh sukh paieeaai ||
1303.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, peace of mind is found.

1303.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1303.t: saadh janaa mil har jas gaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
1303.e: Meeting the Holy Saint, sing the Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1303.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੇਰੋ ॥
1303.t: kar kirapaa prabh ridhai basero ||
1303.e: Granting His Grace, God has come to dwell within my heart.

1303.g: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਥਾ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
1303.t: charan sa(n)tan kai maathaa mero ||1||
1303.e: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints. ||1||

1303.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਮਨਾਂ ॥
1303.t: paarabraham kau simarahu manaa(n) ||
1303.e: Meditate, O my mind, on the Supreme Lord God.

1303.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੮॥
1303.t: gurmukh naanak har jas sunaa(n) ||2||9||28||
1303.e: As Gurmukh, Nanak listens to the Praises of the Lord. ||2||9||28||

1303.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1303.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1303.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1303.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਸਨ ॥
1303.t: mere man preet charan prabh parasan ||
1303.e: My mind loves to touch the Feet of God.

1303.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਜਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ਅਖੀਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1303.t: rasanaa har har bhojan tirapataanee akheean kau sa(n)tokh prabh dharasan ||1|| rahaau ||
1303.e: My tongue is satisfied with the Food of the Lord, Har, Har. My eyes are contented with the Blessed Vision of God. ||1||Pause||

1303.g: ਕਰਨਨਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਲਮਲ ਦੋਖ ਸਗਲ ਮਲ ਹਰਸਨ ॥
1303.t: karanan poor rahio jas preetam kalamal dhokh sagal mal harasan ||
1303.e: My ears are filled with the Praise of my Beloved; all my foul sins and faults are erased.

1303.g: ਪਾਵਨ ਧਾਵਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਪੰਥਾ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਸਨ ॥੧॥
1303.t: paavan dhaavan suaamee sukh pa(n)thaa a(n)g sa(n)g kaiaa sa(n)t sarasan ||1||
1303.e: My feet follow the Path of Peace to my Lord and Master; my body and limbs joyfully blossom forth in the Society of the Saints. ||1||

1303.g: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਕਿਤ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਸਨ ॥
1303.t: saran gahee pooran abinaasee aan upaav thakit nahee karasan ||
1303.e: I have taken Sanctuary in my Perfect, Eternal, Imperishable Lord. I do not bother trying anything else.

1303.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਸਨ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੯॥
1303.t: kar geh le'ee naanak jan apane a(n)dh ghor saagar nahee marasan ||2||10||29||
1303.e: Taking them by the hand, O Nanak, God saves His humble servants; they shall not perish in the deep, dark world-ocean. ||2||10||29||

1303.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1303.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1303.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1303.g: ਕੁਹਕਤ ਕਪਟ ਖਪਟ ਖਲ ਗਰਜਤ ਮਰਜਤ ਮੀਚੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1303.t: kuhakat kapaT khapaT khal garajat marajat meech anik bareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1303.e: Those fools who bellow with rage and destructive deceit, are crushed and killed innumerable times. ||1||Pause||

1303.g: ਅਹੰ ਮਤ ਅਨ ਰਤ ਕੁਮਿਤ ਹਿਤ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪੇਖਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਲਾਖ ਗਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
1303.t: aha(n) mat an rat kumit hit preetam pekhat bhramat laakh gareeaa ||1||
1303.e: Intoxicated with egotism and imbued with other tastes, I am in love with my evil enemies. My Beloved watches over me as I wander through thousands of incarnations. ||1||

1303.g: ਅਨਿਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਅਚਾਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੀਨਤ ਮਮ ਮਦ ਮਾਤ ਕੋਪ ਜਰੀਆ ॥
1303.t: anit biauhaar achaar bidh heenat mam madh maat kop jareeaa ||
1303.e: My dealings are false, and my lifestyle is chaotic. Intoxicated with the wine of emotion, I am burning in the fire of anger.

1303.g: ਕਰੁਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੦॥
1303.t: karun kirapaal guopaal dheen ba(n)dh naanak udhar saran pareeaa ||2||11||30||
1303.e: O Merciful Lord of the World, Embodiment of Compassion, Relative of the meek and the poor, please save Nanak; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||11||30||

1303.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1303.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1303.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1303.g: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
1303.t: jeea praan maan dhaataa ||
1303.e: The Giver of the soul, the breath of life and honor

1303.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤੇ ਹੀ ਹਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1303.t: har bisarate hee haan ||1|| rahaau ||
1303.e: - forgetting the Lord, all is lost. ||1||Pause||

1303.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੋ ਡਾਰਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਾਗਹਿ ॥
1303.t: gobi(n)dh tiaag aan laageh a(n)mrito ddaar bhoom paageh ||
1303.e: You have forsaken the Lord of the Universe, and become attached to another - you are throwing away the Ambrosial Nectar, to take dust.

1303.g: ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਸਿਉ ਆਸਕਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
1303.t: bikhai ras siau aasakat mooRe kaahe sukh maan ||1||
1303.e: What do you expect from corrupt pleasures? You fool! What makes you think that they will bring peace? ||1||

1304.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਜਨਮ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਖਾਨਿ ॥
1304.t: kaam karodh lobh biaapio janam hee kee khaan ||
1304.e: Engrossed in unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger and greed, you shall be consigned to reincarnation.

1304.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਉਧਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੧॥
1304.t: patit paavan saran aaio udhar naanak jaan ||2||12||31||
1304.e: But I have entered the Sanctuary of the Purifier of sinners. O Nanak, I know that I shall be saved. ||2||12||31||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:
I gaze on the Lotus-like Face of the Lord.

1304.g: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1304.t: khojat khojat ratan paio bisaree sabh chi(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
1304.e: Searching and seeking, I have found the Jewel. I am totally rid of all anxiety. ||1||Pause||
Enshrining His Lotus Feet within my heart,
pain and wickedness have been dispelled. ||1||

1304.g: ਰਾਜ ਧਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬਸੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
1304.t: raaj dhan paravaar merai sarabaso gobi(n)dh ||
1304.e: The Lord of all the Universe is my kingdom, wealth and family.

1304.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਮਰੰਦ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੩੨॥
1304.t: saadhasa(n)gam laabh paio naanak fir na mara(n)dh ||2||13||32||
1304.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has earned the Profit; he shall never die again. ||2||13||32||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Worship God, and adore His Name.
Grasp the Feet of the Guru, the True Guru.
The Unfathomable Lord shall come into your mind,

1304.g: ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1304.t: jag jeeto ho ho gur kirapaadh ||1|| rahaau ||
1304.e: and by Guru's Grace, you shall be victorious in this world. ||1||Pause||

1304.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਖੋਜੀ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਾਸਿ ॥
1304.t: anik poojaa mai bahu bidh khojee saa poojaa j har bhaavaas ||
1304.e: I have studied countless ways of worship in all sorts of ways, but that alone is worship, which is pleasing to the Lord's Will.

1304.g: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਜੋਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਏਹ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਸਿ ॥
1304.t: maaTee kee ieh putaree joree kiaa eh karam kamaas ||
1304.e: This body-puppet is made of clay - what can it do by itself?

1304.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
1304.t: prabh baeh pakar jis maarag paavahu so tudh ja(n)t milaas ||1||
1304.e: O God, those humble beings meet You, whom You grasp by the arm, and place on the Path. ||1||

1304.g: ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਇਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਆਸ ॥
1304.t: avar oT mai koi na soojhai ik har kee oT mai aas ||
1304.e: I do not know of any other support; O Lord, You are my only Hope and Support.
I am meek and poor - what prayer can I offer?
God abides in every heart.
My mind is thirsty for the Feet of God.

1304.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੩॥
1304.t: jan naanak dhaas kaheeat hai tum(h)raa hau bal bal sadh bal jaas ||2||1||33||
1304.e: Servant Nanak, Your slave, speaks: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||1||33||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Your Name, O my Beloved, is the Saving Grace of the world.

1304.g: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੈ ॥
1304.t: nav nidh naam nidhaan har kerai ||
1304.e: The Lord's Name is the wealth of the nine treasures.
One who is imbued with the Love of the Incomparably Beautiful Lord is joyful.
O mind, why do you cling to emotional attachments?
With your eyes, gaze upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Holy.

1304.g: ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1304.t: so paavai jis likhat lilerai ||1|| rahaau ||
1304.e: They alone find it, who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||1||Pause||
I serve at the feet of the Holy Saints.
I long for the dust of their feet, which purifies and sanctifies.
Just like the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, it washes away filth and pollution.

1304.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਰੈ ॥
1304.t: saas saas dhiaavahu mukh nahee morai ||
1304.e: With each and every breath I meditate on Him, and never turn my face away.

1304.g: ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੈ ॥
1304.t: kichh sa(n)g na chaalai laakh karorai ||
1304.e: Of your thousands and millions, nothing shall go along with you.

1304.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪੁਕਰੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
1304.t: prabh jee ko naam a(n)t pukarorai ||1||
1304.e: Only the Name of God will call to you in the end. ||1||
Let it be your wish to honor and obey the One Formless Lord.
Abandon the love of everything else.

1304.g: ਕਵਨ ਕਹਾਂ ਹਉ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
1304.t: kavan kahaa(n) hau gun pria terai ||
1304.e: What Glorious Praises of Yours can I utter, O my Beloved?
I cannot describe even one of Your Virtues.
My mind is so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

1304.g: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੪॥
1304.t: mil naanak dhev jagat gur kerai ||2||1||34||
1304.e: Please come and meet Nanak, O Divine Guru of the World. ||2||1||34||

1305.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1305.g: ਐਸੀ ਕਉਨ ਬਿਧੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1305.t: aaisee kaun bidhe dharasan parasanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1305.e: How may I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan? ||1||Pause||

1305.g: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਉਮਗਿ ਹੀਉ ਤਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥
1305.t: aas piaas safal moorat umag heeau tarasanaa ||1||
1305.e: I hope and thirst for Your wish-fulfilling image; my heart yearns and longs for You. ||1||

1305.g: ਦੀਨ ਲੀਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੀਨ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ॥
1305.t: dheen leen piaas meen sa(n)tanaa har sa(n)tanaa ||
1305.e: The meek and humble Saints are like thirsty fish; the Saints of the Lord are absorbed in Him.
I am the dust of the feet of the Lord's Saints.
I dedicate my heart to them.
God has become Merciful to me.

1305.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭੇਟਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੫॥
1305.t: maan moh tiaag chhoddio tau naanak har jeeau bheTanaa ||2||2||35||
1305.e: Renouncing pride and leaving behind emotional attachment, O Nanak, one meets with the Dear Lord. ||2||2||35||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:
The Playful Lord imbues all with the Color of His Love.

1305.g: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1305.t: keeT hasat pooran sabh sa(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1305.e: From the ant to the elephant, He is permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||
Some go on fasts, make vows, and take pilgrimages to sacred shrines on the Ganges.
They stand naked in the water, enduring hunger and poverty.
They sit cross-legged, perform worship services and do good deeds.
They apply religious symbols to their bodies, and ceremonial marks to their limbs.
They read through the Shaastras, but they do not join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||
They stubbornly practice ritualistic postures, standing on their heads.

1305.g: ਹਉ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਨ ਭੰਗਾ ॥
1305.t: hau rog biaapai chukai na bha(n)gaa ||
1305.e: They are afflicted with the disease of egotism, and their faults are not covered up.
They burn in the fire of sexual frustration, unresolved anger and compulsive desire.

1305.g: ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੬॥
1305.t: so mukat naanak jis satigur cha(n)gaa ||2||3||36||
1305.e: He alone is liberated, O Nanak, whose True Guru is Good. ||2||3||36||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Seventh House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1305.g: ਤਿਖ ਬੂਝਿ ਗਈ ਗਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ॥
1305.t: tikh boojh giee giee mil saadh janaa ||
1305.e: My thirst has been quenched, meeting with the Holy.

1305.g: ਪੰਚ ਭਾਗੇ ਚੋਰ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੈਨੋ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1305.t: pa(n)ch bhaage chor sahaje sukhaino hare gun gaavatee gaavatee gaavatee dharas piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1305.e: The five thieves have run away, and I am in peace and poise; singing, singing, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I obtain the Blessed Vision of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

1305.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਐਸੀ ਹਉ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਰਉ ॥
1305.t: jaisee karee prabh mo siau mo siau aaisee hau kaise karau ||
1305.e: That which God has done for me - how can I do that for Him in return?

1305.g: ਹੀਉ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਗਈ ॥੧॥
1305.t: heeau tum(h)aare bal bale bal bale bal giee ||1||
1305.e: I make my heart a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||1||

1305.g: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
1305.t: pahile pai sa(n)t pai dhiaai dhiaai preet lai ||
1305.e: First, I fall at the feet of the Saints; I meditate, meditate, lovingly attuned to You.

1305.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੇਹਰੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੰਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1305.t: prabh thaan tero keharo jit ja(n)tan kar beechaar ||
1305.e: O God, where is that Place, where You contemplate all Your beings?
Countless slaves sing Your Praises.

1305.g: ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਤੋ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
1305.t: soiee milio jo bhaavato jan naanak Thaakur rahio samai ||
1305.e: He alone meets You, who is pleasing to Your Will. Servant Nanak remains absorbed in his Lord and Master.
You, You, You alone, Lord. ||2||1||37||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Eighth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1305.g: ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਪੇਖਤਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ਹਾਂ ਹਾਂ ਮਨ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1305.t: tiaageeaai gumaan maan pekhataa dhiaal laal haa(n) haa(n) man charan ren ||1|| rahaau ||
1305.e: Give up your pride and your self-conceit; the Loving, Merciful Lord is watching over all. O mind, become the dust of His Feet. ||1||Pause||

1305.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੧॥
1305.t: har sa(n)t ma(n)t gupaal giaan dhiaan ||1||
1305.e: Through the Mantra of the Lord's Saints, experience the spiritual wisdom and meditation of the Lord of the World. ||1||

1305.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਾਇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਨਾ ॥
1305.t: hiradhai gobi(n)dh gai charan kamal preet lai dheen dhiaal mohanaa ||
1305.e: Within your heart, sing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and be lovingly attuned to His Lotus Feet. He is the Fascinating Lord, Merciful to the meek and the humble.
O Merciful Lord, please bless me with Your Kindness and Compassion.
Nanak begs for the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
I have abandoned emotional attachment, doubt and all egotistical pride. ||2||1||38||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1305.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਨ ਮਲਨ ਦਹਨ ਲਹਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਉਪਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1305.t: prabh kahan malan dhahan lahan gur mile aan nahee upaau ||1|| rahaau ||
1305.e: Speaking of God, filth and pollution are burnt away; This comes by meeting with the Guru, and not by any other efforts. ||1||Pause||

1306.g: ਤਟਨ ਖਟਨ ਜਟਨ ਹੋਮਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੰਡਧਾਰ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
1306.t: taTan khaTan jaTan homan naahee dda(n)ddadhaar suaau ||1||
1306.e: Making pilgrimages to sacred rivers, observing the six rituals, wearing matted and tangled hair, performing fire sacrifices and carrying ceremonial walking sticks - none of these are of any use. ||1||

1306.g: ਜਤਨ ਭਾਂਤਨ ਤਪਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਥਨ ਕਥਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਠਾਉ ॥
1306.t: jatan bhaa(n)tan tapan bhraman anik kathan kathate nahee thaeh paiee Thaau ||
1306.e: All sorts of efforts, austerities, wanderings and various speeches - none of these will lead you to find the Lord's Place.

1306.g: ਸੋਧਿ ਸਗਰ ਸੋਧਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੯॥
1306.t: sodh sagar sodhanaa sukh naanakaa bhaj naau ||2||2||39||
1306.e: I have considered all considerations, O Nanak, but peace comes only by vibrating and meditating on the Name. ||2||2||39||

1306.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯
1306.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar nauvaa
1306.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Ninth House:

1306.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1306.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1306.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1306.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲੁ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1306.t: patit paavan bhagat bachhal bhai haran taaran taran ||1|| rahaau ||
1306.e: The Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear - He carries us across to the other side. ||1||Pause||

1306.g: ਨੈਨ ਤਿਪਤੇ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਜਸੁ ਤੋਖਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਰਨ ॥੧॥
1306.t: nain tipate dharas pekh jas tokh sunat karan ||1||
1306.e: My eyes are satisfied, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; my ears are satisfied, hearing His Praise. ||1||

1306.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੀਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਰਨ ॥
1306.t: praan naath anaath dhaate dheen gobidh saran ||
1306.e: He is the Master of the praanaa, the breath of life; He is the Giver of Support to the unsupported. I am meek and poor - I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe.

1306.g: ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਗਹੀ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੦॥
1306.t: aas pooran dhukh binaasan gahee oT naanak har charan ||2||1||40||
1306.e: He is the Fulfiller of hope, the Destroyer of pain. Nanak grasps the Support of the Feet of the Lord. ||2||1||40||

1306.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1306.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1306.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1306.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
1306.t: charan saran dhiaal Thaakur aan naahee jai ||
1306.e: I seek the Sanctuary of the Feet of my Merciful Lord and Master; I do not go anywhere else.

1306.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਉਧਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1306.t: patit paavan biradh suaamee udharate har dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
1306.e: It is the Inherent Nature of our Lord and Master to purify sinners. Those who meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||Pause||

1306.g: ਸੈਸਾਰ ਗਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਪਤਿਤ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਅੰਧ ॥
1306.t: saisaar gaar bikaar saagar patit moh maan a(n)dh ||
1306.e: The world is a swamp of wickedness and corruption. The blind sinner has fallen into the ocean of emotional attachment and pride,

1306.g: ਬਿਕਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਧੰਧ ॥
1306.t: bikal maiaa sa(n)g dha(n)dh ||
1306.e: bewildered by the entanglements of Maya.

1306.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
1306.t: kar gahe prabh aap kaaddahu raakh leh gobi(n)dh rai ||1||
1306.e: God Himself has taken me by the hand and lifted me up and out of it; save me, O Sovereign Lord of the Universe. ||1||

1306.g: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
1306.t: anaath naath sanaath sa(n)tan koT paap binaas ||
1306.e: He is the Master of the masterless, the Supporting Lord of the Saints, the Neutralizer of millions of sins.

1306.g: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨੈ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
1306.t: man dharasanai kee piaas ||
1306.e: My mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

1306.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਨਤਾਸ ॥
1306.t: prabh pooran gunataas ||
1306.e: God is the Perfect Treasure of Virtue.

1306.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੧॥
1306.t: kirapaal dhiaal gupaal naanak har rasanaa gun gai ||2||2||41||
1306.e: O Nanak, sing and savor the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Kind and Compassionate Lord of the World. ||2||2||41||

1306.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1306.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1306.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1306.g: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਉ ਅਨਿਕ ਡਾਰਉ ॥
1306.t: vaar vaarau anik ddaarau ||
1306.e: Countless times, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice

1306.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਪਲਕ ਰਾਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1306.t: sukh pria suhaag palak raat ||1|| rahaau ||
1306.e: to that moment of peace, on that night when I was joined with my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

1306.g: ਕਨਿਕ ਮੰਦਰ ਪਾਟ ਸੇਜ ਸਖੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਤਾਤ ॥੧॥
1306.t: kanik ma(n)dhar paaT sej sakhee moh naeh in siau taat ||1||
1306.e: Mansions of gold, and beds of silk sheets - O sisters, I have no love for these. ||1||

1306.g: ਮੁਕਤ ਲਾਲ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਾਤ ॥
1306.t: mukat laal anik bhog bin naam naanak haat ||
1306.e: Pearls, jewels and countless pleasures, O Nanak, are useless and destructive without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1306.g: ਰੂਖੋ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭੂਮਿ ਸੈਨ ਸਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਤ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੨॥
1306.t: rookho bhojan bhoom sain sakhee pria sa(n)g sookh bihaat ||2||3||42||
1306.e: Even with only dry crusts of bread, and a hard floor on which to sleep, my life passes in peace and pleasure with my Beloved, O sisters. ||2||3||42||

1306.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1306.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1306.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1306.g: ਅਹੰ ਤੋਰੋ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਰੋ ॥
1306.t: aha(n) toro mukh joro ||
1306.e: Give up your ego, and turn your face to God.

1306.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਰੋ ॥
1306.t: gur gur karat man loro ||
1306.e: Let your yearning mind call out, ""Guru, Guru"".

1306.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਮੋਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1306.t: pria preet piaaro moro ||1|| rahaau ||
1306.e: My Beloved is the Lover of Love. ||1||Pause||

1306.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਆਗਨਿ ਚੈਨਾ ਤੋਰੋ ਰੀ ਤੋਰੋ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੋਰੋ ॥੧॥
1306.t: gireh sej suhaavee aagan chainaa toro ree toro pa(n)ch dhootan siau sa(n)g toro ||1||
1306.e: The bed of your household shall be cozy, and your courtyard shall be comfortable; shatter and break the bonds which tie you to the five thieves. ||1||

1306.g: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨਿ ਊਂਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਸੋਰੋ ॥
1306.t: aai na jai base nij aasan uoo(n)dh kamal bigasoro ||
1306.e: You shall not come and go in reincarnation; you shall dwell in your own home deep within, and your inverted heart-lotus shall blossom forth.

1306.g: ਛੁਟਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਰੋ ॥
1306.t: chhuTakee haumai soro ||
1306.e: The turmoil of egotism shall be silenced.

1306.g: ਗਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਗਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰੋ ॥੨॥੪॥੪੩॥
1306.t: gaio ree gaio prabh naanak gunee gahero ||2||4||43||
1306.e: Nanak sings - he sings the Praises of God, the Ocean of Virtue. ||2||4||43||

1306.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਃ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
1306.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar nauvaa ||
1306.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Ninth House:

1306.g: ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਜਾਪਿ ਮਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
1306.t: taa(n) te jaap manaa har jaap ||
1306.e: This is why you should chant and meditate on the Lord, O mind.

1306.g: ਜੋ ਸੰਤ ਬੇਦ ਕਹਤ ਪੰਥੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਅਹੰ ਤਾਪ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1306.t: jo sa(n)t bedh kahat pa(n)th gaakharo moh magan aha(n) taap || rahaau ||
1306.e: The Vedas and the Saints say that the path is treacherous and difficult. You are intoxicated with emotional attachment and the fever of egotism. ||Pause||

1306.g: ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
1306.t: jo raate maate sa(n)g bapuree maiaa moh sa(n)taap ||1||
1306.e: Those who are imbued and intoxicated with the wretched Maya, suffer the pains of emotional attachment. ||1||

1306.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਊ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਹੁ ਆਪ ॥
1306.t: naam japat souoo jan udharai jiseh udhaarahu aap ||
1306.e: That humble being is saved, who chants the Naam; You Yourself save him.

1306.g: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੋਹ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੫॥੪੪॥
1306.t: binas jai moh bhai bharamaa naanak sa(n)t prataap ||2||5||44||
1306.e: Emotional attachment, fear and doubt are dispelled, O Nanak, by the Grace of the Saints. ||2||5||44||

1307.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Tenth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1307.g: ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਾਤ ਜੀਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥
1307.t: aaiso dhaan dheh jee sa(n)tahu jaat jeeau balihaar ||
1307.e: Give me that blessing, O Dear Saints, for which my soul would be a sacrifice.

1307.g: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਹੀ ਉਰਝਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1307.t: maan mohee pa(n)ch dhohee urajh nikaT basio taakee saran saadhooaa dhoot sa(n)g nivaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1307.e: Enticed by pride, entrapped and plundered by the five thieves, still, you live near them. I have come to the Sanctuary of the Holy, and I have been rescued from my association with those demons. ||1||Pause||

1307.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
1307.t: koT janam jon bhramio haar pario dhuaar ||1||
1307.e: I wandered through millions of lifetimes and incarnations. I am so very tired - I have fallen at God's Door. ||1||

1307.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਈ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
1307.t: kirapaa gobi(n)dh bhiee milio naam adhaar ||
1307.e: The Lord of the Universe has become Kind to me; He has blessed me with the Support of the Naam.

1307.g: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੫॥
1307.t: dhulabh janam safal naanak bhav utaar paar ||2||1||45||
1307.e: This precious human life has become fruitful and prosperous; O Nanak, I am carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||45||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Eleventh House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
He Himself has come to me, in His Natural Way.
I know nothing, and I show nothing.

1307.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਲੇ ਭੋਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1307.t: prabh milio sukh baale bhole ||1|| rahaau ||
1307.e: I have met God through innocent faith, and He has blessed me with peace. ||1||Pause||
By the good fortune of my destiny, I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
I do not go out anywhere; I dwell in my own home.
God, the Treasure of Virtue, has been revealed in this body-robe. ||1||
I have fallen in love with His Feet; I have abandoned everything else.
In the places and interspaces, He is All-pervading.
With loving joy and excitement, Nanak speaks His Praises. ||2||1||46||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:
It is so hard to meet the Lord of the Universe, my Lord and Master.

1307.g: ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1307.t: paramit roop aga(n)m agochar rahio sarab samaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1307.e: His Form is Immeasurable, Inaccessible and Unfathomable; He is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

1307.g: ਕਹਨਿ ਭਵਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਕਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
1307.t: kahan bhavan naahee paio paio anik ukat chaturaiee ||1||
1307.e: By speaking and wandering, nothing is gained; nothing is obtained by clever tricks and devices. ||1||

1307.g: ਜਤਨ ਜਤਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਰੇ ਤਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾਈ ॥
1307.t: jatan jatan anik upaav re tau milio jau kirapaiee ||
1307.e: People try all sorts of things, but the Lord is only met when He shows His Mercy.

1307.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੭॥
1307.t: prabhoo dhiaar kirapaar kirapaa nidh jan naanak sa(n)t renaiee ||2||2||47||
1307.e: God is Kind and Compassionate, the Treasure of Mercy; servant Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||2||47||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:
O mother, I meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
Without God, there is no other at all.

1307.g: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸਾਸਨ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1307.t: chitavau charanaarabi(n)dh saasan nis bhor ||1|| rahaau ||
1307.e: I remember His Lotus Feet with every breath, night and day. ||1||Pause||

1307.g: ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਨ ਆਪਨ ਤੂਟਤ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
1307.t: lai preet keen aapan tooTat nahee jor ||
1307.e: He loves me and makes me His Own; my union with Him shall never be broken.

1307.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬਸੋੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧੇ ਸੁਖ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
1307.t: praan man dhan sarabasuo har gun nidhe sukh mor ||1||
1307.e: He is my breath of life, mind, wealth and everything. The Lord is the Treasure of Virtue and Peace. ||1||

1307.g: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਰਾਮ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰਿਦ ਖੋਰਿ ॥
1307.t: e'eet uoot raam pooran nirakhat ridh khor ||
1307.e: Here and hereafter, the Lord is perfectly pervading; He is seen deep within the heart.

1307.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਦੁਖੁ ਘੋਰ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੮॥
1307.t: sa(n)t saran taran naanak binasio dhukh ghor ||2||3||48||
1307.e: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, I am carried across; O Nanak, the terrible pain has been taken away. ||2||3||48||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:
God's humble servant is in love with Him.

1307.g: ਸਾਜਨੋ ਤੂ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1307.t: saajano too meet meraa gireh terai sabh keh ||1|| rahaau ||
1307.e: You are my Friend, my very best Friend; everything is in Your Home. ||1||Pause||

1307.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਤਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਧਨੁ ਲਖਮੀ ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥
1307.t: maan maa(n)gau taan maa(n)gau dhan lakhamee sut dheh ||1||
1307.e: I beg for honor, I beg for strength; please bless me with wealth, property and children. ||1||

1307.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
1307.t: mukat jugat bhugat pooran paramaana(n)dh param nidhaan ||
1307.e: You are the Technology of liberation, the Way to worldly success, the Perfect Lord of Supreme Bliss, the Transcendent Treasure.

1308.g: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੪॥੪੯॥
1308.t: bhai bhai bhagat nihaal naanak sadhaa sadhaa kurabaan ||2||4||49||
1308.e: In the Fear of God and loving devotion, Nanak is exalted and enraptured, forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||4||49||

1308.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1308.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
1308.e: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

1308.g: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਚਰਚ ਚਰਚ ਚਰਚਰੀ ॥
1308.t: karat karat charach charach characharee ||
1308.e: The debaters debate and argue their arguments.

1308.g: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਭੇਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਧਰਤ ਧਰਤ ਧਰਚਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1308.t: jog dhiaan bhekh giaan firat firat dharat dharat dharacharee ||1|| rahaau ||
1308.e: The Yogis and meditators, religious and spiritual teachers roam and ramble, wandering endlessly all over the earth. ||1||Pause||

1308.g: ਅਹੰ ਅਹੰ ਅਹੈ ਅਵਰ ਮੂੜ ਮੂੜ ਮੂੜ ਬਵਰਈ ॥
1308.t: aha(n) aha(n) ahai avar mooR mooR mooR bavariee ||
1308.e: They are egotistical, self-centered and conceited, foolish, stupid, idiotic and insane.

1308.g: ਜਤਿ ਜਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਲ ਹਈ ॥੧॥
1308.t: jat jaat jaat jaat sadhaa sadhaa sadhaa sadhaa kaal hiee ||1||
1308.e: Wherever they go and wander, death is always with them, forever and ever and ever and ever. ||1||

1308.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਈ ॥
1308.t: maan maan maan tiaag mrit mrit nikaT nikaT sadhaa hiee ||
1308.e: Give up your pride and stubborn self-conceit; death, yes, death, is always close and near at hand.

1308.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਭਾਜੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਮੂੜ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਭਜਨ ਭਜਨ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੫੦॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
1308.t: har hare hare bhaaj kahat naanak sunahu re mooR bin bhajan bhajan bhajan ahilaa janam giee ||2||5||50||12||62||
1308.e: Vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Har, Haray, Haray. Says Nanak, listen you fool: without vibrating, and meditating, and dwelling on Him, your life is uselessly wasting away. ||2||5||50||12||62||

1308.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
1308.t: kaanaRaa asaTapadheeaa mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
1308.e: Kaanraa, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehla, First House:

1308.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1308.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1308.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1308.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1308.t: jap man raam naam sukh paavaigo ||
1308.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind, and find peace.

1308.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1308.t: jiau jiau japai tivai sukh paavai satigur sev samaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
1308.e: The more you chant and meditate, the more you will be at peace; serve the True Guru, and merge in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1308.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਲੋਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1308.t: bhagat janaa(n) kee khin khin lochaa naam japat sukh paavaigo ||
1308.e: Each and every instant, the humble devotees long for Him; chanting the Naam, they find peace.

1308.g: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
1308.t: an ras saadh ge sabh neekar bin naavai kichh na sukhaavaigo ||1||
1308.e: The taste of other pleasures is totally eradicated; nothing pleases them, except the Name. ||1||

1308.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਠੇ ਬਚਨ ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1308.t: gurmat har har meeThaa laagaa gur meeThe bachan kaddaavaigo ||
1308.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord seems sweet to them; the Guru inspires them to speak sweet words.

1308.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
1308.t: satigur baanee purakh purakhotam baanee siau chit laavaigo ||2||
1308.e: Through the Word of the True Guru's Bani, the Primal Lord God is revealed; so focus your consciousness on His Bani. ||2||

1308.g: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਨਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਵਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1308.t: gurbaanee sunat meraa man dhraviaa man bheenaa nij ghar aavaigo ||
1308.e: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, my mind has been softened and saturated with it; my mind has returned to its own home deep within.

1308.g: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਤ ਧੁਨੀ ਬਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਨੀਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
1308.t: teh anahat dhunee baajeh nit baaje neejhar dhaar chuaavaigo ||3||
1308.e: The Unstruck Melody resonates and resounds there continuously; the stream of nectar trickles down constantly. ||3||

1308.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲ ਤਿਲ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1308.t: raam naam ik til til gaavai man gurmat naam samaavaigo ||
1308.e: Singing the Name of the One Lord each and every instant, and following the Guru's Teachings, the mind is absorbed in the Naam.

1308.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
1308.t: naam sunai naamo man bhaavai naame hee tirapataavaigo ||4||
1308.e: Listening to the Naam, the mind is pleased with the Naam, and satisfied with the Naam. ||4||

1308.g: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਨਿਕ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਕੰਗਨਾ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਨਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1308.t: kanik kanik pahire bahu ka(n)ganaa kaapar bhaa(n)t banaavaigo ||
1308.e: People wear lots of bracelets, glittering with gold; they wear all sorts of fine clothes.

1308.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਫੀਕ ਫਿਕਾਨੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
1308.t: naam binaa sabh feek fikaane janam marai fir aavaigo ||5||
1308.e: But without the Naam, they are all bland and insipid. They are born, only to die again, in the cycle of reincarnation. ||5||

1308.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਪਟਲ ਪਟਲ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਘਰੁ ਘੂਮਨਿ ਘੇਰਿ ਘੁਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1308.t: maiaa paTal paTal hai bhaaree ghar ghooman gher ghulaavaigo ||
1308.e: The veil of Maya is a thick and heavy veil, a whirlpool which destroys one's home.

1308.g: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨੂਰ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
1308.t: paap bikaar manoor sabh bhaare bikh dhutar tario na jaavaigo ||6||
1308.e: Sins and corrupt vices are totally heavy, like rusted slag. They will not let you cross over the poisonous and treacherous world-ocean. ||6||

1308.g: ਭਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1308.t: bhau bairaag bhiaa hai bohith gur khevaT sabadh taraavaigo ||
1308.e: Let the Fear of God and neutral detachment be the boat; the Guru is the Boatman, who carries us across in the Word of the Shabad.

1308.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
1308.t: raam naam har bheTeeaai har raamai naam samaavaigo ||7||
1308.e: Meeting with the Lord, the Name of the Lord, merge in the Lord, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

1308.g: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਜਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1308.t: agiaan lai savaaliaa gur giaanai lai jagaavaigo ||
1308.e: Attached to ignorance, people are falling asleep; attached to the Guru's spiritual wisdom, they awaken.

1308.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੧॥
1308.t: naanak bhaanai aapanai jiau bhaavai tivai chalaavaigo ||8||1||
1308.e: O Nanak, by His Will, He makes us walk as He pleases. ||8||1||

1308.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1308.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1308.e: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

1308.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1308.t: jap man har har naam taraavaigo ||
1308.e: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and be carried across.

1308.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੋਈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1308.t: jo jo japai soiee gat paavai jiau dhraoo prahilaadh samaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
1308.e: Whoever chants and meditates on it is emancipated. Like Dhroo and Prahlaad, they merge in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1309.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: kirapaa kirapaa kirapaa kar har jeeau kar kirapaa naam lagaavaigo ||
1309.e: Mercy, mercy, mercy - O Dear Lord, please shower Your Mercy on me, and attach me to Your Name.

1309.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
1309.t: kar kirapaa satiguroo milaavahu mil satigur naam dhiaavaigo ||1||
1309.e: Please be Merciful, and lead me to meet the True Guru; meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

1309.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: janam janam kee haumai mal laagee mil sa(n)gat mal leh jaavaigo ||
1309.e: The filth of egotism from countless incarnations sticks to me; joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, this filth is washed away.

1309.g: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਤਰਿਓ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
1309.t: jiau lohaa tario sa(n)g kaasaT lag sabadh guroo har paavaigo ||2||
1309.e: As iron is carried across if it is attached to wood, one who is attached to the Word of the Guru's Shabad finds the Lord. ||2||

1309.g: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: sa(n)gat sa(n)t milahu satasa(n)gat mil sa(n)gat har ras aavaigo ||
1309.e: Joining the Society of the Saints, joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, you shall come to receive the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

1309.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕਢਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਚੀਕੜੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
1309.t: bin sa(n)gat karam karai abhimaanee kadd paanee cheekaR paavaigo ||3||
1309.e: But not joining the Sangat, and committing actions in egotistical pride, is like drawing out clean water, and throwing it in the mud. ||3||

1309.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: bhagat janaa ke har rakhavaare jan har ras meeTh lagaavaigo ||
1309.e: The Lord is the Protector and Saving Grace of His humble devotees. The Lord's Sublime Essence seems so sweet to these humble beings.

1309.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
1309.t: khin khin naam dhei vaddiaaiee satigur upadhes samaavaigo ||4||
1309.e: Each and every instant, they are blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam; through the Teachings of the True Guru, they are absorbed in Him. ||4||

1309.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜਨ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਫਲ ਗੁਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: bhagat janaa kau sadhaa niv raheeaai jan niveh taa fal gun paavaigo ||
1309.e: Bow forever in deep respect to the humble devotees; if you bow to those humble beings, you shall obtain the fruit of virtue.

1309.g: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਨਾਖਸ ਜਿਉ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
1309.t: jo ni(n)dhaa dhusaT kareh bhagataa kee haranaakhas jiau pach jaavaigo ||5||
1309.e: Those wicked enemies who slander the devotees are destroyed, like Harnaakhash. ||5||

1309.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲ ਪੁਤੁ ਮੀਨ ਬਿਆਸਾ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਨ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: braham kamal put meen biaasaa tap taapan pooj karaavaigo ||
1309.e: Brahma, the son of the lotus, and Vyaas, the son of the fish, practiced austere penance and were worshipped.

1309.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਭਰਮਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
1309.t: jo jo bhagat hoi so poojahu bharaman bharam chukaavaigo ||6||
1309.e: Whoever is a devotee - worship and adore that person. Get rid of your doubts and superstitions. ||6||

1309.g: ਜਾਤ ਨਜਾਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਤ ਭਰਮਹੁ ਸੁਕ ਜਨਕ ਪਗੀਂ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: jaat najaat dhekh mat bharamahu suk janak pagee(n) lag dhiaavaigo ||
1309.e: Do not be fooled by appearances of high and low social class. Suk Dayv bowed at the feet of Janak, and meditated.

1309.g: ਜੂਠਨ ਜੂਠਿ ਪਈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਡੁਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
1309.t: jooThan jooTh piee sir uoopar khin manooaa til na ddulaavaigo ||7||
1309.e: Even though Janak threw his left-overs and garbage on Suk Dayv's head, his mind did not waver, even for an instant. ||7||

1309.g: ਜਨਕ ਜਨਕ ਬੈਠੇ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਨਉ ਮੁਨੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲੈ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: janak janak baiThe si(n)ghaasan nau munee dhoor lai laavaigo ||
1309.e: Janak sat upon his regal throne, and applied the dust of the nine sages to his forehead.

1309.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੨॥
1309.t: naanak kirapaa kirapaa kar Thaakur mai dhaasan dhaas karaavaigo ||8||2||
1309.e: Please shower Nanak with your Mercy, O my Lord and Master; make him the slave of Your slaves. ||8||2||

1309.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1309.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1309.e: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

1309.g: ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: man gurmat ras gun gaavaigo ||
1309.e: O mind, follow the Guru's Teachings, and joyfully sing God's Praises.

1309.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਹੋਇ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1309.t: jihavaa ek hoi lakh koTee lakh koTee koT dhiaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
1309.e: If my one tongue became hundreds of thousands and millions, I would meditate on Him millions and millions of times. ||1||Pause||

1309.g: ਸਹਸ ਫਨੀ ਜਪਿਓ ਸੇਖਨਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: sahas fanee japio sekhanaagai har japatiaa a(n)t na paavaigo ||
1309.e: The serpent king chants and meditates on the Lord with his thousands of heads, but even by these chants, he cannot find the Lord's limits.

1309.g: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
1309.t: too athaahu at agam agam hai mat gurmat man Thaharaavaigo ||1||
1309.e: You are Utterly Unfathomable, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, the mind becomes steady and balanced. ||1||

1309.g: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਜਪਿਓ ਤੇਈ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਅਹੁ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: jin too japio teiee jan neeke har japatiahu kau sukh paavaigo ||
1309.e: Those humble beings who meditate on You are noble and exalted. Meditating on the Lord, they are at peace.

1309.g: ਬਿਦਰ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਛੋਕ ਛੋਹਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਅੰਕਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
1309.t: bidhar dhaasee sut chhok chhoharaa kirasan a(n)k gal laavaigo ||2||
1309.e: Bidur, the son of a slave-girl, was an untouchable, but Krishna hugged him close in His Embrace. ||2||

1309.g: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਤਿ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਕਾਸਟ ਕਾਸਟ ਅੰਗਿ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: jal te opat bhiee hai kaasaT kaasaT a(n)g taraavaigo ||
1309.e: Wood is produced from water, but by holding onto wood, one is saved from drowning.

1309.g: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
1309.t: raam janaa har aap savaare apanaa biradh rakhaavaigo ||3||
1309.e: The Lord Himself embellishes and exalts His humble servants; He confirms His Innate Nature. ||3||

1309.g: ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਲੋਹ ਲੋਹ ਬਡ ਪਾਥਰ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: ham paathar loh loh badd paathar gur sa(n)gat naav taraavaigo ||
1309.e: I am like a stone, or a piece of iron, heavy stone and iron; in the Boat of the Guru's Congregation, I am carried across,

1309.g: ਜਿਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
1309.t: jiau satasa(n)gat tario julaaho sa(n)t janaa man bhaavaigo ||4||
1309.e: like Kabeer the weaver, who was saved in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. He became pleasing to the minds of the humble Saints. ||4||

1309.g: ਖਰੇ ਖਰੋਏ ਬੈਠਤ ਊਠਤ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: khare kharoe baiThat uooThat maarag pa(n)th dhiaavaigo ||
1309.e: Standing up, sitting down, rising up and walking on the path, I meditate.

1309.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਬਚਨ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਨਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
1309.t: satigur bachan bachan hai satigur paadhar mukat janaavaigo ||5||
1309.e: The True Guru is the Word, and the Word is the True Guru, who teaches the Path of Liberation. ||5||

1309.g: ਸਾਸਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਬਲੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ਨਿਹਸਾਸਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1309.t: saasan saas saas bal paiee hai nihasaasan naam dhiaavaigo ||
1309.e: By His Training, I find strength with each and every breath; now that I am trained and tamed, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1309.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤੌ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
1309.t: gur parasaadhee haumai boojhai tau gurmat naam samaavaigo ||6||
1309.e: By Guru's Grace, egotism is extinguished, and then, through the Guru's Teachings, I merge in the Naam. ||6||

1310.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: satigur dhaataa jeea jeean ko bhaagaheen nahee bhaavaigo ||
1310.e: The True Guru is the Giver of the life of the soul, but the unfortunate ones do not love Him.

1310.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
1310.t: fir eh velaa haath na aavai parataapai pachhutaavaigo ||7||
1310.e: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; in the end, they will suffer in torment and regret. ||7||

1310.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਭਲ ਅਪਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: je ko bhalaa loRai bhal apanaa gur aagai ddeh ddeh paavaigo ||
1310.e: If a good person seeks goodness for himself, he should bow low in humble surrender to the Guru.

1310.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੩॥
1310.t: naanak dhiaa dhiaa kar Thaakur mai satigur bhasam lagaavaigo ||8||3||
1310.e: Nanak prays: please show kindness and compassion to me, O my Lord and Master, that I may apply the dust of the True Guru to my forehead. ||8||3||

1310.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1310.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1310.e: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

1310.g: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: man har ra(n)g raataa gaavaigo ||
1310.e: O mind, be attuned to His Love, and sing.

1310.g: ਭੈ ਭੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1310.t: bhai bhai traas bhe hai niramal gurmat laag lagaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
1310.e: The Fear of God makes me fearless and immaculate; I am dyed in the color of the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

1310.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: har ra(n)g raataa sadh bairaagee har nikaT tinaa ghar aavaigo ||
1310.e: Those who are attuned to the Lord's Love remain balanced and detached forever; they live near the Lord, who comes into their house.

1310.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
1310.t: tin kee pa(n)k milai taa(n) jeevaa kar kirapaa aap dhivaavaigo ||1||
1310.e: If I am blessed with the dust of their feet, then I live. Granting His Grace, He Himself bestows it. ||1||

1310.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਗੇ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: dhubidhaa lobh lage hai praanee man korai ra(n)g na aavaigo ||
1310.e: Mortal beings are attached to greed and duality. Their minds are unripe and unfit, and will not accept the Dye of His Love.

1310.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਉਲਟਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
1310.t: fir ulaTio janam hovai gur bachanee gur purakh milai ra(n)g laavaigo ||2||
1310.e: But their lives are transformed through the Word of the Guru's Teachings. Meeting with the Guru, the Primal Being, they are dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||

1310.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਦਸੇ ਦਸੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਵਤ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣੀਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਟਿਕਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: ei(n)dhree dhase dhase fun dhaavat trai guneeaa khin na Tikaavaigo ||
1310.e: There are ten organs of sense and action; the ten wander unrestrained. Under the influence of the three dispositions, they are not stable, even for an instant.

1310.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
1310.t: satigur parachai vasagat aavai mokh mukat so paavaigo ||3||
1310.e: Coming in contact with the True Guru, they are brought under control; then, salvation and liberation are attained. ||3||

1310.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਏਕਸ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: oa(n)kaar eko rav rahiaa sabh ekas maeh samaavaigo ||
1310.e: The One and Only Creator of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. All shall once again merge into the One.

1310.g: ਏਕੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕਤੁ ਬਚਨਿ ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
1310.t: eko roop eko bahu ra(n)gee sabh ekat bachan chalaavaigo ||4||
1310.e: His One Form has one, and many colors; He leads all according to His One Word. ||4||

1310.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: gurmukh eko ek pachhaataa gurmukh hoi lakhaavaigo ||
1310.e: The Gurmukh realizes the One and Only Lord; He is revealed to the Gurmukh.

1310.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਜ ਮਹਲੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
1310.t: gurmukh jai milai nij mahalee anahadh sabadh bajaavaigo ||5||
1310.e: The Gurmukh goes and meets the Lord in His Mansion deep within; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad vibrates there. ||5||

1310.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh sisaT upaiee gurmukh sobhaa paavaigo ||
1310.e: God created all the beings and creatures of the universe; He blesses the Gurmukh with glory.

1310.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੋ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
1310.t: bin gur bheTe ko mahal na paavai aai jai dhukh paavaigo ||6||
1310.e: Without meeting the Guru, no one obtains the Mansion of His Presence. They suffer the agony of coming and going in reincarnation. ||6||

1310.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: anek janam vichhuRe mere preetam kar kirapaa guroo milaavaigo ||
1310.e: For countless lifetimes, I have been separated from my Beloved; in His Mercy, the Guru has united me with Him.

1310.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਮਲੀਨ ਬਿਗਸਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
1310.t: satigur milat mahaa sukh paiaa mat maleen bigasaavaigo ||7||
1310.e: Meeting the True Guru, I have found absolute peace, and my polluted intellect blossoms forth. ||7||

1310.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮੈ ਸਰਧਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: har har kirapaa karahu jagajeevan mai saradhaa naam lagaavaigo ||
1310.e: O Lord, Har, Har, please grant Your Grace; O Life of the World, instill faith in the Naam within me.

1310.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੪॥
1310.t: naanak guroo guroo hai satigur mai satigur saran milaavaigo ||8||4||
1310.e: Nanak is the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru; I am immersed in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||8||4||

1310.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1310.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1310.e: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

1310.g: ਮਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਾਲ ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: man gurmat chaal chalaavaigo ||
1310.e: O mind, walk on the Path of the Guru's Teachings.

1310.g: ਜਿਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਮਸਤੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਤਲਿ ਕੁੰਡੇ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1310.t: jiau maigal masat dheejai tal ku(n)dde gur a(n)kas sabadh dhiraRaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
1310.e: Just as the wild elephant is subdued by the prod, the mind is disciplined by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

1310.g: ਚਲਤੌ ਚਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਦਹ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: chalatau chalai chalai dheh dheh dhis gur raakhai har liv laavaigo ||
1310.e: The wandering mind wanders, roams and rambles in the ten directions; but the Guru holds it, and lovingly attunes it to the Lord.

1310.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੇਇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
1310.t: satigur sabadh dhei ridh a(n)tar mukh a(n)mrit naam chuaavaigo ||1||
1310.e: The True Guru implants the Word of the Shabad deep within the heart; the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, trickles into the mouth. ||1||

1310.g: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਬਿਸੂ ਭਰੇ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: biseear bisoo bhare hai pooran gur garuR sabadh mukh paavaigo ||
1310.e: The snakes are filled with poisonous venom; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the antidote - place it in your mouth.

1310.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਝਾਰਿ ਝਾਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
1310.t: maiaa bhuia(n)g tis neR na aavai bikh jhaar jhaar liv laavaigo ||2||
1310.e: Maya, the serpent, does not even approach one who is rid of the poison, and lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||2||

1310.g: ਸੁਆਨੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1310.t: suaan lobh nagar meh sabalaa gur khin meh maar kaddaavaigo ||
1310.e: The dog of greed is very powerful in the village of the body; the Guru strikes it and drives it out in an instant.

1310.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਆਨਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
1310.t: sat sa(n)tokh dharam aan raakhe har nagaree har gun gaavaigo ||3||
1310.e: Truth, contentment, righteousness and Dharma have settled there; in the village of the Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

1311.g: ਪੰਕਜ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਘਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਘਰਤ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: pa(n)kaj moh nigharat hai praanee gur nigharat kaadd kaddaavaigo ||
1311.e: The mortal beings are sinking in the swamp of emotional attachment; the Guru lifts them up, and saves them from sinking.

1311.g: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਜਨ ਆਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਾਥੀ ਦੇ ਨਿਕਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
1311.t: traeh traeh saran jan aae gur haathee dhe nikalaavaigo ||4||
1311.e: Crying, ""Save me! Save me!"", the humble come to His Sanctuary; the Guru reaches out His Hand, and lifts them up. ||4||

1311.g: ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਖਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: supana(n)tar sa(n)saar sabh baajee sabh baajee khel khilaavaigo ||
1311.e: The whole world is like a game in a dream, all a game. God plays and causes the game to be played.

1311.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੈ ਚਾਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
1311.t: laahaa naam gurmat lai chaalahu har dharageh paidhaa jaavaigo ||5||
1311.e: So earn the Profit of the Naam by following the Guru's Teachings; you shall go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||5||

1311.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਇਲੇ ਆਨਿ ਜਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: haumai karai karaavai haumai paap koile aan jamaavaigo ||
1311.e: They act in egotism, and make others act in egotism; they collect and gather up the blackness of sin.

1311.g: ਆਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੋਏ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਵਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
1311.t: aaiaa kaal dhukhadhaiee hoe jo beeje so khavalaavaigo ||6||
1311.e: And when death comes, they suffer in agony; they must eat what they have planted. ||6||

1311.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਲੈ ਖਰਚੁ ਚਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: sa(n)tahu raam naam dhan sa(n)chahu lai kharach chale pat paavaigo ||
1311.e: O Saints, gather the Wealth of the Lord's Name; if you depart after packing these provisions, you shall be honored.

1311.g: ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
1311.t: khai kharach dheveh bahuteraa har dhedhe toT na aavaigo ||7||
1311.e: So eat, spend, consume and give abundantly; the Lord will give - there will be no deficiency. ||7||

1311.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: raam naam dhan hai ridh a(n)tar dhan gur saranaiee paavaigo ||
1311.e: The wealth of the Lord's Name is deep within the heart. In the Sanctuary of the Guru, this wealth is found.

1311.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੫॥
1311.t: naanak dhiaa dhiaa kar dheenee dhukh dhaaladh bha(n)j samaavaigo ||8||5||
1311.e: O Nanak, God has been kind and compassionate; He has blessed me. Removing pain and poverty, He has blended me with Himself. ||8||5||

1311.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1311.t: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1311.e: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

1311.g: ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: man satigur saran dhiaavaigo ||
1311.e: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, and meditate.

1311.g: ਲੋਹਾ ਹਿਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਗੁਨੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1311.t: lohaa hiran hovai sa(n)g paaras gun paaras ko hoi aavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
1311.e: Iron is transformed into gold by touching the philosopher's stone; it takes on its qualities. ||1||Pause||

1311.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਜੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: satigur mahaa purakh hai paaras jo laagai so fal paavaigo ||
1311.e: The True Guru, the Great Primal Being, is the philosopher's stone. Whoever is attached to Him receives fruitful rewards.

1311.g: ਜਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਤਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
1311.t: jiau gur upadhes tare prahilaadhaa gur sevak paij rakhaavaigo ||1||
1311.e: Just as Prahlaad was saved by the Guru's Teachings, the Guru protects the honor of His servant. ||1||

1311.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੁ ਬਚਨੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: satigur bachan bachan hai neeko gur bachanee a(n)mrit paavaigo ||
1311.e: The Word of the True Guru is the most Sublime and Noble Word. Through the Guru's Word, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained.

1311.g: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਬਰੀਕਿ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
1311.t: jiau a(n)bareek amaraa padh paae satigur mukh bachan dhiaavaigo ||2||
1311.e: Ambreek the king was blessed with the status of immortality, meditating on the Word of the True Guru. ||2||

1311.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਧਾ ਸੁਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: satigur saran saran man bhaiee sudhaa sudhaa kar dhiaavaigo ||
1311.e: The Sanctuary, the Protection and Sanctuary of the True Guru is pleasing to the mind. It is sacred and pure - meditate on it.

1311.g: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੀਨ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
1311.t: dhiaal dheen bhe hai satigur har maarag pa(n)th dhikhaavaigo ||3||
1311.e: The True Guru has become Merciful to the meek and the poor; He has shown me the Path, the Way to the Lord. ||3||

1311.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਏ ਸੇ ਥਾਪੇ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: satigur saran pe se thaape tin raakhan kau prabh aavaigo ||
1311.e: Those who enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru are firmly established; God comes to protect them.

1311.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧੈ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਲਟੋ ਤਿਸੈ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
1311.t: je ko sar sa(n)dhai jan uoopar fir ulaTo tisai lagaavaigo ||4||
1311.e: If someone aims an arrow at the Lord's humble servant, it will turn around and hit him instead. ||4||

1311.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: har har har har har sar seveh tin dharageh maan dhivaavaigo ||
1311.e: Those who bathe in the Sacred Pool of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are blessed with honor in His Court.

1311.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
1311.t: gurmat gurmat gurmat dhiaaveh har gal mil mel milaavaigo ||5||
1311.e: Those who meditate on the Guru's Teachings, the Guru's Instructions, the Guru's Wisdom, are united in the Lord's Union; He hugs them close in His Embrace. ||5||

1311.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: gurmukh naadh bedh hai gurmukh gur parachai naam dhiaavaigo ||
1311.e: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad, The Guru's Word is the wisdom of the Vedas; coming in contact with the Guru, meditate on the Naam.

1311.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
1311.t: har har roop har roopo hovai har jan kau pooj karaavaigo ||6||
1311.e: In the Image of the Lord, Har, Har, one becomes the Embodiment of the Lord. The Lord makes His humble servant worthy of worship. ||6||

1311.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: saakat nar satigur nahee keeaa te bemukh har bharamaavaigo ||
1311.e: The faithless cynic does not submit to the True Guru; the Lord makes the non-believer wander in confusion.

1311.g: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰੰਗਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
1311.t: lobh lahar suaan kee sa(n)gat bikh maiaa kara(n)g lagaavaigo ||7||
1311.e: The waves of greed are like packs of dogs. The poison of Maya sticks to the body-skeleton. ||7||

1311.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕਾ ਤਾਰਕੁ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
1311.t: raam naam sabh jag kaa taarak lag sa(n)gat naam dhiaavaigo ||
1311.e: The Lord's Name is the Saving Grace of the whole world; join the Sangat, and meditate on the Naam.

1311.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੬॥
1311.t: naanak raakh raakh prabh mere satasa(n)gat raakh samaavaigo ||8||6||
1311.e: O my God, please protect and preserve Nanak in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; save him, and let him merge in You. ||8||6||

1311.g: ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
1311.t: chhakaa 1 ||
1311.e: First Set of Six||

1312.g: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
1312.t: kaanaRaa chha(n)t mahalaa panjavaa
1312.e: Kaanraa, Chhant, Fifth Mehla:

1312.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1312.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1312.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1312.g: ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
1312.t: se udhare jin raam dhiaae ||
1312.e: They alone are saved, who meditate on the Lord.

1312.g: ਜਤਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥
1312.t: jatan maiaa ke kaam na aae ||
1312.e: Working for Maya is useless.

1312.g: ਰਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਆ ॥
1312.t: raam dhiaae sabh fal paae dhan dha(n)n te baddabhaageeaa ||
1312.e: Meditating on the Lord, all fruits and rewards are obtained. They are blessed, blessed and very fortunate.

1312.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀਆ ॥
1312.t: satasa(n)g jaage naam laage ek siau liv laageeaa ||
1312.e: They are awake and aware in the True Congregation; attached to the Naam, they are lovingly attuned to the One.

1312.g: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ॥
1312.t: taj maan moh bikaar saadhoo lag tarau tin kai paae ||
1312.e: I have renounced pride, emotional attachment, wickedness and corruption; attached to the Holy, I am carried across at their feet.

1312.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਡਭਾਗਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
1312.t: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee baddabhaag dharasan paae ||1||
1312.e: Prays Nanak, I have come to the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; by great good fortune, I obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||

1312.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਿਤ ਭਜਹ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
1312.t: mil saadhoo nit bhajeh naarain ||
1312.e: The Holy meet together, and continually vibrate and meditate on the Lord.

1312.g: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਣ ॥
1312.t: rasak rasak suaamee gun gain ||
1312.e: With love and excitement, they sing the Glorious Praises of their Lord and Master.

1312.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੀਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਵਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਭਾਗਏ ॥
1312.t: gun gai jeeveh har amiau peeveh janam maranaa bhaage ||
1312.e: Singing His Praises they live, drinking in the Lord's Nectar; the cycle of birth and death is over for them.

1312.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਏ ॥
1312.t: satasa(n)g paieeaai har dhiaaieeaai bahuR dhookh na laage ||
1312.e: Finding the True Congregation and meditating on the Lord, one is never again afflicted with pain.

1312.g: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਤੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਣ ॥
1312.t: kar dhiaa dhaate purakh bidhaate sa(n)t sev kamain ||
1312.e: By the Grace of the Great Giver, the Architect of Destiny, we work to serve the Saints.

1312.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਣ ॥੨॥
1312.t: binava(n)t naanak jan dhoor baa(n)chheh har dharas sahaj samain ||2||
1312.e: Prays Nanak, I long for the dust of the feet of the humble; I am intuitively absorbed in the Blessed Vision of the Lord. ||2||

1312.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਤ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੈ ॥
1312.t: sagale ja(n)t bhajahu gopaalai ||
1312.e: All beings vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World.

1312.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
1312.t: jap tap sa(n)jam pooran ghaalai ||
1312.e: This brings the merits of chanting and meditation, austere self-discipline and perfect service.

1312.g: ਨਿਤ ਭਜਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
1312.t: nit bhajahu suaamee a(n)tarajaamee safal janam sabaiaa ||
1312.e: Vibrating and meditating continuously on our Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, one's life becomes totally fruitful.

1312.g: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
1312.t: gobidh gaieeaai nit dhiaaieeaai paravaan soiee aaiaa ||
1312.e: Those who sing and meditate continually on the Lord of the Universe - their coming into the world is blessed and approved.

1312.g: ਜਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
1312.t: jap taap sa(n)jam har har nira(n)jan gobi(n)dh dhan sa(n)g chaalai ||
1312.e: The Immaculate Lord, Har, Har, is meditation and chanting, and austere self-discipline; only the Wealth of the Lord of the Universe shall go along with you in the end.

1312.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਾਧਉ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੩॥
1312.t: binava(n)t naanak kar dhiaa dheejai har ratan baadhau paalai ||3||
1312.e: Prays Nanak, please grant Your Grace, O Lord, and bless me with the Jewel, that I may carry it in my pocket. ||3||

1312.g: ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰ ਚੋਜ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
1312.t: ma(n)galachaar choj aana(n)dhaa ||
1312.e: His Wondrous and Amazing Plays are blissful

1312.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
1312.t: kar kirapaa mile paramaana(n)dhaa ||
1312.e: granting His Grace, He bestows supreme ecstasy.

1312.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹਗਾਮੀ ਇਛ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
1312.t: prabh mile suaamee sukhahagaamee ichh man kee pu(n)neeaa ||
1312.e: God, my Lord and Master, the Bringer of peace, has met me, and the desires of my mind are fulfilled.

1312.g: ਬਜੀ ਬਧਾਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਮਾਈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖਿ ਨ ਰੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
1312.t: bajee badhaiee sahaje samaiee bahuR dhookh na ru(n)neeaa ||
1312.e: Congratulations pour in; I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. I shall never again cry out in pain.

1312.g: ਲੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
1312.t: le ka(n)Th laae sukh dhikhaae bikaar binase ma(n)dhaa ||
1312.e: He hugs me close in His Embrace, and blesses me with peace; the evil of sin and corruption is gone.

1312.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
