1323.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਰਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1323.t: satigur agam agam hai Thaakur bhar saagar bhagat kareejai ||
1323.e: The True Guru is Inaccessible; Inaccessible is our Lord and Master. He is the overflowing Ocean of bliss - worship Him with loving devotion.

1323.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਮ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
1323.t: kirapaa kirapaa kar dheen ham saari(n)g ik boo(n)dh naam mukh dheejai ||4||
1323.e: Please take pity on me, and be Merciful to this meek song-bird; please pour a drop of Your Name into my mouth. ||4||

1323.g: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਰੰਗਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
1323.t: laalan laal laal hai ra(n)gan man ra(n)gan kau gur dheejai ||
1323.e: O Beloved Lord, please color my mind with the Deep Crimson Color of Your Love; I have surrendered my mind to the Guru.

1323.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਗਟਕ ਨਿਤ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
1323.t: raam raam raam ra(n)g raate ras rasik gaTak nit peejai ||5||
1323.e: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, continually drink in this essence in big gulps, savoring its sweet taste. ||5||

1323.g: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਹੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਢਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
1323.t: basudhaa sapat dheep hai saagar kadd ka(n)chan kaadd dhareejai ||
1323.e: If all the gold of the seven continents and the oceans was taken out and placed before them,

1323.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਇਨਹੁ ਨ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
1323.t: mere Thaakur ke jan inahu na baachheh har maageh har ras dheejai ||6||
1323.e: the humble servants of my Lord and Master would not even want it. They beg for the Lord to bless them with the Lord's Sublime Essence. ||6||

1323.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਸਦ ਭੂਖੇ ਨਿਤ ਭੂਖਨ ਭੂਖ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1323.t: saakat nar praanee sadh bhookhe nit bhookhan bhookh kareejai ||
1323.e: The faithless cynics and mortal beings remain hungry forever; they continually cry out in hunger.

1323.g: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਖ ਕੋਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਥਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
1323.t: dhaavat dhai dhaaveh preet maiaa lakh kosan kau bith dheejai ||7||
1323.e: They hurry and run, and wander all around, caught in the love of Maya; they cover hundreds of thousands of miles in their wanderings. ||7||

1323.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
1323.t: har har har har har jan uootam kiaa upamaa tin(h) dheejai ||
1323.e: The humble servants of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are sublime and exalted. What praise can we bestow upon them?

1324.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੧॥
1324.t: raam naam tul aaur na upamaa jan naanak kirapaa kareejai ||8||1||
1324.e: Nothing else can equal the Glory of the Lord's Name; please bless servant Nanak with Your Grace. ||8||1||

1324.g: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1324.t: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1324.e: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

1324.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: raam gur paaras paras kareejai ||
1324.e: O Lord, please bless me with the Touch of the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

1324.g: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀ ਮਨੂਰ ਅਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1324.t: ham niragunee manoor at feeke mil satigur paaras keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
1324.e: I was unworthy, utterly useless, rusty slag; meeting with the True Guru, I was transformed by the Philosopher's Stone. ||1||Pause||

1324.g: ਸੁਰਗ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: surag mukat baiku(n)Th sabh baa(n)chheh nit aasaa aas kareejai ||
1324.e: Everyone longs for paradise, liberation and heaven; all place their hopes in them.

1324.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
1324.t: har dharasan ke jan mukat na maa(n)geh mil dharasan tirapat man dheejai ||1||
1324.e: The humble long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they do not ask for liberation. Their minds are satisfied and comforted by His Darshan. ||1||

1324.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਲੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਲਖ ਦਾਗ ਲਗੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: maiaa moh sabal hai bhaaree moh kaalakh dhaag lageejai ||
1324.e: Emotional attachment to Maya is very powerful; this attachment is a black stain which sticks.

1324.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਪੰਕੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
1324.t: mere Thaakur ke jan alipat hai mukate jiau muragaiee pa(n)k na bheejai ||2||
1324.e: The humble servants of my Lord and Master are unattached and liberated. They are like ducks, whose feathers do not get wet. ||2||

1324.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਵੇੜੀ ਕਿਵ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: cha(n)dhan vaas bhuia(n)gam veRee kiv mileeaai cha(n)dhan leejai ||
1324.e: The fragrant sandalwood tree is encircled by snakes; how can anyone get to the sandalwood?

1324.g: ਕਾਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਛੇਦਿ ਛੇਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
1324.t: kaadd khaRag gur giaan karaaraa bikh chhedh chhedh ras peejai ||3||
1324.e: Drawing out the Mighty Sword of the Guru's Spiritual Wisdom, I slaughter and kill the poisonous snakes, and drink in the Sweet Nectar. ||3||

1324.g: ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਸਮਧਾ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਪਲੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਭਸਮ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: aan aan samadhaa bahu keenee pal baisa(n)tar bhasam kareejai ||
1324.e: You may gather wood and stack it in a pile, but in an instant, fire reduces it to ashes.

1324.g: ਮਹਾ ਉਗ੍ਰ ਪਾਪ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਲੂਕੀ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
1324.t: mahaa ugr paap saakat nar keene mil saadhoo lookee dheejai ||4||
1324.e: The faithless cynic gathers the most horrendous sins, but meeting with the Holy Saint, they are placed in the fire. ||4||

1324.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: saadhoo saadh saadh jan neeke jin a(n)tar naam dhareejai ||
1324.e: The Holy, Saintly devotees are sublime and exalted. They enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within.

1324.g: ਪਰਸ ਨਿਪਰਸੁ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਦਿਖੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
1324.t: paras niparas bhe saadhoo jan jan har bhagavaan dhikheejai ||5||
1324.e: By the touch of the Holy and the humble servants of the Lord, the Lord God is seen. ||5||

1324.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੂਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਰਝੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਨੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: saakat soot bahu gurajhee bhariaa kiau kar taan taneejai ||
1324.e: The thread of the faithless cynic is totally knotted and tangled; how can anything be woven with it?

1324.g: ਤੰਤੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
1324.t: ta(n)t soot kichh nikasai naahee saakat sa(n)g na keejai ||6||
1324.e: This thread cannot be woven into yarn; do not associate with those faithless cynics. ||6||

1324.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: satigur saadhasa(n)gat hai neekee mil sa(n)gat raam raveejai ||
1324.e: The True Guru and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are exalted and sublime. Joining the Congregation, meditate on the Lord.

1324.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
1324.t: a(n)tar ratan javehar maanak gur kirapaa te leejai ||7||
1324.e: The gems, jewels and precious stones are deep within; by Guru's Grace, they are found. ||7||

1324.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: meraa Thaakur vaddaa vaddaa hai suaamee ham kiau kar mileh mileejai ||
1324.e: My Lord and Master is Glorious and Great. How can I be united in His Union?

1324.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੨॥
1324.t: naanak mel milaae gur pooraa jan kau pooran dheejai ||8||2||
1324.e: O Nanak, the Perfect Guru unites His humble servant in His Union, and blesses him with perfection. ||8||2||

1324.g: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1324.t: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1324.e: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

1324.g: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: raamaa ram raamo raam raveejai ||
1324.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the All-pervading Lord.

1324.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1324.t: saadhoo saadh saadh jan neeke mil saadhoo har ra(n)g keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
1324.e: The Holy, the humble and Holy, are noble and sublime. Meeting with the Holy, I joyfully love the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1324.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਡੋਲ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh jag hai jetaa man ddolat ddol kareejai ||
1324.e: The minds of all the beings and creatures of the world waver unsteadily.

1324.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਥੰਮਨ ਕਉ ਥੰਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
1324.t: kirapaa kirapaa kar saadh milaavahu jag tha(n)man kau tha(n)m dheejai ||1||
1324.e: Please take pity on them, be merciful to them, and unite them with the Holy; establish this support to support the world. ||1||

1324.g: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਰੁਲੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: basudhaa talai talai sabh uoopar mil saadhoo charan ruleejai ||
1324.e: The earth is beneath us, and yet its dust falls down on all; let yourself be covered by the dust of the feet of the Holy.

1324.g: ਅਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਚਰਨ ਤਲ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
1324.t: at uootam at uootam hovahu sabh sisaT charan tal dheejai ||2||
1324.e: You shall be utterly exalted, the most noble and sublime of all; the whole world will place itself at your feet. ||2||

1324.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਸਿਵ ਨੀਕੀ ਆਨਿ ਪਾਨੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: gurmukh jot bhalee siv neekee aan paanee sakat bhareejai ||
1324.e: The Gurmukhs are blessed with the Divine Light of the Lord; Maya comes to serve them.

1324.g: ਮੈਨਦੰਤ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਚਬਿ ਚਬਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
1324.t: mainadha(n)t nikase gur bachanee saar chab chab har ras peejai ||3||
1324.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, they bite with teeth of wax and chew iron, drinking in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

1324.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: raam naam anugrahu bahu keeaa gur saadhoo purakh mileejai ||
1324.e: The Lord has shown great mercy, and bestowed His Name; I have met with the Holy Guru, the Primal Being.

1324.g: ਗੁਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨ ਕੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
1324.t: gun raam naam bisatheeran ke'ee har sagal bhavan jas dheejai ||4||
1324.e: The Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name have spread out everywhere; the Lord bestows fame all over the world. ||4||

1324.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਜੈ ॥
1324.t: saadhoo saadh saadh man preetam bin dhekhe reh na sakeejai ||
1324.e: The Beloved Lord is within the minds of the Holy, the Holy Saadhus; without seeing Him, they cannot survive.

1324.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਜਲੰ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
1324.t: jiau jal meen jala(n) jal preet hai khin jal bin fooT mareejai ||5||
1324.e: The fish in the water loves only the water. Without water, it bursts and dies in an instant. ||5||

1325.g: ਮਹਾ ਅਭਾਗ ਅਭਾਗ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਨ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: mahaa abhaag abhaag hai jin ke tin saadhoo dhoor na peejai ||
1325.e: Those who have terrible luck and bad fortune do not drink in the water which washes the dust of the feet of the Holy.

1325.g: ਤਿਨਾ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਜਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
1325.t: tinaa tisanaa jalat jalat nahee boojheh dda(n)dd dharam rai kaa dheejai ||6||
1325.e: The burning fire of their desires is not extinguished; they are beaten and punished by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||6||

1325.g: ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਜਗੵ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀਏ ਹਿਵੈ ਗਾਲਿ ਗਾਲਿ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: sabh teerath barat jagaye pu(n)n ke'ee hivai gaal gaal tan chheejai ||
1325.e: You may visit all the sacred shrines, observe fasts and sacred feasts, give generously in charity and waste away the body, melting it in the snow.

1325.g: ਅਤੁਲਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਤੋਲ ਤੁਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
1325.t: atulaa tol raam naam hai gurmat ko pujai na tol tuleejai ||7||
1325.e: The weight of the Lord's Name is unweighable, according to the Guru's Teachings; nothing can equal its weight. ||7||

1325.g: ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੂ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: tav gun braham braham too jaaneh jan naanak saran pareejai ||
1325.e: O God, You alone know Your Glorious Virtues. Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary.

1325.g: ਤੂ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੀਨ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
1325.t: too jal nidh meen ham tere kar kirapaa sa(n)g rakheejai ||8||3||
1325.e: You are the Ocean of water, and I am Your fish. Please be kind, and keep me always with You. ||8||3||

1325.g: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1325.t: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1325.e: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

1325.g: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: raamaa ram raamo pooj kareejai ||
1325.e: I worship and adore the Lord, the All-pervading Lord.

1325.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਉ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1325.t: man tan arap dharau sabh aagai ras gurmat giaan dhiraReejai ||1|| rahaau ||
1325.e: I surrender my mind and body, and place everything before Him; following the Guru's Teachings, spiritual wisdom is implanted within me. ||1||Pause||

1325.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਨਿਤ ਚੁਨਿ ਚੁਨਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: braham naam gun saakh tarovar nit chun chun pooj kareejai ||
1325.e: God's Name is the tree, and His Glorious Virtues are the branches. Picking and gathering up the fruit, I worship Him.

1325.g: ਆਤਮ ਦੇਉ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ ਆਤਮੁ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
1325.t: aatam dheau dheau hai aatam ras laagai pooj kareejai ||1||
1325.e: The soul is divine; divine is the soul. Worship Him with love. ||1||

1325.g: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਿਚਰਿ ਬਿਚਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: bibek budh sabh jag meh niramal bichar bichar ras peejai ||
1325.e: One of keen intellect and precise understanding is immaculate in all this world. In thoughtful consideration, he drinks in the sublime essence.

1325.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
1325.t: gur parasaadh padhaarath paiaa satigur kau ih man dheejai ||2||
1325.e: By Guru's Grace, the treasure is found; dedicate this mind to the True Guru. ||2||

1325.g: ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਤਿ ਹੀਰੋ ਨੀਕੋ ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਬਿਧੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: niramolak at heero neeko heerai heer bidheejai ||
1325.e: Priceless and utterly sublime is the Diamond of the Lord. This Diamond pierces the diamond of the mind.

1325.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਸਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਪਰਖਿ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੩॥
1325.t: man motee saal hai gur sabadhee jit heeraa parakh lieejai ||3||
1325.e: The mind becomes the jeweller, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; it appraises the Diamond of the Lord. ||3||

1325.g: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਊਚੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੀਪ ਪਲਾਸ ਖਾਇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: sa(n)gat sa(n)t sa(n)g lag uooche jiau peep palaas khai leejai ||
1325.e: Attaching oneself to the Society of the Saints, one is exalted and uplifted, as the palaas tree is absorbed by the peepal tree.

1325.g: ਸਭ ਨਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
1325.t: sabh nar meh praanee uootam hovai raam naamai baas baseejai ||4||
1325.e: That mortal being is supreme among all people, who is perfumed by the fragrance of the Lord's Name. ||4||

1325.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਖਾ ਹਰੀ ਜੜੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: niramal niramal karam bahu keene nit saakhaa haree jaReejai ||
1325.e: One who continually acts in goodness and immaculate purity, sprouts green branches in great abundance.

1325.g: ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਹਕਾਰ ਬਾਸੁ ਜਗਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
1325.t: dharam ful fal gur giaan dhiraRaiaa bahakaar baas jag dheejai ||5||
1325.e: The Guru has taught me that Dharmic faith is the flower, and spiritual wisdom is the fruit; this fragrance permeates the world. ||5||

1325.g: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਭ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: ek jot eko man vasiaa sabh braham dhirasaT ik keejai ||
1325.e: The One, the Light of the One, abides within my mind; God, the One, is seen in all.

1325.g: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਏਕੈ ਹੈ ਪਸਰੇ ਸਭ ਚਰਨ ਤਲੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
1325.t: aatam raam sabh ekai hai pasare sabh charan tale sir dheejai ||6||
1325.e: The One Lord, the Supreme Soul, is spread out everywhere; all place their heads beneath His Feet. ||6||

1325.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਕਟੇ ਨਰ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਘਸਿ ਘਸਿ ਨਾਕ ਵਢੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: naam binaa nakaTe nar dhekhahu tin ghas ghas naak vaddeejai ||
1325.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, people look like criminals with their noses cut off; bit by bit, their noses are cut off.

1325.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
1325.t: saakat nar aha(n)kaaree kahe'eeh bin naavai dhirag jeeveejai ||7||
1325.e: The faithless cynics are called egotistical; without the Name, their lives are cursed. ||7||

1325.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੇਗਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: jab lag saas saas man a(n)tar tat begal saran pareejai ||
1325.e: As long as the breath breathes through the mind deep within, hurry and seek God's Sanctuary.

1325.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
1325.t: naanak kirapaa kirapaa kar dhaarahu mai saadhoo charan pakheejai ||8||4||
1325.e: Please shower Your Kind Mercy and take pity upon Nanak, that he may wash the feet of the Holy. ||8||4||

1325.g: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1325.t: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1325.e: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

1325.g: ਰਾਮਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਧੁਵੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: raamaa mai saadhoo charan dhuveejai ||
1325.e: O Lord, I wash the feet of the Holy.

1325.g: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਹਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1325.t: kilabikh dhahan hoh khin a(n)tar mere Thaakur kirapaa keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
1325.e: May my sins be burnt away in an instant; O my Lord and Master, please bless me with Your Mercy. ||1||Pause||

1325.g: ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਦੀਨ ਖਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਅਤਿ ਤਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: ma(n)gat jan dheen khare dhar Thaadde at tarasan kau dhaan dheejai ||
1325.e: The meek and humble beggars stand begging at Your Door. Please be generous and give to those who are yearning.

1325.g: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
1325.t: traeh traeh saran prabh aae mo kau gurmat naam dhiraReejai ||1||
1325.e: Save me, save me, O God - I have come to Your Sanctuary. Please implant the Guru's Teachings, and the Naam within me. ||1||

1325.g: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜੂਝੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: kaam karodh nagar meh sabalaa nit uTh uTh joojh kareejai ||
1325.e: Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the body-village; I rise up to fight the battle against them.

1325.g: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
1325.t: a(n)geekaar karahu rakh levahu gur pooraa kaadd kaddeejai ||2||
1325.e: Please make me Your Own and save me; through the Perfect Guru, I drive them out. ||2||

1325.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਬਲ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਹਿਵ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
1325.t: a(n)tar agan sabal at bikhiaa hiv seetal sabadh gur dheejai ||
1325.e: The powerful fire of corruption is raging violently within; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the ice water which cools and soothes.

1326.g: ਤਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਵੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
1326.t: tan man saa(n)t hoi adhikaiee rog kaaTai sookh saveejai ||3||
1326.e: My mind and body are calm and tranquil; the disease has been cured, and now I sleep in peace. ||3||

1326.g: ਜਿਉ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਸਭ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: jiau sooraj kiran raviaa sarab Thaiee sabh ghaT ghaT raam raveejai ||
1326.e: As the rays of the sun spread out everywhere, the Lord pervades each and every heart.

1326.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
1326.t: saadhoo saadh mile ras paavai tat nij ghar baiThiaa peejai ||4||
1326.e: Meeting the Holy Saint, one drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord; sitting in the home of your own inner being, drink in the essence. ||4||

1326.g: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਚਕਵੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੂਰੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: jan kau preet lagee gur setee jiau chakavee dhekh sooreejai ||
1326.e: The humble being is in love with the Guru, like the chakvi bird which loves to see the sun.

1326.g: ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਭ ਨਿਰਖੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਢੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
1326.t: nirakhat nirakhat rain sabh nirakhee mukh kaaddai a(n)mrit peejai ||5||
1326.e: She watches, and keeps on watching all through the night; and when the sun shows its face, she drinks in the Amrit. ||5||

1326.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੁਆਨ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: saakat suaan kahe'eeh bahu lobhee bahu dhuramat mail bhareejai ||
1326.e: The faithless cynic is said to be very greedy - he is a dog. He is overflowing with the filth and pollution of evil-mindedness.

1326.g: ਆਪਨ ਸੁਆਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
1326.t: aapan suaai kareh bahu baataa tinaa kaa visaahu kiaa keejai ||6||
1326.e: He talks excessively about his own interests. How can he be trusted? ||6||

1326.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: saadhoo saadh saran mil sa(n)gat jit har ras kaadd kaddeejai ||
1326.e: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have found the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

1326.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
1326.t: paraupakaar boleh bahu guneeaa mukh sa(n)t bhagat har dheejai ||7||
1326.e: They do good deeds for others, and speak of the Lord's many Glorious Virtues; please bless me to meet these Saints, these devotees of the Lord. ||7||

1326.g: ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: too agam dhiaal dhiaa pat dhaataa sabh dhiaa dhaar rakh leejai ||
1326.e: You are the Inaccessible Lord, Kind and Compassionate, the Great Giver; please shower us with Your Mercy, and save us.

1326.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੫॥
1326.t: sarab jeea jagajeevan eko naanak pratipaal kareejai ||8||5||
1326.e: You are the Life of all the beings of the world; please cherish and sustain Nanak. ||8||5||

1326.g: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1326.t: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1326.e: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

1326.g: ਰਾਮਾ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: raamaa ham dhaasan dhaas kareejai ||
1326.e: O Lord, please make me the slave of Your slaves.

1326.g: ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਿਵੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1326.t: jab lag saas hoi man a(n)tar saadhoo dhoor piveejai ||1|| rahaau ||
1326.e: As long as there is breath deep within my mind, let me drink in the dust of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

1326.g: ਸੰਕਰੁ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਸੇਖਨਾਗ ਮੁਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਲੋਚੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: sa(n)kar naaradh sekhanaag mun dhoor saadhoo kee locheejai ||
1326.e: Shiva, Naarad, the thousand-headed cobra king and the silent sages long for the dust of the Holy.

1326.g: ਭਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
1326.t: bhavan bhavan pavit hoh sabh jeh saadhoo charan dhareejai ||1||
1326.e: All the worlds and realms where the Holy place their feet are sanctified. ||1||

1326.g: ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਜੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: taj laaj aha(n)kaar sabh tajeeaai mil saadhoo sa(n)g raheejai ||
1326.e: So let go of your shame and renounce all your egotism; join with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and remain there.

1326.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
1326.t: dharam rai kee kaan chukaavai bikh ddubadhaa kaadd kaddeejai ||2||
1326.e: Give up your fear of the Righteous Judge of Dharma, and you shall be lifted up and saved from drowning in the sea of poison. ||2||

1326.g: ਭਰਮਿ ਸੂਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਉਭਿ ਸੁਕ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: bharam sooke bahu ubh suk kahe'eeh mil saadhoo sa(n)g hareejai ||
1326.e: Some are standing, parched and shrivelled up by their doubts; joining the Saadh Sangat, they are rejuvenated.

1326.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਪਲੁ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨਿ ਲਗੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
1326.t: taa te bilam pal ddil na keejai jai saadhoo charan lageejai ||3||
1326.e: So do not delay, even for an instant - go and fall at the feet of the Holy. ||3||

1326.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਰਤਨ ਵਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਸਿ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: raam naam keeratan ratan vath har saadhoo paas rakheejai ||
1326.e: The Kirtan of the Praise of the Lord's Name is a priceless jewel. The Lord has given it for the Holy to keep.

1326.g: ਜੋ ਬਚਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
1326.t: jo bachan gur sat sat kar maanai tis aagai kaadd dhareejai ||4||
1326.e: Whoever accepts and follows the Word of the Guru's Teachings as True - this Jewel is taken out and given to him. ||4||

1326.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢੀ ਬਾਹ ਕੁਕੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: sa(n)tahu sunahu sunahu jan bhaiee gur kaaddee baeh kukeejai ||
1326.e: Listen, O Saints; listen, humble Siblings of Destiny: the Guru raises His Arms and sends out the call.

1326.g: ਜੇ ਆਤਮ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਿਤ ਲੋੜਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਵੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
1326.t: je aatam kau sukh sukh nit loRahu taa(n) satigur saran paveejai ||5||
1326.e: If you long for everlasting peace and comfort for your soul, then enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||5||

1326.g: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕਾ ਤਾਂ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: je vadd bhaag hoi at neekaa taa(n) gurmat naam dhiraReejai ||
1326.e: If you have great good fortune and are very noble, then implant the Guru's Teachings and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within.

1326.g: ਸਭੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
1326.t: sabh maiaa moh bikham jag tareeaai sahaje har ras peejai ||6||
1326.e: Emotional attachment to Maya is totally treacherous; drinking in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, you shall easily, intuitively cross over the world-ocean. ||6||

1326.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਚੈ ਪਚੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: maiaa maiaa ke jo adhikaiee vich maiaa pachai pacheejai ||
1326.e: Those who are totally in love with Maya, Maya, shall rot away in Maya.

1326.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
1326.t: agiaan a(n)dher mahaa pa(n)th bikhaRaa aha(n)kaar bhaar ladh leejai ||7||
1326.e: The path of ignorance and darkness is utterly treacherous; they are loaded down with the crushing load of egotism. ||7||

1326.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਮ ਰਮੁ ਰਮ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
1326.t: naanak raam ram ram ram ram raamai te gat keejai ||
1326.e: O Nanak, chanting the Name of the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, one is emancipated.

1326.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਲੈ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੬॥
1326.t: satigur milai taa naam dhiraRaae raam naamai ralai mileejai ||8||6||
1326.e: Meeting the True Guru, the Naam is implanted within; we are united and blended with the Lord's Name. ||8||6||

1326.g: ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
1326.t: chhakaa 1 ||
1326.e: First Set of Six||

1327.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1327.t: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
1327.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

1327.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
1327.t: raag parabhaatee bibhaas mahalaa pehilaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa ||
1327.e: Raag Parbhaatee Bibhaas, First Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

1327.g: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਰਣਾ ਨਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜ ॥
1327.t: nai terai taranaa nai pat pooj ||
1327.e: Your Name carries us across; Your Name brings respect and worship.

1327.g: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ਮਤਿ ਮਕਸੂਦੁ ॥
1327.t: naau teraa gahanaa mat makasoodh ||
1327.e: Your Name embellishes us; it is the object of the awakened mind.

1327.g: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
1327.t: nai terai naau ma(n)ne sabh koi ||
1327.e: Your Name brings honor to everyone's name.

1327.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
1327.t: vin naavai pat kabahu na hoi ||1||
1327.e: Without Your Name, no one is ever respected. ||1||

1327.g: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਪਾਜੁ ॥
1327.t: avar siaanap sagalee paaj ||
1327.e: All other clever tricks are just for show.

1327.g: ਜੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਤੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1327.t: jai bakhase tai pooraa kaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
1327.e: Whoever the Lord blesses with forgiveness - his affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

1327.g: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਾਉ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
1327.t: naau teraa taan naau dheebaan ||
1327.e: Your Name is my strength; Your Name is my support.

1327.g: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
1327.t: naau teraa lasakar naau sulataan ||
1327.e: Your Name is my army; Your Name is my king.

1327.g: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
1327.t: nai terai maan mahat paravaan ||
1327.e: Your Name brings honor, glory and approval.

1327.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
1327.t: teree nadharee karam pavai neesaan ||2||
1327.e: By Your Grace, one is blessed with the banner and the insignia of Your Mercy. ||2||

1327.g: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਨਾਇ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
1327.t: nai terai sahaj nai saalaeh ||
1327.e: Your Name brings intuitive peace and poise; Your Name brings praise.

1327.g: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
1327.t: naau teraa a(n)mrit bikh uTh jai ||
1327.e: Your Name is the Ambrosial Nectar which cleans out the poison.

1327.g: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
1327.t: nai terai sabh sukh vaseh man aai ||
1327.e: Through Your Name, all peace and comfort comes to abide in the mind.

1327.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
1327.t: bin naavai baadhee jam pur jai ||3||
1327.e: Without the Name, they are bound and gagged, and dragged off to the City of Death. ||3||

1327.g: ਨਾਰੀ ਬੇਰੀ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਦੇਸ ॥
1327.t: naaree beree ghar dhar dhes ||
1327.e: Man is involved with his wife, hearth and home, land and country,

1327.g: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਵੇਸ ॥
1327.t: man keeaa khuseeaa keecheh ves ||
1327.e: the pleasures of the mind and fine clothes;

1327.g: ਜਾਂ ਸਦੇ ਤਾਂ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
1327.t: jaa(n) sadhe taa(n) ddil na pai ||
1327.e: but when the call comes, he cannot delay.

1327.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
1327.t: naanak kooR kooRo hoi jai ||4||1||
1327.e: O Nanak, in the end, the false turn out to be false. ||4||1||

1327.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1327.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1327.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1327.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਲੋਇ ॥
1327.t: teraa naam ratan karam chaanan surat tithai loi ||
1327.e: Your Name is the Jewel, and Your Grace is the Light. In awareness, there is Your Light.

1327.g: ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਅੰਧੀ ਵਾਪਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਲੀਜੈ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
1327.t: a(n)dher a(n)dhee vaaparai sagal leejai khoi ||1||
1327.e: Darkness fills the dark, and then everything is lost. ||1||

1327.g: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
1327.t: eih sa(n)saar sagal bikaar ||
1327.e: This whole world is corrupt.

1327.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1327.t: teraa naam dhaaroo avar naasat karanahaar apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1327.e: Your Name is the only cure; nothing else works, O Infinite Creator Lord. ||1||Pause||

1327.g: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਭਾਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥
1327.t: paataal pureeaa ek bhaar hoveh laakh karoR ||
1327.e: One side of the scale holds tens of thousands, millions of nether regions and realms.

1327.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਤਾ ਪਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਿਰੈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੨॥
1327.t: tere laal keemat taa pavai jaa(n) sirai hoveh hor ||2||
1327.e: O my Beloved, Your Worth could only be estimated if something else could be placed on the other side of the scale. ||2||

1328.g: ਦੂਖਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਸੂਖੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥
1328.t: dhookhaa te sukh uoopajeh sookhee hoveh dhookh ||
1328.e: Out of pain, pleasure is produced, and out of pleasure comes pain.

1328.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ॥੩॥
1328.t: jit mukh too saalaahe'eeh tit mukh kaisee bhookh ||3||
1328.e: That mouth which praises You - what hunger could that mouth ever suffer? ||3||

1328.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ॥
1328.t: naanak moorakh ek too avar bhalaa saisaar ||
1328.e: O Nanak, you alone are foolish; all the rest of the world is good.

1328.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੪॥੨॥
1328.t: jit tan naam na uoopajai se tan hoh khuaar ||4||2||
1328.e: That body in which the Naam does not well up - that body becomes miserable. ||4||2||

1328.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1328.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1328.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1328.g: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਉਚਰੇ ਸੰਕਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1328.t: jai kaaran bedh brahamai uchare sa(n)kar chhoddee maiaa ||
1328.e: For His sake, Brahma uttered the Vedas, and Shiva renounced Maya.

1328.g: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਦੇਵੀ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1328.t: jai kaaran sidh bhe udhaasee dhevee maram na paiaa ||1||
1328.e: For His sake, the Siddhas became hermits and renunciates; even the gods have not realized His Mystery. ||1||

1328.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
1328.t: baabaa man saachaa mukh saachaa kaheeaai tareeaai saachaa hoiee ||
1328.e: O Baba, keep the True Lord in your mind, and utter the Name of the True Lord with your mouth; the True Lord will carry you across.

1328.g: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1328.t: dhusaman dhookh na aavai neRai har mat paavai koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1328.e: Enemies and pain shall not even approach you; only a rare few realize the Wisdom of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1328.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਪਵਣੈ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
1328.t: agan bi(n)b pavanai kee baanee teen naam ke dhaasaa ||
1328.e: Fire, water and air make up the world; these three are the slaves of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1328.g: ਤੇ ਤਸਕਰ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵਹਿ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਕੋਟ ਪੰਚਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
1328.t: te tasakar jo naam na leveh vaaseh koT pa(n)chaasaa ||2||
1328.e: One who does not chant the Naam is a thief, dwelling in the fortress of the five thieves. ||2||

1328.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਰੈ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਫਾਵੈ ॥
1328.t: je ko ek karai cha(n)giaaiee man chit bahut bafaavai ||
1328.e: If someone does a good deed for someone else, he totally puffs himself up in his conscious mind.

1328.g: ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਤੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
1328.t: ete gun eteeaa cha(n)giaaieeaa dhei na pachhotaavai ||3||
1328.e: The Lord bestows so many virtues and so much goodness; He does not ever regret it. ||3||

1328.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
1328.t: tudh saalaahan tin dhan palai naanak kaa dhan soiee ||
1328.e: Those who praise You gather the wealth in their laps; this is Nanak's wealth.

1328.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ਕਹੈ ਓਨਾ ਕਉ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
1328.t: je ko jeeau kahai onaa kau jam kee talab na hoiee ||4||3||
1328.e: Whoever shows respect to them is not summoned by the Messenger of Death. ||4||3||

1328.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1328.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1328.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1328.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥
1328.t: jaa kai roop naahee jaat naahee naahee mukh maasaa ||
1328.e: One who has no beauty, no social status, no mouth, no flesh

1328.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
1328.t: satigur mile nira(n)jan paiaa terai naam hai nivaasaa ||1||
1328.e: - meeting with the True Guru, he finds the Immaculate Lord, and dwells in Your Name. ||1||

1328.g: ਅਉਧੂ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1328.t: aaudhoo sahaje tat beechaar ||
1328.e: O detached Yogi, contemplate the essence of reality,

1328.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੁ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1328.t: jaa te fir na aavahu saisaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1328.e: and you shall never again come to be born into the world. ||1||Pause||

1328.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਚਿ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
1328.t: jaa kai karam naahee dharam naahee naahee such maalaa ||
1328.e: One who does not have good karma or Dharmic faith, sacred rosary or mala

1328.g: ਸਿਵ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੰਨਹੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
1328.t: siv jot ka(n)nahu budh paiee satiguroo rakhavaalaa ||2||
1328.e: - through the Light of God, wisdom is bestowed; the True Guru is our Protector. ||2||

1328.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਕਬਾਈ ॥
1328.t: jaa kai barat naahee nem naahee naahee bakabaiee ||
1328.e: One who does not observe any fasts, make religious vows or chant

1328.g: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
1328.t: gat avagat kee chi(n)t naahee satiguroo furamaiee ||3||
1328.e: - he does not have to worry about good luck or bad, if he obeys the Command of the True Guru. ||3||

1328.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥
1328.t: jaa kai aas naahee niraas naahee chit surat samajhaiee ||
1328.e: One who is not hopeful, nor hopeless, who has trained his intuitive consciousness

1328.g: ਤੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
1328.t: ta(n)t kau param ta(n)t miliaa naanakaa budh paiee ||4||4||
1328.e: - his being blends with the Supreme Being. O Nanak, his awareness is awakened. ||4||4||

1328.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1328.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1328.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1328.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
1328.t: taa kaa kahiaa dhar paravaan ||
1328.e: What he says is approved in the Court of the Lord.

1328.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
1328.t: bikh a(n)mrit dhui sam kar jaan ||1||
1328.e: He looks upon poison and nectar as one and the same. ||1||

1328.g: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਰਬੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
1328.t: kiaa kaheeaai sarabe rahiaa samai ||
1328.e: What can I say? You are permeating and pervading all.

1328.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1328.t: jo kichh varatai sabh teree rajai ||1|| rahaau ||
1328.e: Whatever happens, is all by Your Will. ||1||Pause||

1328.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
1328.t: pragaTee jot chookaa abhimaan ||
1328.e: The Divine Light shines radiantly, and egotistical pride is dispelled.

1328.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
1328.t: satigur dheeaa a(n)mirat naam ||2||
1328.e: The True Guru bestows the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

1328.g: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
1328.t: kal meh aaiaa so jan jaan ||
1328.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, one's birth is approved,

1328.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
1328.t: saachee dharageh paavai maan ||3||
1328.e: if one is honored in the True Court. ||3||

1328.g: ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਅਕਥ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
1328.t: kahanaa sunanaa akath ghar jai ||
1328.e: Speaking and listening, one goes to the Celestial Home of the Indescribable Lord.

1328.g: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
1328.t: kathanee badhanee naanak jal jai ||4||5||
1328.e: Mere words of mouth, O Nanak, are burnt away. ||4||5||

1328.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1328.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1328.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1328.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਹੇ ॥
1328.t: a(n)mrit neer giaan man majan aThasaTh teerath sa(n)g gahe ||
1328.e: One who bathes in the Ambrosial Water of spiritual wisdom takes with him the virtues of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

1328.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੋੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
1328.t: gur upadhes javaahar maanak seve sikh suo khoj lahai ||1||
1328.e: The Guru's Teachings are the gems and jewels; the Sikh who serves Him searches and finds them. ||1||

1328.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
1328.t: gur samaan teerath nahee koi ||
1328.e: There is no sacred shrine equal to the Guru.

1328.g: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1328.t: sar sa(n)tokh taas gur hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
1328.e: The Guru encompasses the ocean of contentment. ||1||Pause||

1329.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਦਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੈ ॥
1329.t: gur dhareeaau sadhaa jal niramal miliaa dhuramat mail harai ||
1329.e: The Guru is the River, from which the Pure Water is obtained forever; it washes away the filth and pollution of evil-mindedness.

1329.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਦੇਵ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
1329.t: satigur paiaai pooraa naavan pasoo paretahu dhev karai ||2||
1329.e: Finding the True Guru, the perfect cleansing bath is obtained, which transforms even beasts and ghosts into gods. ||2||

1329.g: ਰਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਲ ਹੀਅਲੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
1329.t: rataa sach naam tal heeal so gur paramal kaheeaai ||
1329.e: He is said to be the Guru, with the scent of sandalwood, who is imbued with the True Name to the bottom of His Heart.

1329.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਸਉਰੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
1329.t: jaa kee vaas banaasapat saurai taas charan liv raheeaai ||3||
1329.e: By His Fragrance, the world of vegetation is perfumed. Lovingly focus yourself on His Feet. ||3||

1329.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
1329.t: gurmukh jeea praan upajeh gurmukh siv ghar jaieeaai ||
1329.e: The life of the soul wells up for the Gurmukh; the Gurmukh goes to the House of God.

1329.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੬॥
1329.t: gurmukh naanak sach samaieeaai gurmukh nij padh paieeaai ||4||6||
1329.e: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, merges in the True One; the Gurmukh attains the exalted state of the self. ||4||6||

1329.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1329.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1329.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1329.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
1329.t: gur parasaadhee vidhiaa veechaarai paR paR paavai maan ||
1329.e: By Guru's Grace, contemplate spiritual knowledge; read it and study it, and you shall be honored.

1329.g: ਆਪਾ ਮਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
1329.t: aapaa madhe aap paragaasiaa paiaa a(n)mrit naam ||1||
1329.e: Within the self, the self is revealed, when one is blessed with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

1329.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ ॥
1329.t: karataa too meraa jajamaan ||
1329.e: O Creator Lord, You alone are my Benefactor.

1329.g: ਇਕ ਦਖਿਣਾ ਹਉ ਤੈ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1329.t: eik dhakhinaa hau tai peh maagau dheh aapanaa naam ||1|| rahaau ||
1329.e: I beg for only one blessing from You: please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

1329.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
1329.t: pa(n)ch tasakar dhaavat raakhe chookaa man abhimaan ||
1329.e: The five wandering thieves are captured and held, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

1329.g: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
1329.t: dhisaT bikaaree dhuramat bhaagee aaisaa braham giaan ||2||
1329.e: Visions of corruption, vice and evil-mindedness run away. Such is the spiritual wisdom of God. ||2||

1329.g: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਚਾਵਲ ਦਇਆ ਕਣਕ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਪਾਤੀ ਧਾਨੁ ॥
1329.t: jat sat chaaval dhiaa kanak kar praapat paatee dhaan ||
1329.e: Please bless me with the rice of truth and self-restraint, the wheat of compassion, and the leaf-plate of meditation.

1329.g: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਘੀਉ ਕਰਿ ਐਸਾ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
1329.t: dhoodh karam sa(n)tokh gheeau kar aaisaa maa(n)gau dhaan ||3||
1329.e: Bless me with the milk of good karma, and the clarified butter, the ghee, of compassion. Such are the gifts I beg of You, Lord. ||3||

1329.g: ਖਿਮਾ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਊ ਲਵੇਰੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਛਰਾ ਖੀਰੁ ਪੀਐ ॥
1329.t: khimaa dheeraj kar guoo laveree sahaje bachharaa kheer peeaai ||
1329.e: Let forgiveness and patience be my milk-cows, and let the calf of my mind intuitively drink in this milk.

1329.g: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਰਮ ਕਾ ਕਪੜਾ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੪॥੭॥
1329.t: sifat saram kaa kapaRaa maa(n)gau har gun naanak ravat rahai ||4||7||
1329.e: I beg for the clothes of modesty and the Lord's Praise; Nanak chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||7||

1329.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1329.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1329.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1329.g: ਆਵਤੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਾਵਤੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
1329.t: aavat kinai na raakhiaa jaavat kiau raakhiaa jai ||
1329.e: No one can hold anyone back from coming; how could anyone hold anyone back from going?

1329.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਂ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
1329.t: jis te hoaa soiee par jaanai jaa(n) us hee maeh samai ||1||
1329.e: He alone thoroughly understands this, from whom all beings come; all are merged and immersed in Him. ||1||

1329.g: ਤੂਹੈ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
1329.t: toohai hai vaahu teree rajai ||
1329.e: Waaho! - You are Great, and Wondrous is Your Will.

1329.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਹੋਇਬਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1329.t: jo kichh kareh soiee par hoibaa avar na karanaa jai ||1|| rahaau ||
1329.e: Whatever You do, surely comes to pass. Nothing else can happen. ||1||Pause||

1329.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਹਟ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਟਿੰਡ ਲਗਤ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਸਖਨੀ ਹੋਰ ਫੇਰ ਭਰੀਅਤ ਹੈ ॥
1329.t: jaise harahaT kee maalaa Ti(n)dd lagat hai ik sakhanee hor fer bhareeat hai ||
1329.e: The buckets on the chain of the Persian wheel rotate; one empties out to fill another.

1329.g: ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਉਸ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
1329.t: taiso hee ih khel khasam kaa jiau us kee vaddiaaiee ||2||
1329.e: This is just like the Play of our Lord and Master; such is His Glorious Greatness. ||2||

1329.g: ਸੁਰਤੀ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਿ ਕੈ ਉਲਟੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ॥
1329.t: suratee kai maarag chal kai ulaTee nadhar pragaasee ||
1329.e: Following the path of intuitive awareness, one turns away from the world, and one's vision is enlightened.

1329.g: ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
1329.t: man veechaar dhekh braham giaanee kaun girahee kaun udhaasee ||3||
1329.e: Contemplate this in your mind, and see, O spiritual teacher. Who is the householder, and who is the renunciate? ||3||

1329.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸਉਪਿ ਕੈ ਏਹੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
1329.t: jis kee aasaa tis hee saup kai eh rahiaa nirabaan ||
1329.e: Hope comes from the Lord; surrendering to Him, we remain in the state of nirvaanaa.

1329.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੮॥
1329.t: jis te hoaa soiee kar maaniaa naanak girahee udhaasee so paravaan ||4||8||
1329.e: We come from Him; surrendering to Him, O Nanak, one is approved as a householder, and a renunciate. ||4||8||

1329.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1329.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1329.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1329.g: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
1329.t: dhisaT bikaaree ba(n)dhan baa(n)dhai hau tis kai bal jaiee ||
1329.e: I am a sacrifice to that one who binds in bondage his evil and corrupted gaze.

1329.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
1329.t: paap pu(n)n kee saar na jaanai bhoolaa firai ajaiee ||1||
1329.e: One who does not know the difference between vice and virtue wanders around uselessly. ||1||

1329.g: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
1329.t: bolahu sach naam karataar ||
1329.e: Speak the True Name of the Creator Lord.

1329.g: ਫੁਨਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1329.t: fun bahuR na aavan vaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1329.e: Then, you shall never again have to come into this world. ||1||Pause||

1329.g: ਊਚਾ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
1329.t: uoochaa te fun neech karat hai neech karai sulataan ||
1329.e: The Creator transforms the high into the low, and makes the lowly into kings.

1329.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਗਿ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
1329.t: jinee jaan sujaaniaa jag te poore paravaan ||2||
1329.e: Those who know the All-knowing Lord are approved and certified as perfect in this world. ||2||

1329.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਣ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭੂਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
1329.t: taa kau samajhaavan jaieeaai je ko bhoolaa hoiee ||
1329.e: If anyone is mistaken and fooled, you should go to instruct him.

1330.g: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
1330.t: aape khel kare sabh karataa aaisaa boojhai koiee ||3||
1330.e: The Creator Himself plays all the games; only a few understand this. ||3||

1330.g: ਨਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਦੁਨੀ ਪਰੀਤਾ ॥
1330.t: naau prabhaatai sabadh dhiaaieeaai chhoddahu dhunee pareetaa ||
1330.e: Meditate on the Name, and the Word of the Shabad, in the early hours before dawn; leave your worldly entanglements behind.

1330.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਜਗਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੯॥
1330.t: pranavat naanak dhaasan dhaasaa jag haariaa tin jeetaa ||4||9||
1330.e: Prays Nanak, the slave of God's slaves: the world loses, and he wins. ||4||9||
Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1330.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ॥
1330.t: man maiaa man dhaiaa man pa(n)khee aakaas ||
1330.e: The mind is Maya, the mind is a chaser; the mind is a bird flying across the sky.

1330.g: ਤਸਕਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
1330.t: tasakar sabadh nivaariaa nagar vuThaa saabaas ||
1330.e: The thieves are overpowered by the Shabad, and then the body-village prospers and celebrates.

1330.g: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
1330.t: jaa too raakheh raakh laih saabat hovai raas ||1||
1330.e: Lord, when You save someone, he is saved; his capital is safe and sound. ||1||
Such is my Treasure, the Jewel of the Naam;

1330.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਲਗਉ ਪਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1330.t: gurmat dheh lagau pag terai ||1|| rahaau ||
1330.e: please bless me with the Guru's Teachings, so that I may fall at Your Feet. ||1||Pause||

1330.g: ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਭੋਗੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
1330.t: man jogee man bhogeeaa man moorakh gaavaar ||
1330.e: The mind is a Yogi, the mind is a pleasure-seeker; the mind is foolish and ignorant.

1330.g: ਮਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਗਤਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
1330.t: man dhaataa man ma(n)gataa man sir gur karataar ||
1330.e: The mind is the giver, the mind is the beggar; the mind is the Great Guru, the Creator.

1330.g: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
1330.t: pa(n)ch maar sukh paiaa aaisaa braham veechaar ||2||
1330.e: The five thieves are conquered, and peace is attained; such is the contemplative wisdom of God. ||2||

1330.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
1330.t: ghaT ghaT ek vakhaaneeaai kahau na dhekhiaa jai ||
1330.e: The One Lord is said to be in each and every heart, but no one can see Him.

1330.g: ਖੋਟੋ ਪੂਠੋ ਰਾਲੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
1330.t: khoTo pooTho raaleeaai bin naavai pat jai ||
1330.e: The false are cast upside-down into the womb of reincarnation; without the Name, they lose their honor.

1330.g: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
1330.t: jaa too meleh taa mil rahaa(n) jaa(n) teree hoi rajai ||3||
1330.e: Those whom You unite, remain united, if it is Your Will. ||3||

1330.g: ਜਾਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹ ਪੂਛੀਐ ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਇ ॥
1330.t: jaat janam neh poochheeaai sach ghar leh batai ||
1330.e: God does not ask about social class or birth; you must find your true home.

1330.g: ਸਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
1330.t: saa jaat saa pat hai jehe karam kamai ||
1330.e: That is your social class and that is your status - the karma of what you have done.

1330.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
1330.t: janam maran dhukh kaaTeeaai naanak chhooTas nai ||4||10||
1330.e: The pains of death and rebirth are eradicated; O Nanak, salvation is in the Lord's Name. ||4||10||
Prabhaatee, First Mehla:
He is awake, and even happy, but he is being plundered - he is blind!
The noose is around his neck, and yet, his head is busy with worldly affairs.
In hope, he comes and in desire, he leaves.
The strings of his life are all tangled up; he is utterly helpless. ||1||
The Lord of Awareness, the Lord of Life is awake and aware.
He is the Ocean of peace, the Treasure of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

1330.g: ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਭੋਂਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
1330.t: kahio na boojhai a(n)dh na soojhai bho(n)ddee kaar kamaiee ||
1330.e: He does not understand what he is told; he is blind - he does not see, and so he does his evil deeds.

1330.g: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
1330.t: aape preet prem paramesur karamee milai vaddaiee ||2||
1330.e: The Transcendent Lord Himself showers His Love and Affection; by His Grace, He bestows glorious greatness. ||2||

1330.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਘਟਾਈ ॥
1330.t: dhin dhin aavai til til chheejai maiaa moh ghaTaiee ||
1330.e: With the coming of each and every day, his life is wearing away, bit by bit; but still, his heart is attached to Maya.

1330.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਡੋ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਬ ਲਗ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
1330.t: bin gur booddo Thaur na paavai jab lag dhoojee raiee ||3||
1330.e: Without the Guru, he is drowned, and finds no place of rest, as long as he is caught in duality. ||3||

1330.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
1330.t: ahinis jeeaa dhekh sam(h)aalai sukh dhukh purab kamaiee ||
1330.e: Day and night, God watches over and takes care of His living beings; they receive pleasure and pain according to their past actions.

1330.g: ਕਰਮਹੀਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
1330.t: karamaheen sach bheekhiaa maa(n)gai naanak milai vaddaiee ||4||11||
1330.e: Nanak, the unfortunate one, begs for the charity of Truth; please bless him with this glory. ||4||11||
Prabhaatee, First Mehla:
If I remain silent, the world calls me a fool.
If I talk too much, I miss out on Your Love.
My mistakes and faults will be judged in Your Court.
Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can I maintain good conduct? ||1||
Such is the falsehood which is plundering the world.
The slanderer slanders me, but even so, I love him. ||1||Pause||
He alone knows the way, who has been slandered.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is stamped with the Lord's Insignia in His Court.
He realizes the Naam, the Cause of causes, deep within himself.

1330.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
1330.t: jis no nadhar kare soiee bidh jaanai ||2||
1330.e: He alone knows the way, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||2||
I am filthy and polluted; the True Lord is Immaculate and Sublime.
Calling oneself sublime, one does not become exalted.
The self-willed manmukh openly eats the great poison.
But one who becomes Gurmukh is absorbed in the Name. ||3||
I am blind, deaf, foolish and ignorant,

1331.e: the lowest of the low, the worst of the worst.
I am poor, but I have the Wealth of Your Name, O my Beloved.

1331.g: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
1331.t: eih dhan saar hor bikhiaa chhaar ||4||
1331.e: This is the most excellent wealth; all else is poison and ashes. ||4||
I pay no attention to slander and praise; I contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
I celebrate the One who blesses me with His Bounty.
Whomever You forgive, O Lord, is blessed with status and honor.
Says Nanak, I speak as He causes me to speak. ||5||12||
Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1331.g: ਖਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ਪੈਧੈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਣਿ ॥
1331.t: khaiaa mail vadhaiaa paidhai ghar kee haan ||
1331.e: Eating too much, one's filth only increases; wearing fancy clothes, one's home is disgraced.

1331.g: ਬਕਿ ਬਕਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
1331.t: bak bak vaadh chalaiaa bin naavai bikh jaan ||1||
1331.e: Talking too much, one only starts arguments. Without the Name, everything is poison - know this well. ||1||

1331.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਐਸਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਜਾਲਿ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਸਿਆ ॥
1331.t: baabaa aaisaa bikham jaal man vaasiaa ||
1331.e: O Baba, such is the treacherous trap which has caught my mind;
riding out the waves of the storm, it will be enlightened by intuitive wisdom. ||1||Pause||

1331.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
1331.t: bikh khaanaa bikh bolanaa bikh kee kaar kamai ||
1331.e: They eat poison, speak poison and do poisonous deeds.

1331.g: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
1331.t: jam dhar baadhe maare'eh chhooTas saachai nai ||2||
1331.e: Bound and gagged at Death's door, they are punished; they can be saved only through the True Name. ||2||

1331.g: ਜਿਵ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਵ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਕੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
1331.t: jiv aaiaa tiv jaisee keeaa likh lai jai ||
1331.e: As they come, they go. Their actions are recorded, and go along with them.

1331.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
1331.t: manmukh mool gavaiaa dharageh milai sajai ||3||
1331.e: The self-willed manmukh loses his capital, and is punished in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

1331.g: ਜਗੁ ਖੋਟੌ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੌ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀਂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1331.t: jag khoTau sach niramalau gur sabadhee(n) veechaar ||
1331.e: The world is false and polluted; only the True One is Pure. Contemplate Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1331.g: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
1331.t: te nar virale jaane'eeh jin a(n)tar giaan muraar ||4||
1331.e: Those who have God's spiritual wisdom within, are known to be very rare. ||4||

1331.g: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਨੀਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਅਮਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
1331.t: ajar jarai neejhar jharai amar ana(n)dh saroop ||
1331.e: They endure the unendurable, and the Nectar of the Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss, trickles into them continuously.

1331.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਲ ਕੌ ਮੀਨੁ ਸੈ ਥੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
1331.t: naanak jal kau meen sai the bhaavai raakhahu preet ||5||13||
1331.e: O Nanak, the fish is in love with the water; if it pleases You, Lord, please enshrine such love within me. ||5||13||
Prabhaatee, First Mehla:
Songs, sounds, pleasures and clever tricks;
joy, love and the power to command;
fine clothes and food - these have no place in one's consciousness.
True intuitive peace and poise rest in the Naam. ||1||
What do I know about what God does?

1331.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਤਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1331.t: naam binaa tan kichh na sukhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
1331.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing makes my body feel good. ||1||Pause||
Yoga, thrills, delicious flavors and ecstasy;
wisdom, truth and love all come from devotion to the Lord of the Universe.
My own occupation is to work to praise the Lord.
Deep within, I dwell on the Lord of the sun and the moon. ||2||

1331.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
1331.t: priau priau preet prem ur dhaaree ||
1331.e: I have lovingly enshrined the love of my Beloved within my heart.
My Husband Lord, the Lord of the World, is the Master of the meek and the poor.
Night and day, the Naam is my giving in charity and fasting.
The waves have subsided, contemplating the essence of reality. ||3||
What power do I have to speak the Unspoken?
I worship You with devotion; You inspire me to do so.
You dwell deep within; my egotism is dispelled.
So whom should I serve? There is no other than You. ||4||

1331.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
1331.t: gur kaa sabadh mahaa ras meeThaa ||
1331.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is utterly sweet and sublime.
Such is the Ambrosial Nectar I see deep within.
Those who taste this, attain the state of perfection.
O Nanak, they are satisfied, and their bodies are at peace. ||5||14||
Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1331.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਂਗਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
1331.t: a(n)tar dhekh sabadh man maaniaa avar na raa(n)ganahaaraa ||
1331.e: Deep within, I see the Shabad, the Word of God; my mind is pleased and appeased. Nothing else can touch and imbue me.

1331.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
1331.t: ahinis jeeaa dhekh samaale tis hee kee sarakaaraa ||1||
1331.e: Day and night, God watches over and cares for His beings and creatures; He is the Ruler of all. ||1||

1331.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਂਗਿ ਘਣੌ ਅਤਿ ਰੂੜੌ ॥
1331.t: meraa prabh raa(n)g ghanau at rooRau ||
1331.e: My God is dyed in the most beautiful and glorious color.

1331.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਰਸ ਲਾਲ ਸਗੂੜੌ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1331.t: dheen dhiaal preetam manmohan at ras laal sagooRau ||1|| rahaau ||
1331.e: Merciful to the meek and the poor, my Beloved is the Enticer of the mind; He is so very sweet, imbued with the deep crimson color of His Love. ||1||Pause||

1331.g: ਊਪਰਿ ਕੂਪੁ ਗਗਨ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1331.t: uoopar koop gagan panihaaree a(n)mrit peevanahaaraa ||
1331.e: The Well is high up in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Nectar flows, and I drink it in.

1331.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
1331.t: jis kee rachanaa so bidh jaanai gurmukh giaan veechaaraa ||2||
1331.e: The creation is His; He alone knows its ways and means. The Gurmukh contemplates spiritual wisdom. ||2||

1332.g: ਪਸਰੀ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਸਿ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
1332.t: pasaree kiran ras kamal bigaase sas ghar soor samaiaa ||
1332.e: The rays of light spread out, and the heart-lotus joyfully blossoms forth; the sun enters into the house of the moon.

1332.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਧੁੰਸਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1332.t: kaal bidhu(n)s manasaa man maaree gur prasaadh prabh paiaa ||3||
1332.e: I have conquered death; the desires of the mind are destroyed. By Guru's Grace, I have found God. ||3||

1332.g: ਅਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1332.t: at ras ra(n)g chaloolai raatee dhoojaa ra(n)g na koiee ||
1332.e: I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love. I am not colored by any other color.

1332.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਾਏ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
1332.t: naanak rasan rasaae raate rav rahiaa prabh soiee ||4||15||
1332.e: O Nanak, my tongue is saturated with the taste of God, who is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||15||

1332.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1332.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1332.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1332.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ ਖਪਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਚਹੁ ਛਿਅ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
1332.t: baareh meh raaval khap jaaveh chahu chhia meh sa(n)niaasee ||
1332.e: The Yogis are divided into twelve schools, the Sannyaasees into ten.

1332.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਸਿਰਖੂਥੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
1332.t: jogee kaapaReeaa sirakhoothe bin sabadhai gal faasee ||1||
1332.e: The Yogis and those wearing religious robes, and the Jains with their all hair plucked out - without the Word of the Shabad, the noose is around their necks. ||1||

1332.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
1332.t: sabadh rate poore bairaagee ||
1332.e: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are the perfectly detached renunciates.

1332.g: ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਚੀ ਏਕ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1332.t: aauhaTh hasat meh bheekhiaa jaachee ek bhai liv laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
1332.e: They beg to receive charity in the hands of their hearts, embracing love and affection for the One. ||1||Pause||

1332.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਵਾਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
1332.t: brahaman vaadh paReh kar kiriaa karanee karam karaae ||
1332.e: The Brahmins study and argue about the scriptures; they perform ceremonial rituals, and lead others in these rituals.

1332.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
1332.t: bin boojhe kichh soojhai naahee manmukh vichhuR dhukh paae ||2||
1332.e: Without true understanding, those self-willed manmukhs understand nothing. Separated from God, they suffer in pain. ||2||

1332.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਚਾਚਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
1332.t: sabadh mile se soochaachaaree saachee dharageh maane ||
1332.e: Those who receive the Shabad are sanctified and pure; they are approved in the True Court.

1332.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
1332.t: anadhin naam ratan liv laage jug jug saach samaane ||3||
1332.e: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the Naam; throughout the ages, they are merged in the True One. ||3||

1332.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
1332.t: sagale karam dharam such sa(n)jam jap tap teerath sabadh vase ||
1332.e: Good deeds, righteousness and Dharmic faith, purification, austere self-discipline, chanting, intense meditation and pilgrimages to sacred shrines - all these abide in the Shabad.

1332.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਦੂਖ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਕਾਲ ਨਸੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
1332.t: naanak satigur milai milaiaa dhookh paraachhat kaal nase ||4||16||
1332.e: O Nanak, united in union with the True Guru, suffering, sin and death run away. ||4||16||

1332.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1332.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1332.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1332.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
1332.t: sa(n)taa kee ren saadh jan sa(n)gat har keerat tar taaree ||
1332.e: The dust of the feet of the Saints, the Company of the Holy, and the Praises of the Lord carry us across to the other side.

1332.g: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
1332.t: kahaa karai bapuraa jam ddarapai gurmukh ridhai muraaree ||1||
1332.e: What can the wretched, terrified Messenger of Death do to the Gurmukhs? The Lord abides in their hearts. ||1||

1332.g: ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
1332.t: jal jaau jeevan naam binaa ||
1332.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life might just as well be burnt down.

1332.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1332.t: har jap jaap japau japamaalee gurmukh aavai saadh manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1332.e: The Gurmukh chants and meditates on the Lord, chanting the chant on the mala; the Flavor of the Lord comes into the mind. ||1||Pause||

1332.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
1332.t: gur upadhes saach sukh jaa kau kiaa tis upamaa kaheeaai ||
1332.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find true peace - how can I even describe the glory of such a person?

1332.g: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਖੋਜਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
1332.t: laal javehar ratan padhaarath khojat gurmukh laheeaai ||2||
1332.e: The Gurmukh seeks and finds the gems and jewels, diamonds, rubies and treasures. ||2||

1332.g: ਚੀਨੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚੌ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
1332.t: cheenai giaan dhiaan dhan saachau ek sabadh liv laavai ||
1332.e: So center yourself on the treasures of spiritual wisdom and meditation; remain lovingly attuned to the One True Lord, and the Word of His Shabad.

1332.g: ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬੁ ਨਿਰਹਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
1332.t: niraala(n)b nirahaar nihakeval nirabhau taaRee laavai ||3||
1332.e: Remain absorbed in the Primal State of the Fearless, Immaculate, Independent, Self-sufficient Lord. ||3||

1332.g: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਉਲਟੀ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥
1332.t: sair sapat bhare jal niramal ulaTee naav taraavai ||
1332.e: The seven seas are overflowing with the Immaculate Water; the inverted boat floats across.

1332.g: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤੌ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
1332.t: baahar jaatau Thaak rahaavai gurmukh sahaj samaavai ||4||
1332.e: The mind which wandered in external distractions is restrained and held in check; the Gurmukh is intuitively absorbed in God. ||4||

1332.g: ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
1332.t: so girahee so dhaas udhaasee jin gurmukh aap pachhaaniaa ||
1332.e: He is a householder, he is a renunciate and God's slave, who, as Gurmukh, realizes his own self.

1332.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੫॥੧੭॥
1332.t: naanak kahai avar nahee dhoojaa saach sabadh man maaniaa ||5||17||
1332.e: Says Nanak, his mind is pleased and appeased by the True Word of the Shabad; there is no other at all. ||5||17||

1332.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ
1332.t: raag prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa chaupadhe
1332.e: Raag Prabhaatee, Third Mehla, Chau-Padhay:

1332.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1332.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1332.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1332.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
1332.t: gurmukh viralaa koiee boojhai sabadhe rahiaa samaiee ||
1332.e: Those who become Gurmukh and understand are very rare; God is permeating and pervading through the Word of His Shabad.

1332.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
1332.t: naam rate sadhaa sukh paavai saach rahai liv laiee ||1||
1332.e: Those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find everlasting peace; they remain lovingly attuned to the True One. ||1||

1333.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
1333.t: har har naam japahu jan bhaiee ||
1333.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O Siblings of Destiny.

1333.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1333.t: gur prasaadh man asathir hovai anadhin har ras rahiaa aghaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1333.e: By Guru's Grace, the mind becomes steady and stable; night and day, it remains satisfied with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1333.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
1333.t: anadhin bhagat karahu dhin raatee is jug kaa laahaa bhaiee ||
1333.e: Night and day, perform devotional worship service to the Lord, day and night; this is the profit to be obtained in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Siblings of Destiny.

1333.g: ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
1333.t: sadhaa jan niramal mail na laagai sach naam chit laiee ||2||
1333.e: The humble beings are forever immaculate; no filth ever sticks to them. They focus their consciousness on the True Name. ||2||

1333.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1333.t: sukh seegaar satiguroo dhikhaiaa naam vaddee vaddiaaiee ||
1333.e: The True Guru has revealed the ornamentation of peace; the Glorious Greatness of the Naam is Great!

1333.g: ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ਕਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
1333.t: akhuT bha(n)ddaar bhare kadhe toT na aavai sadhaa har sevahu bhaiee ||3||
1333.e: The Inexhaustible Treasures are overflowing; they are never exhausted. So serve the Lord forever, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

1333.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
1333.t: aape karataa jis no dhevai tis vasai man aaiee ||
1333.e: The Creator comes to abide in the minds of those whom He Himself has blessed.

1333.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
1333.t: naanak naam dhiaai sadhaa too satigur dheeaa dhikhaiee ||4||1||
1333.e: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Naam, which the True Guru has revealed. ||4||1||

1333.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1333.t: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
1333.e: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

1333.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
1333.t: niraguneeaare kau bakhas lai suaamee aape laih milaiee ||
1333.e: I am unworthy; please forgive me and bless me, O my Lord and Master, and unite me with Yourself.

1333.g: ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
1333.t: too bia(n)t teraa a(n)t na paiaa sabadhe dheh bujhaiee ||1||
1333.e: You are Endless; no one can find Your limits. Through the Word of Your Shabad, You bestow understanding. ||1||

1333.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
1333.t: har jeeau tudh viTahu bal jaiee ||
1333.e: O Dear Lord, I am a sacrifice to You.

1333.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1333.t: tan man arapee tudh aagai raakhau sadhaa rahaa(n) saranaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1333.e: I dedicate my mind and body and place them in offering before You; I shall remain in Your Sanctuary forever. ||1||Pause||

1333.g: ਆਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1333.t: aapane bhaane vich sadhaa rakh suaamee har naamo dheh vaddiaaiee ||
1333.e: Please keep me forever under Your Will, O my Lord and Master; please bless me with the Glorious Greatness of Your Name.

1333.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭਾਣਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
1333.t: poore gur te bhaanaa jaapai anadhin sahaj samaiee ||2||
1333.e: Through the Perfect Guru, God's Will is revealed; night and day, remain absorbed in peace and poise. ||2||

1333.g: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
1333.t: terai bhaanai bhagat je tudh bhaavai aape bakhas milaiee ||
1333.e: Those devotees who accept Your Will are pleasing to You, Lord; You Yourself forgive them, and unite them with Yourself.

1333.g: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
1333.t: terai bhaanai sadhaa sukh paiaa gur tirasanaa agan bujhaiee ||3||
1333.e: Accepting Your Will, I have found everlasting peace; the Guru has extinguished the fire of desire. ||3||

1333.g: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
1333.t: jo too kareh su hovai karate avar na karanaa jaiee ||
1333.e: Whatever You do comes to pass, O Creator; nothing else can be done.

1333.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
1333.t: naanak naavai jevadd avar na dhaataa poore gur te paiee ||4||2||
1333.e: O Nanak, nothing is as great as the Blessing of the Name; it is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||4||2||

1333.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1333.t: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
1333.e: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

1333.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
1333.t: gurmukh har saalaahiaa ji(n)naa tin salaeh har jaataa ||
1333.e: The Gurmukhs praise the Lord; praising the Lord, they know Him.

1333.g: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
1333.t: vichahu bharam giaa hai dhoojaa gur kai sabadh pachhaataa ||1||
1333.e: Doubt and duality are gone from within; they realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

1333.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
1333.t: har jeeau too meraa ik soiee ||
1333.e: O Dear Lord, You are my One and Only.

1333.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1333.t: tudh japee tudhai saalaahee gat mat tujh te hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1333.e: I meditate on You and praise You; salvation and wisdom come from You. ||1||Pause||

1333.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
1333.t: gurmukh saalaahan se saadh pain meeThaa a(n)mrit saar ||
1333.e: The Gurmukhs praise You; they receive the most excellent and sweet Ambrosial Nectar.

1333.g: ਸਦਾ ਮੀਠਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਫੀਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
1333.t: sadhaa meeThaa kadhe na feekaa gur sabadhee veechaar ||2||
1333.e: This Nectar is forever sweet; it never loses its taste. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

1333.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
1333.t: jin meeThaa laiaa soiee jaanai tis viTahu bal jaiee ||
1333.e: He makes it seem so sweet to me; I am a sacrifice to Him.

1333.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
1333.t: sabadh salaahee sadhaa sukhadhaataa vichahu aap gavaiee ||3||
1333.e: Through the Shabad, I praise the Giver of peace forever. I have eradicated self-conceit from within. ||3||

1333.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
1333.t: satigur meraa sadhaa hai dhaataa jo ichhai so fal paae ||
1333.e: My True Guru is forever the Giver. I receive whatever fruits and rewards I desire.

1333.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
1333.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee gur sabadhee sach paae ||4||3||
1333.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the True One is found. ||4||3||

1333.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1333.t: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
1333.e: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

1333.g: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
1333.t: jo teree saranaiee har jeeau tin too raakhan jog ||
1333.e: Those who enter Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord, are saved by Your Protective Power.

1333.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
1333.t: tudh jevadd mai avar na soojhai naa ko hoaa na hog ||1||
1333.e: I cannot even conceive of any other as Great as You. There never was, and there never shall be. ||1||

1333.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
1333.t: har jeeau sadhaa teree saranaiee ||
1333.e: O Dear Lord, I shall remain in Your Sanctuary forever.

1333.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1333.t: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu mere suaamee eh teree vaddiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1333.e: As it pleases You, You save me, O my Lord and Master; this is Your Glorious Greatness. ||1||Pause||

1333.g: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
1333.t: jo teree saranaiee har jeeau tin kee kareh pratipaal ||
1333.e: O Dear Lord, You cherish and sustain those who seek Your Sanctuary.

1334.g: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
1334.t: aap kirapaa kar raakhahu har jeeau poh na sakai jamakaal ||2||
1334.e: O Dear Lord, the Messenger of Death cannot even touch those whom You, in Your Mercy, protect. ||2||

1334.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾ ਓਹ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1334.t: teree saranaiee sachee har jeeau naa oh ghaTai na jai ||
1334.e: True Is Your Sanctuary, O Dear Lord; it never diminishes or goes away.

1334.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
1334.t: jo har chhodd dhoojai bhai laagai oh ja(n)mai tai mar jai ||3||
1334.e: Those who abandon the Lord, and become attached to the love of duality, shall continue to die and be reborn. ||3||

1334.g: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1334.t: jo teree saranaiee har jeeau tinaa dhookh bhookh kichh naeh ||
1334.e: Those who seek Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord, shall never suffer in pain or hunger for anything.

1334.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
1334.t: naanak naam salaeh sadhaa too sachai sabadh samaeh ||4||4||
1334.e: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord forever, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||4||

1334.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1334.t: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
1334.e: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

1334.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
1334.t: gurmukh har jeeau sadhaa dhiaavahu jab lag jeea paraan ||
1334.e: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Dear Lord forever, as long as there is the breath of life.

1334.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
1334.t: gur sabadhee man niramal hoaa chookaa man abhimaan ||
1334.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind becomes immaculate, and egotistical pride is expelled from the mind.

1334.g: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
1334.t: safal janam tis praanee keraa har kai naam samaan ||1||
1334.e: Fruitful and prosperous is the life of that mortal being, who is absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

1334.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
1334.t: mere man gur kee sikh suneejai ||
1334.e: O my mind, listen to the Teachings of the Guru.

1334.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1334.t: har kaa naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa sahaje har ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
1334.e: The Name of the Lord is the Giver of peace forever. With intuitive ease, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1334.g: ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
1334.t: mool pachhaanan tin nij ghar vaasaa sahaje hee sukh hoiee ||
1334.e: Those who understand their own origin dwell within the home of their inner being, in intuitive peace and poise.

1334.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
1334.t: gur kai sabadh kamal paragaasiaa haumai dhuramat khoiee ||
1334.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and egotism and evil-mindedness are eradicated.

1334.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
1334.t: sabhanaa meh eko sach varatai viralaa boojhai koiee ||2||
1334.e: The One True Lord is pervading amongst all; those who realize this are very rare. ||2||

1334.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
1334.t: gurmatee man niramal hoaa a(n)mrit tat vakhaanai ||
1334.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind becomes immaculate, speaking the Ambrosial Essence.

1334.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
1334.t: har kaa naam sadhaa man vasiaa vich man hee man maanai ||
1334.e: The Name of the Lord dwells in the mind forever; within the mind, the mind is pleased and appeased.

1334.g: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
1334.t: sadh balihaaree gur apune viTahu jit aatam raam pachhaanai ||3||
1334.e: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, through whom I have realized the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||3||

1334.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
1334.t: maanas janam satiguroo na seviaa birathaa janam gavaiaa ||
1334.e: Those human beings who do not serve the True Guru - their lives are uselessly wasted.

1334.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
1334.t: nadhar kare taa(n) satigur mele sahaje sahaj samaiaa ||
1334.e: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, then we meet the True Guru, merging in intuitive peace and poise.

1334.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
1334.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee poorai bhaag dhiaaiaa ||4||5||
1334.e: O Nanak, by great good fortune, the Naam is bestowed; by perfect destiny, meditate. ||4||5||

1334.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1334.t: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
1334.e: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

1334.g: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਣਾਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
1334.t: aape bhaa(n)t banaae bahu ra(n)gee sisaT upai prabh khel keeaa ||
1334.e: God Himself fashioned the many forms and colors; He created the Universe and staged the play.

1334.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਨੋ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥
1334.t: kar kar vekhai kare karaae sarab jeeaa no rijak dheeaa ||1||
1334.e: Creating the creation, He watches over it. He acts, and causes all to act; He gives sustenance to all beings. ||1||

1334.g: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
1334.t: kalee kaal meh raviaa raam ||
1334.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord is All-pervading.

1334.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1334.t: ghaT ghaT poor rahiaa prabh eko gurmukh paragaT har har naam ||1|| rahaau ||
1334.e: The One God is pervading and permeating each and every heart; the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||1||Pause||

1334.g: ਗੁਪਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
1334.t: gupataa naam varatai vich kalajug ghaT ghaT har bharapoor rahiaa ||
1334.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is hidden, but it is pervasive in the Dark Age. The Lord is totally pervading and permeating each and every heart.

1334.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨॥
1334.t: naam ratan tinaa hiradhai pragaTiaa jo gur saranaiee bhaj piaa ||2||
1334.e: The Jewel of the Naam is revealed within the hearts of those who hurry to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

1334.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪੰਚ ਪੰਚੇ ਵਸਿ ਆਣੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1334.t: ei(n)dhree pa(n)ch pa(n)che vas aanai khimaa sa(n)tokh gurmat paavai ||
1334.e: Whoever overpowers the five sense organs, is blessed with forgiveness, patience and contentment, through the Guru's Teachings.

1334.g: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਵਡ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੋ ਭੈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
1334.t: so dhan dhan har jan vadd pooraa jo bhai bairaag har gun gaavai ||3||
1334.e: Blessed, blessed, perfect and great is that humble servant of the Lord, who is inspired by the Fear of God and detached love, to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

1334.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
1334.t: gur te muh fere je koiee gur kaa kahiaa na chit dharai ||
1334.e: If someone turns his face away from the Guru, and does not enshrine the Guru's Words in his consciousness

1334.g: ਕਰਿ ਆਚਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਪਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੪॥
1334.t: kar aachaar bahu sa(n)pau sa(n)chai jo kichh karai su narak parai ||4||
1334.e: - he may perform all sorts of rituals and accumulate wealth, but in the end, he will fall into hell. ||4||

1334.g: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
1334.t: eko sabadh eko prabh varatai sabh ekas te utapat chalai ||
1334.e: The One Shabad, the Word of the One God, is prevailing everywhere. All the creation came from the One Lord.

1334.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੈ ॥੫॥੬॥
1334.t: naanak gurmukh mel milaae gurmukh har har jai ralai ||5||6||
1334.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is united in union. When the Gurmukh goes, he blends into the Lord, Har, Har. ||5||6||

1334.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1334.t: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
1334.e: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

1334.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
1334.t: mere man gur apanaa saalaeh ||
1334.e: O my mind, praise your Guru.

1335.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1335.t: pooraa bhaag hovai mukh masatak sadhaa har ke gun gaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
1335.e: Perfect destiny is inscribed upon your forehead and face; sing the Praises of the Lord forever. ||1||Pause||

1335.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
1335.t: a(n)mirat naam bhojan har dhei ||
1335.e: The Lord bestows the Ambrosial Food of the Naam.

1335.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਲੇਇ ॥
1335.t: koT madhe koiee viralaa lei ||
