1335.e: Out of millions, only a rare few receive it

1335.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
1335.t: jis no apanee nadhar karei ||1||
1335.e: - only those who are blessed by God's Glance of Grace. ||1||

1335.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
1335.t: gur ke charan man maeh vasai ||
1335.e: Whoever enshrines the Guru's Feet within his mind,

1335.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਅਨੑੇਰਾ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
1335.t: dhukh an(h)eraa a(n)dharahu jai ||
1335.e: is rid of pain and darkness from within.

1335.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
1335.t: aape saachaa le milai ||2||
1335.e: The True Lord unites him with Himself. ||2||

1335.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1335.t: gur kee baanee siau lai piaar ||
1335.e: So embrace love for the Word of the Guru's Bani.

1335.g: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਏਹੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
1335.t: aaithai othai eh adhaar ||
1335.e: Here and hereafter, this is your only Support.

1335.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
1335.t: aape dhevai sirajanahaar ||3||
1335.e: The Creator Lord Himself bestows it. ||3||

1335.g: ਸਚਾ ਮਨਾਏ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
1335.t: sachaa manaae apanaa bhaanaa ||
1335.e: One whom the Lord inspires to accept His Will,

1335.g: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੋੁਜਾਣਾ ॥
1335.t: soiee bhagat sughaR suojaanaa ||
1335.e: is a wise and knowing devotee.

1335.t: naanak tis kai sadh kurabaanaa ||4||7||17||7||24||
1335.e: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to him. ||4||7||17||7||24||

1335.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਬਿਭਾਸ
1335.t: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa bibhaas
1335.e: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla, Bibhaas:

1335.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1335.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1335.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1335.g: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਨ ॥
1335.t: rasak rasak gun gaaveh gurmat liv unaman naam lagaan ||
1335.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with joyous love and delight; I am enraptured, lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1335.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੧॥
1335.t: a(n)mrit ras peeaa gur sabadhee ham naam viTahu kurabaan ||1||
1335.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I drink in the Ambrosial Essence; I am a sacrifice to the Naam. ||1||

1335.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
1335.t: hamare jagajeevan har praan ||
1335.e: The Lord, the Life of the World, is my Breath of Life.

1335.g: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1335.t: har uootam ridh a(n)tar bhaio gur ma(n)t dheeo har kaan ||1|| rahaau ||
1335.e: The Lofty and Exalted Lord became pleasing to my heart and my inner being, when the Guru breathed the Mantra of the Lord into my ears. ||1||Pause||

1335.g: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨ ॥
1335.t: aavahu sa(n)t milahu mere bhaiee mil har har naam vakhaan ||
1335.e: Come, O Saints: let us join together, O Siblings of Destiny; let us meet and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

1335.g: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੨॥
1335.t: kit bidh kiau paieeaai prabh apunaa mo kau karahu upadhes har dhaan ||2||
1335.e: How am I to find my God? Please bless me with the Gift of the Lord's Teachings. ||2||

1335.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨ ॥
1335.t: satasa(n)gat meh har har vasiaa mil sa(n)gat har gun jaan ||
1335.e: The Lord, Har, Har, abides in the Society of the Saints; joining this Sangat, the Lord's Glories are known.

1335.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੩॥
1335.t: vaddai bhaag satasa(n)gat paiee gur satigur paras bhagavaan ||3||
1335.e: By great good fortune, the Society of the Saints is found. Through the Guru, the True Guru, I receive the Touch of the Lord God. ||3||

1335.g: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਹੈਰਾਨ ॥
1335.t: gun gaaveh prabh agam Thaakur ke gun gai rahe hairaan ||
1335.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of God, my Inaccessible Lord and Master; singing His Praises, I am enraptured.

1335.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਖਿਨ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
1335.t: jan naanak kau gur kirapaa dhaaree har naam dheeo khin dhaan ||4||1||
1335.e: The Guru has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; in an instant, He blessed him with the Gift of the Lord's Name. ||4||1||

1335.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1335.t: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1335.e: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla:

1335.g: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਭ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ॥
1335.t: augavai soor gurmukh har boleh sabh rain sam(h)aaleh har gaal ||
1335.e: With the rising of the sun, the Gurmukh speaks of the Lord. All through the night, he dwells upon the Sermon of the Lord.

1335.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਮ ਲੋਚ ਲਗਾਈ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲ ॥੧॥
1335.t: hamarai prabh ham loch lagaiee ham kareh prabhoo har bhaal ||1||
1335.e: My God has infused this longing within me; I seek my Lord God. ||1||

1335.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
1335.t: meraa man saadhoo dhoor ravaal ||
1335.e: My mind is the dust of the feet of the Holy.

1335.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਹ ਹਮ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1335.t: har har naam dhiraRaio gur meeThaa gur pag jhaareh ham baal ||1|| rahaau ||
1335.e: The Guru has implanted the Sweet Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within me. I dust the Guru's Feet with my hair. ||1||Pause||

1335.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲ ॥
1335.t: saakat kau dhin rain a(n)dhaaree moh faathe maiaa jaal ||
1335.e: Dark are the days and nights of the faithless cynics; they are caught in the trap of attachment to Maya.

1335.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਰਿਨਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਲ ॥੨॥
1335.t: khin pal har prabh ridhai na vasio rin baadhe bahu bidh baal ||2||
1335.e: The Lord God does not dwell in their hearts, even for an instant; every hair of their heads is totally tied up in debts. ||2||

1335.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਉ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲ ॥
1335.t: satasa(n)gat mil mat budh paiee hau chhooTe mamataa jaal ||
1335.e: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, wisdom and understanding are obtained, and one is released from the traps of egotism and possessiveness.

1335.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩॥
1335.t: har naamaa har meeTh lagaanaa gur ke'ee sabadh nihaal ||3||
1335.e: The Lord's Name, and the Lord, seem sweet to me. Through the Word of His Shabad, the Guru has made me happy. ||3||

1335.g: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਗੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
1335.t: ham baarik gur agam gusaiee gur kar kirapaa pratipaal ||
1335.e: I am just a child; the Guru is the Unfathomable Lord of the World. In His Mercy, He cherishes and sustains me.

1335.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥੪॥੨॥
1335.t: bikh bhaujal ddubadhe kaadd leh prabh gur naanak baal gupaal ||4||2||
1335.e: I am drowning in the ocean of poison; O God, Guru, Lord of the World, please save Your child, Nanak. ||4||2||

1335.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1335.t: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1335.e: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla:

1335.g: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਰਸਕ ਰਸੀਕ ॥
1335.t: eik khin har prabh kirapaa dhaaree gun gaae rasak raseek ||
1335.e: The Lord God showered me with His Mercy for an instant; I sing His Glorious Praises with joyous love and delight.

1336.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੋਊ ਭਏ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਕ ॥੧॥
1336.t: gaavat sunat dhouoo bhe mukate jinaa gurmukh khin har peek ||1||
1336.e: Both the singer and the listener are liberated, when, as Gurmukh, they drink in the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||1||

1336.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੀਕ ॥
1336.t: merai man har har raam naam ras Teek ||
1336.e: The Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is enshrined within my mind.

1336.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਰਸੁ ਝੀਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1336.t: gurmukh naam seetal jal paiaa har har naam peeaa ras jheek ||1|| rahaau ||
1336.e: As Gurmukh, I have obtained the cooling, soothing Water of the Naam. I eagerly drink in the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

1336.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਊਜਲ ਟੀਕ ॥
1336.t: jin har hiradhai preet lagaanee tinaa masatak uoojal Teek ||
1336.e: Those whose hearts are imbued with the Love of the Lord have the mark of radiant purity upon their foreheads.

1336.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਡਵਾ ਸਸਿ ਕੀਕ ॥੨॥
1336.t: har jan sobhaa sabh jag uoopar jiau vich uddavaa sas keek ||2||
1336.e: The Glory of the Lord's humble servant is manifest throughout the world, like the moon among the stars. ||2||

1336.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਫੀਕ ॥
1336.t: jin har hiradhai naam na vasio tin sabh kaaraj feek ||
1336.e: Those whose hearts are not filled with the Lord's Name - all their affairs are worthless and insipid.

1336.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਦੇਹ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਕਟੇ ਨਕ ਕੀਕ ॥੩॥
1336.t: jaise seegaar karai dheh maanukh naam binaa nakaTe nak keek ||3||
1336.e: They may adorn and decorate their bodies, but without the Naam, they look like their noses have been cut off. ||3||

1336.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਈਕ ॥
1336.t: ghaT ghaT ramieeaa ramat raam rai sabh varatai sabh meh ieek ||
1336.e: The Sovereign Lord permeates each and every heart; the One Lord is all-pervading everywhere.

1336.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਘਰੀ ਮੀਕ ॥੪॥੩॥
1336.t: jan naanak kau har kirapaa dhaaree gur bachan dhiaaio gharee meek ||4||3||
1336.e: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I have meditated on the Lord in an instant. ||4||3||

1336.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1336.t: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1336.e: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla:

1336.g: ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਕਹੇ ॥
1336.t: agam dhiaal kirapaa prabh dhaaree mukh har har naam ham kahe ||
1336.e: God, the Inaccessible and Merciful, has showered me with His Mercy; I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with my mouth.

1336.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥
1336.t: patit paavan har naam dhiaaio sabh kilabikh paap lahe ||1||
1336.e: I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners; I am rid of all my sins and mistakes. ||1||

1336.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
1336.t: jap man raam naam rav rahe ||
1336.e: O mind, chant the Name of the All-pervading Lord.

1336.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1336.t: dheen dhiaal dhukh bha(n)jan gaio gurmat naam padhaarath lahe ||1|| rahaau ||
1336.e: I sing the Praises of the Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain. Following the Guru's Teachings, I gather in the Wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1336.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਨਗਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹੇ ॥
1336.t: kaiaa nagar nagar har basio mat gurmat har har sahe ||
1336.e: The Lord abides in the body-village; through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed.

1336.g: ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੨॥
1336.t: sareer sarovar naam har pragaTio ghar ma(n)dhar har prabh lahe ||2||
1336.e: In the lake of the body, the Lord's Name has been revealed. Within my own home and mansion, I have obtained the Lord God. ||2||

1336.g: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਉਦਿਆਨੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਹੇ ॥
1336.t: jo nar bharam bharam udhiaane te saakat mooR muhe ||
1336.e: Those beings who wander in the wilderness of doubt - those faithless cynics are foolish, and are plundered.

1336.g: ਜਿਉ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਭਿ ਬਸੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਨਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਝਾਰ ਗਹੇ ॥੩॥
1336.t: jiau mirag naabh basai baas basanaa bhram bhramio jhaar gahe ||3||
1336.e: They are like the deer: the scent of musk comes from its own navel, but it wanders and roams around, searching for it in the bushes. ||3||

1336.g: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਹੇ ॥
1336.t: tum vadd agam agaadh bodh prabh mat dhevahu har prabh lahe ||
1336.e: You are Great and Unfathomable; Your Wisdom, God, is Profound and Incomprehensible. Please bless me with that wisdom, by which I might attain You, O Lord God.

1336.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
1336.t: jan naanak kau gur haath sir dhario har raam naam rav rahe ||4||4||
1336.e: The Guru has placed His Hand upon servant Nanak; he chants the Name of the Lord. ||4||4||

1336.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1336.t: prabhaatee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1336.e: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla:

1336.g: ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਫਾ ॥
1336.t: man laagee preet raam naam har har japio har prabh vaddafaa ||
1336.e: My mind is in love with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; I meditate on the Great Lord God.

1336.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਫਾ ॥੧॥
1336.t: satigur bachan sukhaane heearai har dhaaree har prabh kirapafaa ||1||
1336.e: The Word of the True Guru has become pleasing to my heart. The Lord God has showered me with His Grace. ||1||

1336.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਫਾ ॥
1336.t: mere man bhaj raam naam har nimakhafaa ||
1336.e: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord's Name every instant.

1336.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਫਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1336.t: har har dhaan dheeo gur poorai har naamaa man tan basafaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1336.e: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with the gift of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name abides in my mind and body. ||1||Pause||

1336.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਵਸਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਪਫਾ ॥
1336.t: kaiaa nagar vasio ghar ma(n)dhar jap sobhaa gurmukh karapafaa ||
1336.e: The Lord abides in the body-village, in my home and mansion. As Gurmukh, I meditate on His Glory.

1336.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰਫਾ ॥੨॥
1336.t: halat palat jan bhe suhele mukh uoojal gurmukh tarafaa ||2||
1336.e: Here and hereafter, the Lord's humble servants are embellished and exalted; their faces are radiant; as Gurmukh, they are carried across. ||2||

1336.g: ਅਨਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਫਾ ॥
1336.t: anabhau har har har liv laagee har ur dhaario gur nimakhafaa ||
1336.e: I am lovingly attuned to the Fearless Lord, Har, Har, Har; through the Guru, I have enshrined the Lord within my heart in an instant.

1336.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਇਕ ਪਲਫਾ ॥੩॥
1336.t: koT koT ke dhokh sabh jan ke har dhoor ke'ee ik palafaa ||3||
1336.e: Millions upon millions of the faults and mistakes of the Lord's humble servant are all taken away in an instant. ||3||

1336.g: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਖਫਾ ॥
1336.t: tumare jan tum hee te jaane prabh jaanio jan te mukhafaa ||
1336.e: Your humble servants are known only through You, God; knowing You, they become supreme.

1336.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਕਫਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
1336.t: har har aap dhario har jan meh jan naanak har prabh ikafaa ||4||5||
1336.e: The Lord, Har, Har, has enshrined Himself within His humble servant. O Nanak, the Lord God and His servant are one and the same. ||4||5||

1337.e: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehla:

1337.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਭਾ ॥
1337.t: gur satigur naam dhiraRaio har har ham mue jeeve har japibhaa ||
1337.e: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord within me. I was dead, but chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been brought back to life.

1337.g: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਇ ਕਢਿਭਾ ॥੧॥
1337.t: dhan dha(n)n guroo gur satigur pooraa bikh ddubadhe baeh dhei kaddibhaa ||1||
1337.e: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Guru, the Perfect True Guru; He reached out to me with His Arm, and pulled me up and out of the ocean of poison. ||1||
O mind, meditate and worship the Lord's Name.

1337.g: ਉਪਜੰਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਤਹੂ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1337.t: aupaja(n)p upai na paieeaai katahoo gur poorai har prabh laabhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1337.e: God is never found, even by making all sorts of new efforts. The Lord God is obtained only through the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

1337.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਭਾ ॥
1337.t: raam naam ras raam rasain ras peeaa gurmat rasabhaa ||
1337.e: The Sublime Essence of the Lord's Name is the source of nectar and bliss; drinking in this Sublime Essence, following the Guru's Teachings, I have become happy.

1337.g: ਲੋਹ ਮਨੂਰ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿਭਾ ॥੨॥
1337.t: loh manoor ka(n)chan mil sa(n)gat har ur dhaario gur haribhaa ||2||
1337.e: Even iron slag is transformed into gold, joining the Lord's Congregation. Through the Guru, the Lord's Light is enshrined within the heart. ||2||

1337.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਨੇ ਪੁਤ ਕਲਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੁਭਿਭਾ ॥
1337.t: haumai bikhiaa nit lobh lubhaane put kalat moh lubhibhaa ||
1337.e: Those who are continually lured by greed, egotism and corruption, who are lured away by emotional attachment to their children and spouse

1337.g: ਤਿਨ ਪਗ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਤੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂੰਭਰ ਭਰਭਾ ॥੩॥
1337.t: tin pag sa(n)t na seve kabahoo te manmukh bhoo(n)bhar bharabhaa ||3||
1337.e: - they never serve at the feet of the Saints; those self-willed manmukhs are filled with ashes. ||3||

1337.g: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਰੇ ਹਾਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਭਾ ॥
1337.t: tumare gun tum hee prabh jaanahu ham pare haar tum saranabhaa ||
1337.e: O God, You alone know Your Glorious Virtues; I have grown weary - I seek Your Sanctuary.

1337.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਨਭਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
1337.t: jiau jaanahu tiau raakhahu suaamee jan naanak dhaas tumanabhaa ||4||6||
1337.e: As You know best, You preserve and protect me, O my Lord and Master; servant Nanak is Your slave. ||4||6||
First Set of Six||
Prabhaatee, Bibhaas, Partaal, Fourth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1337.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
1337.t: jap man har har naam nidhaan ||
1337.e: O mind, meditate on the Treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
You shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

1337.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1337.t: jin japiaa te paar paraan ||1|| rahaau ||
1337.e: Those who chant and meditate shall be carried across to the other shore. ||1||Pause||

1337.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
1337.t: sun man har har naam kar dhiaan ||
1337.e: Listen, O mind: meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

1337.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਾਨੁ ॥
1337.t: sun man har keerat aThasaTh majaan ||
1337.e: Listen, O mind: the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is equal to bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Listen, O mind: as Gurmukh, you shall be blessed with honor. ||1||
O mind, chant and meditate on the Supreme Transcendent Lord God.
Millions of sins shall be destroyed in an instant.
O Nanak, you shall meet with the Lord God. ||2||1||7||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla, Bibhaas:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1337.g: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
1337.t: man har keeaa tan sabh saajiaa ||
1337.e: The Lord created the mind, and fashioned the entire body.
From the five elements, He formed it, and infused His Light within it.
He made the earth its bed, and water for it to use.
Do not forget Him for an instant; serve the Lord of the World. ||1||

1337.g: ਮਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥
1337.t: man satigur sev hoi param gate ||
1337.e: O mind, serve the True Guru, and obtain the supreme status.

1337.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1337.t: harakh sog te raheh niraaraa taa(n) too paaveh praanapate ||1|| rahaau ||
1337.e: If you remain unattached and unaffected by sorrow and joy, then you shall find the Lord of Life. ||1||Pause||
He makes all the various pleasures, clothes and foods for you to enjoy.
He made your mother, father and all relatives.
He provides sustenance to all, in the water and on the land, O friend.
So serve the Lord, forever and ever. ||2||

1337.g: ਤਹਾ ਸਖਾਈ ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
1337.t: tahaa sakhaiee jeh koi na hovai ||
1337.e: He shall be your Helper and Support there, where no one else can help you.

1337.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
1337.t: koT apraadh ik khin meh dhovai ||
1337.e: He washes away millions of sins in an instant.
He bestows His Gifts, and never regrets them.

1337.g: ਏਕਾ ਬਖਸ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
1337.t: ekaa bakhas fir bahur na bulaavai ||3||
1337.e: He forgives, once and for all, and never asks for one's account again. ||3||

1338.e: By pre-ordained destiny, I have searched and found God.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord of the World abides.
Meeting with the Guru, I have come to Your Door.
O Lord, please bless servant Nanak with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||4||1||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

1338.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
1338.t: prabh kee sevaa jan kee sobhaa ||
1338.e: Serving God, His humble servant is glorified.
Unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger and unsatisfied greed are eradicated.
Your Name is the treasure of Your humble servant.
Singing His Praises, I am in love with the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||1||
You are known, O God, by Your devotees.

1338.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1338.t: kaaT jevaree jan le'ee chhaddaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1338.e: Breaking their bonds, You emancipate them. ||1||Pause||

1338.g: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
1338.t: jo jan raataa prabh kai ra(n)g ||
1338.e: Those humble beings who are imbued with God's Love

1338.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
1338.t: tin sukh paiaa prabh kai sa(n)g ||
1338.e: find peace in God's Congregation.
They alone understand this, to whom this subtle essence comes.
Beholding it, and gazing upon it, in their minds they are wonderstruck. ||2||

1338.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
1338.t: so sukheeaa sabh te uootam soi ||
1338.e: They are at peace, the most exalted of all,

1338.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
1338.t: jaa kai hiradhai vasiaa prabh soi ||
1338.e: within whose hearts God dwells.
They are stable and unchanging; they do not come and go in reincarnation.

1338.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
1338.t: anadhin prabh ke har gun gai ||3||
1338.e: Night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God. ||3||
All bow down in humble respect to those
whose minds are filled with the Formless Lord.
Show mercy unto me, O my Divine Lord and Master.
May Nanak be saved, by serving these humble beings. ||4||2||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:
Singing His Glorious Praises, the mind is in ecstasy.
Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate in remembrance on God.
Remembering Him in meditation, the sins go away.

1338.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
1338.t: tis gur kee ham charanee paeh ||1||
1338.e: I fall at the Feet of that Guru. ||1||
O beloved Saints, please bless me with wisdom;
let me meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and be emancipated. ||1||Pause||
The Guru has shown me the straight path;
I have abandoned everything else. I am enraptured with the Name of the Lord.

1338.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
1338.t: tis gur kai sadhaa bal jaieeaai ||
1338.e: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru;

1338.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
1338.t: har simaran jis gur te paieeaai ||2||
1338.e: I meditate in remembrance on the Lord, through the Guru. ||2||
The Guru carries those mortal beings across, and saves them from drowning.
By His Grace, they are not enticed by Maya;
in this world and the next, they are embellished and exalted by the Guru.

1338.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
1338.t: tis gur uoopar sadhaa hau vaariaa ||3||
1338.e: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru. ||3||
From the most ignorant, I have been made spiritually wise,
through the Unspoken Speech of the Perfect Guru.
The Divine Guru, O Nanak, is the Supreme Lord God.
By great good fortune, I serve the Lord. ||4||3||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

1338.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟੇ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
1338.t: sagale dhookh miTe sukh dhe'ee apanaa naam japaiaa ||
1338.e: Eradicating all my pains, He has blessed me with peace, and inspired me to chant His Name.

1338.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1338.t: kar kirapaa apanee sevaa laae sagalaa dhurat miTaiaa ||1||
1338.e: In His Mercy, He has enjoined me to His service, and has purged me of all my sins. ||1||
I am only a child; I seek the Sanctuary of God the Merciful.

1338.g: ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1338.t: avagan kaaT ke'ee prabh apune raakh le'ee merai gur gopaal ||1|| rahaau ||
1338.e: Erasing my demerits and faults, God has made me His Own. My Guru, the Lord of the World, protects me. ||1||Pause||

1338.g: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
1338.t: taap paap binase khin bheetar bhe kirapaal gusaiee ||
1338.e: My sicknesses and sins were erased in an instant, when the Lord of the World became merciful.

1338.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
1338.t: saas saas paarabraham araadhee apune satigur kai bal jaiee ||2||
1338.e: With each and very breath, I worship and adore the Supreme Lord God; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||

1338.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
1338.t: agam agochar bia(n)t suaamee taa kaa a(n)t na paieeaai ||
1338.e: My Lord and Master is Inaccessible, Unfathomable and Infinite. His limits cannot be found.

1338.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਹੋਈਐ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
1338.t: laahaa khaaT hoieeaai dhanava(n)taa apunaa prabhoo dhiaaieeaai ||3||
1338.e: We earn the profit, and become wealthy, meditating on our God. ||3||

1339.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
1339.t: aaTh pahar paarabraham dhiaaiee sadhaa sadhaa gun gaiaa ||
1339.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on the Supreme Lord God; I sing His Glorious Praises forever and ever.

1339.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
1339.t: kahu naanak mere poore manorath paarabraham gur paiaa ||4||4||
1339.e: Says Nanak, my desires have been fulfilled; I have found my Guru, the Supreme Lord God. ||4||4||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:
Meditating in rememberance on the Naam, all my sins have been erased.
The Guru has blessed me with the Capital of the True Name.
God's servants are embellished and exalted in His Court;
serving Him, they look beauteous forever. ||1||

1339.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
1339.t: har har naam japahu mere bhaiee ||
1339.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Siblings of Destiny.

1339.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1339.t: sagale rog dhokh sabh binaseh agiaan a(n)dheraa man te jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1339.e: All sickness and sin shall be erased; your mind shall be rid of the darkness of ignorance. ||1||Pause||
The Guru has saved me from death and rebirth, O friend;

1339.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
1339.t: har ke naam siau laagee preet ||
1339.e: I am in love with the Name of the Lord.
The suffering of millions of incarnations is gone;

1339.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲ ਹੋਸ ॥੨॥
1339.t: jo tis bhaavai so bhal hos ||2||
1339.e: whatever pleases Him is good. ||2||

1339.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
1339.t: tis gur kau hau sadh bal jaiee ||
1339.e: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru;
by His Grace, I meditate on the Lord's Name.
By great good fortune, such a Guru is found;
meeting Him, one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||3||
Please be merciful, O Supreme Lord God, O Lord and Master,
Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts.
Twenty-four hours a day, I am lovingly attuned to You.
Servant Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of God. ||4||5||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:
In His Mercy, God has made me His Own.

1339.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ॥
1339.t: har kaa naam japan kau dhe'ee ||
1339.e: He has blessed me with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
Fear is dispelled, and all anxiety has been alleviated. ||1||
I have been saved, touching the Feet of the True Guru.

1339.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1339.t: jo gur kahai soiee bhal meeThaa man kee mat tiaag ||1|| rahaau ||
1339.e: Whatever the Guru says is good and sweet to me. I have renounced the intellectual wisdom of my mind. ||1||Pause||

1339.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
1339.t: man tan vasiaa har prabh soiee ||
1339.e: That Lord God abides within my mind and body.

1339.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1339.t: kal kales kichh bighan na hoiee ||
1339.e: There are no conflicts, pains or obstacles.

1339.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
1339.t: sadhaa sadhaa prabh jeea kai sa(n)g ||
1339.e: Forever and ever, God is with my soul.
Filth and pollution are washed away by the Love of the Name. ||2||
I am in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord;
I am no longer consumed by sexual desire, anger and egotism.
Now, I know the way to meet God.

1339.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
1339.t: bhai bhagat har siau man maanaa(n) ||3||
1339.e: Through loving devotional worship, my mind is pleased and appeased with the Lord. ||3||
Listen, O friends, Saints, my exalted companions.
The Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is unfathomable and immeasurable.

1339.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
1339.t: sadhaa sadhaa prabh gun nidh gaieeaai ||
1339.e: Forever and ever, sing the Glories of God, the Treasure of Virtue.
Says Nanak, by great good fortune, He is found. ||4||6||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:
They are wealthy, and they are the true merchants,
who have the credit of the Naam in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

1339.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
1339.t: har har naam japahu man meet ||
1339.e: So chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in your mind, my friends.

1339.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1339.t: gur pooraa paieeaai vaddabhaagee niramal pooran reet ||1|| rahaau ||
1339.e: The Perfect Guru is found by great good fortune, and then one's lifestyle becomes perfect and immaculate. ||1||Pause||
They earn the profit, and the congratulations pour in;

1339.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
1339.t: sa(n)t prasaadh har ke gun gaiee ||2||
1339.e: by the Grace of the Saints, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
Their lives are fruitful and prosperous, and their birth is approved;
by Guru's Grace, they enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||3||
Sexuality, anger and egotism are wiped away;
O Nanak, as Gurmukh, they are carried across to the other shore. ||4||7||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

1339.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ॥
1339.t: gur pooraa pooree taa kee kalaa ||
1339.e: The Guru is Perfect, and Perfect is His Power.

1340.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਅਟਲਾ ॥
1340.t: gur kaa sabadh sadhaa sadh aTalaa ||
1340.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is unchanging, forever and ever.

1340.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
1340.t: gur kee baanee jis man vasai || dhookh dharadh sabh taa kaa nasai ||1||
1340.e: All pains and afflictions run away from those, whose minds are filled with the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||1||

1340.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
1340.t: har ra(n)g raataa man raam gun gaavai ||
1340.e: Imbued with the Lord's Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
They are liberated, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's Grace, they are carried across to the other shore;
they are rid of fear, doubt and corruption.

1340.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
1340.t: man tan a(n)tar base gur charanaa ||
1340.e: The Guru's Feet abide deep within their minds and bodies.
The Holy are fearless; they take to the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||
They are blessed with abundant bliss, happiness, pleasure and peace.
Enemies and pains do not even approach them.
The Perfect Guru makes them His Own, and protects them.

1340.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
1340.t: har naam japat kilabikh sabh laathe ||3||
1340.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, they are rid of all their sins. ||3||
The Saints, spiritual companions and Sikhs are exalted and uplifted.

1340.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲੈ ਮੇਲੇ ॥
1340.t: gur poorai prabh siau lai mele ||
1340.e: The Perfect Guru leads them to meet God.
The painful noose of death and rebirth is snapped.
Says Nanak, the Guru covers their faults. ||4||8||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:
The Perfect True Guru has bestowed the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1340.g: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1340.t: anadh ma(n)gal kaliaan sadhaa sukh kaaraj sagalaa raas theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1340.e: I am blessed with bliss and happiness, emancipation and eternal peace. All my affairs have been resolved. ||1||Pause||

1340.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
1340.t: charan kamal gur ke man vooThe ||
1340.e: The Lotus Feet of the Guru abide within my mind.
I am rid of pain, suffering, doubt and fraud. ||1||

1340.g: ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1340.t: nit uTh gaavahu prabh kee baanee ||
1340.e: Rise early, and sing the Glorious Word of God's Bani.
Twenty-four hours a day, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, O mortal. ||2||
Inwardly and outwardly, God is everywhere.
Wherever I go, He is always with me, my Helper and Support. ||3||
With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer.
O Nanak, I meditate forever on the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||4||9||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:
The Supreme Lord God is All-wise and All-knowing.

1340.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1340.t: gur pooraa paieeaai vaddabhaagee dharasan kau jaieeaai kurabaan ||1|| rahaau ||
1340.e: The Perfect Guru is found by great good fortune. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||
My sins are cut away, through the Word of the Shabad, and I have found contentment.
I have become worthy of worshipping the Naam in adoration.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have been enlightened.
The Lord's Lotus Feet abide within my mind. ||1||
The One who made us, protects and preserves us.
God is Perfect, the Master of the masterless.
Those, upon whom He showers His Mercy
- they have perfect karma and conduct. ||2||

1340.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਵੇ ॥
1340.t: gun gaavai nit nit nit nave ||
1340.e: They sing the Glories of God, continually, continuously, forever fresh and new.
They do not wander in the 8.4 million incarnations.
Here and hereafter, they worship the Lord's Feet.
Their faces are radiant, and they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
That person, upon whose forehead the Guru places His Hand
out of millions, how rare is that slave.
He sees God pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky.

1340.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
1340.t: naanak udharas tis jan kee dhoor ||4||10||
1340.e: Nanak is saved by the dust of the feet of such a humble being. ||4||10||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:
I am a sacrifice to my Perfect Guru.

1340.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1340.t: jis prasaadh har har jap japane ||1|| rahaau ||
1340.e: By His Grace, I chant and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
Listening to the Ambrosial Word of His Bani, I am exalted and enraptured.
My corrupt and poisonous entanglements are gone. ||1||
I am in love with the True Word of His Shabad.
The Lord God has come into my consciousness. ||2||
Chanting the Naam, I am enlightened.

1341.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ ਕੀਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
1341.t: gur sabadhe keenaa ridhai nivaas ||3||
1341.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has come to dwell within my heart. ||3||

1341.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
1341.t: gur samarath sadhaa dhiaal ||
1341.e: The Guru is All-powerful and Merciful forever.

1341.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
1341.t: har jap jap naanak bhe nihaal ||4||11||
1341.e: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, Nanak is exalted and enraptured. ||4||11||

1341.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1341.t: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
1341.e: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

1341.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1341.t: gur gur karat sadhaa sukh paiaa ||
1341.e: Chanting Guru, Guru, I have found eternal peace.

1341.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1341.t: dheen dhiaal bhe kirapaalaa apanaa naam aap japaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1341.e: God, Merciful to the meek, has become kind and compassionate; He has inspired me to chant His Name. ||1||Pause||

1341.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
1341.t: sa(n)tasa(n)gat mil bhiaa pragaas ||
1341.e: Joining the Society of the Saints, I am illumined and enlightened.

1341.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
1341.t: har har japat pooran bhiee aas ||1||
1341.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my hopes have been fulfilled. ||1||

1341.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
1341.t: sarab kaliaan sookh man vooThe ||
1341.e: I am blessed with total salvation, and my mind is filled with peace.

1341.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੂਠੇ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
1341.t: har gun gaae gur naanak tooThe ||2||12||
1341.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; O Nanak, the Guru has been gracious to me. ||2||12||

1341.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਬਿਭਾਸ
1341.t: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa bibhaas
1341.e: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Bibhaas:

1341.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1341.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1341.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1341.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਉ ॥
1341.t: avar na dhoojaa Thaau ||
1341.e: There is no other place of rest,

1341.g: ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
1341.t: naahee bin har naau ||
1341.e: none at all, without the Lord's Name.

1341.g: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥
1341.t: sarab sidh kaliaan ||
1341.e: There is total success and salvation,

1341.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
1341.t: pooran hoh sagal kaam ||1||
1341.e: and all affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||

1341.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥
1341.t: har ko naam japeeaai neet ||
1341.e: Constantly chant the Name of the Lord.

1341.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਏਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1341.t: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar binasai lagai ekai preet ||1|| rahaau ||
1341.e: Sexuality, anger and egotism are wiped away; let yourself fall in love with the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

1341.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਾਲਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
1341.t: naam laagai dhookh bhaagai saran paalan jog ||
1341.e: Attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, pain runs away. In His Sanctuary, He cherishes and sustains us.

1341.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਤੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
1341.t: satigur bheTai jam na teTai jis dhur hovai sa(n)jog ||2||
1341.e: Whoever has such pre-ordained destiny meets with the True Guru; the Messenger of Death cannot grab him. ||2||

1341.g: ਰੈਨਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਜਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ॥
1341.t: rain dhinas dhiaai har har tajahu man ke bharam ||
1341.e: Night and day, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; abandon the doubts of your mind.

1341.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥
1341.t: saadhasa(n)gat har milai jiseh pooran karam ||3||
1341.e: One who has perfect karma joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meets the Lord. ||3||

1341.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਖਾਦ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
1341.t: janam janam bikhaadh binase raakh leene aap ||
1341.e: The sins of countless lifetimes are erased, and one is protected by the Lord Himself.

1341.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩॥
1341.t: maat pitaa meet bhaiee jan naanak har har jaap ||4||1||13||
1341.e: He is our Mother, Father, Friend and Sibling; O servant Nanak, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||13||

1341.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪੜਤਾਲ
1341.t: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa bibhaas paRataal
1341.e: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla, Bibhaas, Partaal:

1341.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1341.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1341.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1341.g: ਰਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਪ ॥
1341.t: ram raam raam raam jaap ||
1341.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

1341.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1341.t: kal kales lobh moh binas jai aha(n) taap ||1|| rahaau ||
1341.e: Conflict, suffering, greed and emotional attachment shall be dispelled, and the fever of egotism shall be relieved. ||1||Pause||

1341.g: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਾਪ ॥੧॥
1341.t: aap tiaag sa(n)t charan laag man pavit jaeh paap ||1||
1341.e: Renounce your selfishness, and grasp the feet of the Saints; your mind shall be sanctified, and your sins shall be taken away. ||1||

1341.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥
1341.t: naanak baarik kachhoo na jaanai raakhan kau prabh maiee baap ||2||1||14||
1341.e: Nanak, the child, does not know anything at all. O God, please protect me; You are my Mother and Father. ||2||1||14||

1341.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1341.t: prabhaatee mahalaa panjavaa ||
1341.e: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

1341.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
1341.t: charan kamal saran Tek ||
1341.e: I have taken the Shelter and Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

1341.g: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1341.t: uooch mooch bea(n)t Thaakur sarab uoopar tuhee ek ||1|| rahaau ||
1341.e: You are Lofty and Exalted, Grand and Infinite, O my Lord and Master; You alone are above all. ||1||Pause||

1341.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦਾਰ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
1341.t: praan adhaar dhukh bidhaar dhainahaar budh bibek ||1||
1341.e: He is the Support of the breath of life, the Destroyer of pain, the Giver of discriminating understanding. ||1||

1341.g: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਰਖਨਹਾਰ ਮਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਕ ॥
1341.t: namasakaar rakhanahaar man araadh prabhoo mek ||
1341.e: So bow down in respect to the Savior Lord; worship and adore the One God.

1341.g: ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥
1341.t: sa(n)t ren karau majan naanak paavai sukh anek ||2||2||15||
1341.e: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Saints, Nanak is blessed with countless comforts. ||2||2||15||

1342.e: Prabhaatee, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla, Bibhaas:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The insanity of duality has driven the mind insane.
In false greed, life is wasting away.

1342.g: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1342.t: lapaT rahee fun ba(n)dh na paiaa ||
1342.e: Duality clings to the mind; it cannot be restrained.
The True Guru saves us, implanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord within. ||1||

1342.g: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਰੈ ॥
1342.t: naa man marai na maiaa marai ||
1342.e: Without subduing the mind, Maya cannot be subdued.

1342.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1342.t: jin kichh keeaa soiee jaanai sabadh veechaar bhau saagar tarai ||1|| rahaau ||
1342.e: The One who created this, He alone understands. Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, one is carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
Gathering the wealth of Maya, kings become proud and arrogant.
But this Maya that they love so much shall not go along with them in the end.
There are so many colors and flavors of attachment to Maya.

1342.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੨॥
1342.t: bin naavai ko saath na sa(n)gee ||2||
1342.e: Except for the Name, no one has any friend or companion. ||2||

1342.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਪਰ ਮਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ॥
1342.t: jiau man dhekheh par man taisaa ||
1342.e: According to one's own mind, one sees the minds of others.
According to one's desires, one's condition is determined.
According to one's actions, one is focused and tuned in.
Seeking the advice of the True Guru, one finds the home of peace and poise. ||3||
In music and song, the mind is caught by the love of duality.
Filled with deception deep within, one suffers in terrible pain.
Meeting with the True Guru, one is blessed with clear understanding,
and remains lovingly attuned to the True Name. ||4||
Through the True Word of the Shabad, one practices Truth.
He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, through the True Word of His Bani.

1342.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1342.t: nij ghar vaas amar padh paavai ||
1342.e: He dwells in the home of his own heart deep within, and obtains the immortal status.
Then, he is blessed with honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||5||

1342.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1342.t: gur sevaa bin bhagat na hoiee ||
1342.e: Without serving the Guru, there is no devotional worship,
even though one may make all sorts of efforts.
If one eradicates egotism and selfishness through the Shabad,
the Immaculate Naam comes to abide in the mind. ||6||

1342.g: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
1342.t: eis jag meh sabadh karanee hai saar ||
1342.e: In this world, the practice of the Shabad is the most excellent occupation.
Without the Shabad, everything else is the darkness of emotional attachment.
Through the Shabad, the Naam is enshrined within the heart.
Through the Shabad, one obtains clear understanding and the door of salvation. ||7||
There is no other Creator except the All-seeing Lord God.
The True Lord Himself is Infinite and Incomparably Beautiful.
Through the Lord's Name, one obtains the most sublime and exalted state.
O Nanak, how rare are those humble beings, who seek and find the Lord. ||8||1||
Prabhaatee, First Mehla:
Emotional attachment to Maya is spread out all over the world.
Seeing a beautiful woman, the man is overcome with sexual desire.
His love for his children and gold steadily increases.

1342.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1342.t: sabh kichh apanaa ik raam paraiaa ||1||
1342.e: He sees everything as his own, but he does not own the One Lord. ||1||
I meditate as I chant on such a mala,

1342.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1342.t: dhukh sukh parahar bhagat niraalee ||1|| rahaau ||
1342.e: that I rise above pleasure and pain; I attain the most wondrous devotional worship of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1342.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1342.t: gun nidhaan teraa a(n)t na paiaa ||
1342.e: O Treasure of Virtue, Your limits cannot be found.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, I am absorbed into You.
You Yourself created the comings and goings of reincarnation.

1342.g: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1342.t: seiee bhagat jin sach chit laiaa ||2||
1342.e: They alone are devotees, who focus their consciousness on You. ||2||
Spiritual wisdom and meditation on the Lord, the Lord of Nirvaanaa

1342.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
1342.t: bin satigur bheTe koi na jaanee ||
1342.e: - without meeting the True Guru, no one knows this.
The Lord's Light fills the sacred pools of all beings.
I am a sacrifice to the Embodiment of Bliss. ||3||
Through the Guru's Teachings, one achieves loving devotional worship.
The Shabad burns away egotism from within.

1343.e: The wandering mind is restrained and held in its place.
The True Name is enshrined in the mind. ||4||
The exciting and intoxicating worldly plays come to an end,
for those who accept the Guru's Teachings, and become lovingly attuned to the One Lord.
Seeing this, the fire in the water is extinguished.
They alone realize this, who are blessed by great good fortune. ||5||
Serving the True Guru, doubt is dispelled.
Those who are lovingly attuned to the True Lord remain awake and aware night and day.
They know the One Lord, and no other.
Serving the Giver of peace, they become immaculate. ||6||
Selfless service and intuitive awareness come by reflecting upon the Word of the Shabad.
Chanting, intensive meditation and austere self-discipline come by subduing the ego.
One becomes Jivan-mukta - liberated while yet alive, by listening to the Shabad.
Living a truthful way of life, one finds true peace. ||7||
The Giver of peace is the Eradicator of pain.
I cannot conceive of serving any other.

1343.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
1343.t: tan man dhan har aagai raakhiaa ||
1343.e: I place my body, mind and wealth in offering before Him.
Says Nanak, I have tasted the supreme, sublime Essence of the Lord. ||8||2||
Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1343.g: ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਭੁਅੰਗਮ ਭਾਠੀ ਰੇਚਕ ਪੂਰਕ ਕੁੰਭ ਕਰੈ ॥
1343.t: nivalee karam bhua(n)gam bhaaThee rechak poorak ku(n)bh karai ||
1343.e: You may perform exercises of inner purification, and fire up the furnace of the Kundalini, inhaling and exhaling and holding the breath.

1343.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਬੂਡਿ ਮਰੈ ॥
1343.t: bin satigur kichh sojhee naahee bharame bhoolaa boodd marai ||
1343.e: Without the True Guru, you will not understand; deluded by doubt, you shall drown and die.

1343.g: ਅੰਧਾ ਭਰਿਆ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
1343.t: a(n)dhaa bhariaa bhar bhar dhovai a(n)tar kee mal kadhe na lahai ||
1343.e: The spiritually blind are filled with filth and pollution; they may wash, but the filth within shall never depart.

1343.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਫੋਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਮਾ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੈ ॥੧॥
1343.t: naam binaa fokaT sabh karamaa jiau baajeegar bharam bhulai ||1||
1343.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all their actions are useless, like the magician who deceives through illuions. ||1||
The merits of the six religious rituals are obtained through the Immaculate Naam.

1343.g: ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1343.t: too gun saagar avagun mohee ||1|| rahaau ||
1343.e: You, O Lord, are the Ocean of virtue; I am so unworthy. ||1||Pause||

1343.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਣੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
1343.t: maiaa dha(n)dhaa dhaavanee dhuramat kaar bikaar ||
1343.e: Running around chasing the entanglements of Maya is an evil-minded act of corruption.

1343.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ਬੂਝਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
1343.t: moorakh aap ganaidhaa boojh na sakai kaar ||
1343.e: The fool makes a show of his self-conceit; he does not know how to behave.

1343.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲ ਖੁਆਰ ॥
1343.t: manasaa maiaa mohanee manmukh bol khuaar ||
1343.e: The self-willed manmukh is enticed by his desires for Maya; his words are useless and empty.

1343.g: ਮਜਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਚੰਡਾਲ ਕਾ ਫੋਕਟ ਚਾਰ ਸੀਂਗਾਰ ॥੨॥
1343.t: majan jhooThaa cha(n)ddaal kaa fokaT chaar see(n)gaar ||2||
1343.e: The ritual cleansings of the sinner are fradulent; his rituals and decorations are useless and empty. ||2||

1343.g: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ॥
1343.t: jhooThee man kee mat hai karanee baadh bibaadh ||
1343.e: False is the wisdom of the mind; its actions inspire useless disputes.

1343.g: ਝੂਠੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਹੰਕਰਣੁ ਹੈ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
1343.t: jhooThe vich aha(n)karan hai khasam na paavai saadh ||
1343.e: The false are filled with egotism; they do not obtain the sublime taste of their Lord and Master.

1343.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
1343.t: bin naavai hor kamaavanaa fikaa aavai saadh ||
1343.e: Without the Name, whatever else they do is tasteless and insipid.

1343.g: ਦੁਸਟੀ ਸਭਾ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਾਤੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੩॥
1343.t: dhusaTee sabhaa vigucheeaai bikh vaatee jeevan baadh ||3||
1343.e: Associating with their enemies, they are plundered and ruined. Their speech is poison, and their lives are useless. ||3||

1343.g: ਏ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1343.t: e bhram bhoole marahu na koiee ||
1343.e: Do not be deluded by doubt; do not invite your own death.
Serve the True Guru, and you shall be at peace forever.

1343.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1343.t: bin satigur mukat kinai na paiee ||
1343.e: Without the True Guru, no one is liberated.
They come and go in reincarnation; they die, only to be reborn and die again. ||4||

1343.g: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
1343.t: eh sareer hai trai gun dhaat ||
1343.e: This body wanders, caught in the three dispositions.
It is afflicted by sorrow and suffering.

1343.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੁ ॥
1343.t: so sevahu jis maiee na baap ||
1343.e: So serve the One who has no mother or father.
Desire and selfishness shall depart from within. ||5||

1343.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
1343.t: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh teh soiee ||
1343.e: Wherever I look, I see Him.

1343.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1343.t: bin satigur bheTe mukat na hoiee ||
1343.e: Without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.
Enshrine the True One in your heart; this is the most excellent action.
All other hypocritical actions and devotions bring only ruin. ||6||
When one is rid of duality, then he realizes the Word of the Shabad.
Inside and out, he knows the One Lord.
This is the most Excellent Wisdom of the Shabad.
Ashes fall on the heads of those who are in duality. ||7||
To praise the Lord through the Guru's Teachings is the most excellent action.
In the Society of the Saints, contemplate the Glories of God and His spiritual wisdom.
Whoever subdues his mind, knows the state of being dead while yet alive.
O Nanak, by His Grace, the Gracious Lord is realized. ||8||3||

1344.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
1344.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa dhakhanee ||
1344.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla, Dakhnee:

1344.g: ਗੋਤਮੁ ਤਪਾ ਅਹਿਲਿਆ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
1344.t: gotam tapaa ahiliaa isatree tis dhekh i(n)dhr lubhaiaa ||
1344.e: Ahalyaa was the wife of Gautam the seer. Seeing her, Indra was enticed.

1344.g: ਸਹਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਚਿਹਨ ਭਗ ਹੂਏ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1344.t: sahas sareer chihan bhag hooe taa man pachhotaiaa ||1||
1344.e: When he received a thousand marks of disgrace on his body, then he felt regret in his mind. ||1||

1344.g: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਭੂਲੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
1344.t: koiee jaan na bhoolai bhaiee ||
1344.e: O Siblings of Destiny, no one knowingly makes mistakes.

1344.g: ਸੋ ਭੂਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1344.t: so bhoolai jis aap bhulaae boojhai jisai bujhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1344.e: He alone is mistaken, whom the Lord Himself makes so. He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand. ||1||Pause||

1344.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰੀ ਚੰਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੈ ਕਾਗਦਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1344.t: tin haree cha(n)dh pirathamee pat raajai kaagadh keem na paiee ||
1344.e: Harichand, the king and ruler of his land, did not appreciate the value of his pre-ordained destiny.

1344.g: ਅਉਗਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਿਉ ਨੇਖਾਸਿ ਬਿਕਾਈ ॥੨॥
1344.t: aaugan jaanai ta pu(n)n kare kiau kiau nekhaas bikaiee ||2||
1344.e: If he had known that it was a mistake, he would not have made such a show of giving in charity, and he would not have been sold in the market. ||2||

1344.g: ਕਰਉ ਅਢਾਈ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਂਗੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪਿ ਬਹਾਨੈ ॥
1344.t: karau addaiee dharatee maa(n)gee baavan roop bahaanai ||
1344.e: The Lord took the form of a dwarf, and asked for some land.

1344.g: ਕਿਉ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਉ ਛਲੀਐ ਜੇ ਬਲਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
1344.t: kiau piaal jai kiau chhaleeaai je bal roop pachhaanai ||3||
1344.e: If Bal the king has recognized Him, he would not have been deceived, and sent to the underworld. ||3||

1344.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਦੇ ਮਤਂੀ ਬਰਜਿ ਬਿਆਸਿ ਪੜੑਾਇਆ ॥
1344.t: raajaa janamejaa dhe mata(n)ee baraj biaas paR(h)aiaa ||
1344.e: Vyaas taught and warned the king Janmayjaa not to do three things.

1344.g: ਤਿਨਿੑ ਕਰਿ ਜਗ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਘਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1344.t: tini(h) kar jag aThaareh ghaae kirat na chalai chalaiaa ||4||
1344.e: But he performed the sacred feast and killed eighteen Brahmins; the record of one's past deeds cannot be erased. ||4||

1344.g: ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣਂੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਬੋਲੀ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
1344.t: ganat na gana(n)ee hukam pachhaanaa bolee bhai subhaiee ||
1344.e: I do not try to calculate the account; I accept the Hukam of God's Command. I speak with intuitive love and respect.

1344.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਲਾਹਂੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੫॥
1344.t: jo kichh varatai tudhai salaaha(n)ee sabh teree vaddiaaiee ||5||
1344.e: No matter what happens, I will praise the Lord. It is all Your Glorious Greatness, O Lord. ||5||

1344.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
1344.t: gurmukh alipat lep kadhe na laagai sadhaa rahai saranaiee ||
1344.e: The Gurmukh remains detached; filth never attaches itself to him. He remains forever in God's Sanctuary.

1344.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੬॥
1344.t: manmukh mugadh aagai chetai naahee dhukh laagai pachhutaiee ||6||
1344.e: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not think of the future; he is overtaken by pain, and then he regrets. ||6||

1344.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਚੀਐ ॥
1344.t: aape kare karaae karataa jin eh rachanaa racheeaai ||
1344.e: The Creator who created this creation acts, and causes all to act.

1344.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੇ ਪੈ ਪਚੀਐ ॥੭॥
1344.t: har abhimaan na jaiee jeeahu abhimaane pai pacheeaai ||7||
1344.e: O Lord, egotistical pride does not depart from the soul. Falling into egotistical pride, one is ruined. ||7||

1344.g: ਭੁਲਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ॥
1344.t: bhulan vich keeaa sabh koiee karataa aap na bhulai ||
1344.e: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Creator does not make mistakes.

1344.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਘੁਲੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
1344.t: naanak sach naam nisataaraa ko gur parasaadh aghulai ||8||4||
1344.e: O Nanak, salvation comes through the True Name. By Guru's Grace, one is released. ||8||4||

1344.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1344.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1344.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1344.g: ਆਖਣਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
1344.t: aakhanaa sunanaa naam adhaar ||
1344.e: To chant and listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my Support.

1344.g: ਧੰਧਾ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ॥
1344.t: dha(n)dhaa chhuTak giaa vekaar ||
1344.e: Worthless entanglements are ended and gone.

1344.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
1344.t: jiau manmukh dhoojai pat khoiee ||
1344.e: The self-willed manmukh, caught in duality, loses his honor.

1344.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
1344.t: bin naavai mai avar na koiee ||1||
1344.e: Except for the Name, I have no other at all. ||1||

1344.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
1344.t: sun man a(n)dhe moorakh gavaar ||
1344.e: Listen, O blind, foolish, idiotic mind.

1344.g: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਲਾਜ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਡੈ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1344.t: aavat jaat laaj nahee laagai bin gur booddai baaro baar ||1|| rahaau ||
1344.e: Aren't you ashamed of your comings and goings in reincarnation? Without the Guru, you shall drown, over and over again. ||1||Pause||

1344.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
1344.t: eis man maiaa moh binaas ||
1344.e: This mind is ruined by its attachment to Maya.

1344.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਸੁ ॥
1344.t: dhur hukam likhiaa taa(n) kaheeaai kaas ||
1344.e: The Command of the Primal Lord is pre-ordained. Before whom should I cry?

1344.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
1344.t: gurmukh viralaa cheen(h)ai koiee ||
1344.e: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.

1344.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
1344.t: naam bihoonaa mukat na hoiee ||2||
1344.e: Without the Naam, no one is liberated. ||2||

1344.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਡੋਲੈ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ॥
1344.t: bhram bhram ddolai lakh chauraasee ||
1344.e: People wander lost, staggering and stumbling through 8.4 million incarnations.

1344.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
1344.t: bin gur boojhe jam kee faasee ||
1344.e: Without knowing the Guru, they cannot escape the noose of Death.

1344.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
1344.t: eih manooaa khin khin uoobh piaal ||
1344.e: This mind, from one moment to the next, goes from the heavens to the underworld.

1344.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
1344.t: gurmukh chhooTai naam sam(h)aal ||3||
1344.e: The Gurmukh contemplates the Naam, and is released. ||3||

1344.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਦੇ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
1344.t: aape sadhe ddil na hoi ||
1344.e: When God sends His Summons, there is no time to delay.

1344.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
1344.t: sabadh marai sahilaa jeevai soi ||
1344.e: When one dies in the Word of the Shabad, he lives in peace.

1344.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
1344.t: bin gur sojhee kisai na hoi ||
1344.e: Without the Guru, no one understands.

1344.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
1344.t: aape karai karaavai soi ||4||
1344.e: The Lord Himself acts, and inspires all to act. ||4||

1344.g: ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
1344.t: jhagaR chukaavai har gun gaavai ||
1344.e: Inner conflict comes to an end, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

1344.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
1344.t: pooraa satigur sahaj samaavai ||
1344.e: Through the Perfect True Guru, one is intuitively absorbed into the Lord.

1344.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਤਉ ਠਹਰਾਵੈ ॥
1344.t: eih man ddolat tau Thaharaavai ||
1344.e: This wobbling, unsteady mind is stabilized,

1344.g: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
1344.t: sach karanee kar kaar kamaavai ||5||
1344.e: and one lives the lifestyle of true actions. ||5||

1344.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੂਠਾ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
1344.t: a(n)tar jooThaa kiau such hoi ||
1344.e: If someone is false within his own self, then how can he be pure?

1344.g: ਸਬਦੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
1344.t: sabadhee dhovai viralaa koi ||
1344.e: How rare are those who wash with the Shabad.

1344.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
1344.t: gurmukh koiee sach kamaavai ||
1344.e: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, live the Truth.

1344.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
1344.t: aavan jaanaa Thaak rahaavai ||6||
1344.e: Their comings and goings in reincarnation are over and done. ||6||

1345.g: ਭਉ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
1345.t: bhau khaanaa peenaa sukh saar ||
1345.e: Those who eat and drink the Fear of God, find the most excellent peace.

1345.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
1345.t: har jan sa(n)gat paavai paar ||
1345.e: Associating with the humble servants of the Lord, they are carried across.

1345.g: ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1345.t: sach bolai bolaavai piaar ||
1345.e: They speak the Truth, and lovingly inspire others to speak it as well.

1345.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
1345.t: gur kaa sabadh karanee hai saar ||7||
1345.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the most excellent occupation. ||7||

1345.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
1345.t: har jas karam dharam pat poojaa ||
1345.e: Those who take the Lord's Praises as their karma and Dharma, their honor and worship service

1345.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਭੂੰਜਾ ॥
1345.t: kaam karodh aganee meh bhoo(n)jaa ||
1345.e: their sexual desire and anger are burnt off in the fire.

1345.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ ॥
1345.t: har ras chaakhiaa tau man bheejaa ||
1345.e: They taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and their minds are drenched with it.

1345.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੮॥੫॥
1345.t: pranavat naanak avar na dhoojaa ||8||5||
1345.e: Prays Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||5||

1345.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1345.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1345.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1345.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
1345.t: raam naam jap a(n)tar poojaa ||
1345.e: Chant the Lord's Name, and worship Him deep within your being.

1345.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
1345.t: gur sabadh veechaar avar nahee dhoojaa ||1||
1345.e: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and no other. ||1||

1345.g: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
1345.t: eko rav rahiaa sabh Thaiee ||
1345.e: The One is pervading all places.

1345.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1345.t: avar na dheesai kis pooj chaRaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1345.e: I do not see any other; unto whom should I offer worship? ||1||Pause||

1345.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਤੁਝ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
1345.t: man tan aagai jeeaRaa tujh paas ||
1345.e: I place my mind and body in offering before You; I dedicate my soul to You.

1345.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
1345.t: jiau bhaavai tiau rakhahu aradhaas ||2||
1345.e: As it pleases You, You save me, Lord; this is my prayer. ||2||

1345.g: ਸਚੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥
1345.t: sach jihavaa har rasan rasaiee ||
1345.e: True is that tongue which is delighted by the sublime essence of the Lord.

1345.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
1345.t: gurmat chhooTas prabh saranaiee ||3||
1345.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, one is saved in the Sanctuary of God. ||3||

1345.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਕੀਏ ॥
1345.t: karam dharam prabh merai ke'ee ||
1345.e: My God created religious rituals.

1345.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਕੀਏ ॥੪॥
1345.t: naam vaddaiee sir karamaa(n) ke'ee ||4||
1345.e: He placed the glory of the Naam above these rituals. ||4||

1345.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ॥
1345.t: satigur kai vas chaar padhaarath ||
1345.e: The four great blessings are under the control of the True Guru.

1345.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥ ॥੫॥
1345.t: teen samaae ek kirataarath ||5||
1345.e: When the first three are put aside, one is blessed with the fourth. ||5||

1345.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਏ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
1345.t: satigur dhe'ee mukat dhiaanaa(n) ||
1345.e: Those whom the True Guru blesses with liberation and meditation

1345.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਭਏ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
1345.t: har padh cheeni(h) bhe paradhaanaa ||6||
1345.e: realize the Lord's State, and become sublime. ||6||

1345.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1345.t: man tan seetal gur boojh bujhaiee ||
1345.e: Their minds and bodies are cooled and soothed; the Guru imparts this understanding.

1345.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
1345.t: prabh nivaaje kin keemat paiee ||7||
1345.e: Who can estimate the value of those whom God has exalted? ||7||

1345.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1345.t: kahu naanak gur boojh bujhaiee ||
1345.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has imparted this understanding;

1345.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥
1345.t: naam binaa gat kinai na paiee ||8||6||
1345.e: without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is emancipated. ||8||6||

1345.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1345.t: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1345.e: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

1345.g: ਇਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
1345.t: eik dhur bakhas le gur poorai sachee banat banaiee ||
1345.e: Some are forgiven by the Primal Lord God; the Perfect Guru makes the true making.

1345.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
1345.t: har ra(n)g raate sadhaa ra(n)g saachaa dhukh bisare pat paiee ||1||
1345.e: Those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord are imbued with Truth forever; their pains are dispelled, and they obtain honor. ||1||

1345.g: ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
1345.t: jhooThee dhuramat kee chaturaiee ||
1345.e: False are the clever tricks of the evil-minded.

1345.g: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1345.t: binasat baar na laagai kaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1345.e: They shall disappear in no time at all. ||1||Pause||

1345.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਿਆਪਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1345.t: manmukh kau dhukh dharadh viaapas manmukh dhukh na jaiee ||
1345.e: Pain and suffering afflict the self-willed manmukh. The pains of the self-willed manmukh shall never depart.

1345.g: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
1345.t: sukh dhukh dhaataa gurmukh jaataa mel le saranaiee ||2||
1345.e: The Gurmukh recognizes the Giver of pleasure and pain. He merges in His Sanctuary. ||2||

1345.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਅਭ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਸਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚਹਿ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
1345.t: manmukh te abh bhagat na hovas haumai pacheh dhivaane ||
1345.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not know loving devotional worship; they are insane, rotting away in their egotism.

1345.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭਿ ਪਇਆਲੀ ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
1345.t: eih manooaa khin uoobh piaalee jab lag sabadh na jaane ||3||
1345.e: This mind flies in an instant from the heavens to the underworld, as long as it does not know the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

1345.g: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਜਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ॥
1345.t: bhookh piaasaa jag bhiaa tipat nahee bin satigur paae ||
1345.e: The world has become hungry and thirsty; without the True Guru, it is not satisfied.

1345.g: ਸਹਜੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥
1345.t: sahajai sahaj milai sukh paieeaai dharageh paidhaa jaae ||4||
1345.e: Merging intuitively in the Celestial Lord, peace is obtained, and one goes to the Lord's Court wearing robes of honor. ||4||

1345.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1345.t: dharageh dhaanaa beenaa ik aape niramal gur kee baanee ||
1345.e: The Lord in His Court is Himself the Knower and Seer; the Word of the Guru's Bani is Immaculate.

1345.g: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
1345.t: aape surataa sach veechaaras aape boojhai padh nirabaanee ||5||
1345.e: He Himself is the Awareness of Truth; He Himself understands the state of nirvaanaa. ||5||

1345.g: ਜਲੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਵਨੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
1345.t: jal tara(n)g aganee pavanai fun trai mil jagat upaiaa ||
1345.e: He made the waves of water, the fire and the air, and then joined the three together to form the world.

1345.g: ਐਸਾ ਬਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
1345.t: aaisaa bal chhal tin kau dheeaa hukamee Thaak rahaiaa ||6||
1345.e: He blessed these elements with such power, that they remain subject to His Command. ||6||

1345.g: ਐਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1345.t: aaise jan virale jag a(n)dhar parakh khajaanai paiaa ||
1345.e: How rare are those humble beings in this world, whom the Lord tests and places in His Treasury.

1345.g: ਜਾਤਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
1345.t: jaat varan te bhe ateetaa mamataa lobh chukaiaa ||7||
1345.e: They rise above social status and color, and rid themselves of possessiveness and greed. ||7||

1345.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
1345.t: naam rate teerath se niramal dhukh haumai mail chukaiaa ||
1345.e: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are like immaculate sacred shrines; they are rid of the pain and pollution of egotism.

1345.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੭॥
1345.t: naanak tin ke charan pakhaalai jinaa gurmukh saachaa bhaiaa ||8||7||
1345.e: Nanak washes the feet of those who, as Gurmukh, love the True Lord. ||8||7||

1346.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਬਿਭਾਸ
1346.t: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa bibhaas
1346.e: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla, Bibhaas:

1346.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1346.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1346.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1346.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵੇਖੁ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1346.t: gur parasaadhee vekh too har ma(n)dhar terai naal ||
1346.e: By Guru's Grace, see that the Temple of the Lord is within you.

1346.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
1346.t: har ma(n)dhar sabadhe khojeeaai har naamo leh sam(h)aal ||1||
1346.e: The Temple of the Lord is found through the Word of the Shabad; contemplate the Lord's Name. ||1||

1346.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1346.t: man mere sabadh rapai ra(n)g hoi ||
1346.e: O my mind, be joyfully attuned to the Shabad.

1346.g: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1346.t: sachee bhagat sachaa har ma(n)dhar pragaTee saachee soi ||1|| rahaau ||
1346.e: True is devotional worship, and True is the Temple of the Lord; True is His Manifest Glory. ||1||Pause||

1346.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1346.t: har ma(n)dhar eh sareer hai giaan ratan paragaT hoi ||
1346.e: This body is the Temple of the Lord, in which the jewel of spiritual wisdom is revealed.

1346.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਾਣਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
1346.t: manmukh mool na jaananee maanas har ma(n)dhar na hoi ||2||
1346.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not know anything at all; they do not believe that the Lord's Temple is within. ||2||

1346.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
1346.t: har ma(n)dhar har jeeau saajiaa rakhiaa hukam savaar ||
1346.e: The Dear Lord created the Temple of the Lord; He adorns it by His Will.

1346.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
1346.t: dhur lekh likhiaa su kamaavanaa koi na meTanahaar ||3||
1346.e: All act according to their pre-ordained destiny; no one can erase it. ||3||

1346.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
1346.t: sabadh cheeni(h) sukh paiaa sachai nai piaar ||
1346.e: Contemplating the Shabad, peace is obtained, loving the True Name.

1346.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
1346.t: har ma(n)dhar sabadhe sohanaa ka(n)chan koT apaar ||4||
1346.e: The Temple of the Lord is embellished with the Shabad; it is an Infinite Fortress of God. ||4||

1346.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੰਧਾਰ ॥
1346.t: har ma(n)dhar eh jagat hai gur bin ghora(n)dhaar ||
1346.e: This world is the Temple of the Lord; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

1346.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
1346.t: dhoojaa bhaau kar poojadhe manmukh a(n)dh gavaar ||5||
1346.e: The blind and foolish self-willed manmukhs worship in the love of duality. ||5||

1346.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਦੇਹ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1346.t: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeaai tithai dheh jaat na jai ||
1346.e: One's body and social status do not go along to that place, where all are called to account.

1346.g: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੬॥
1346.t: saach rate se ubare dhukhe'ee dhoojai bhai ||6||
1346.e: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; those in the love of duality are miserable. ||6||

1346.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
1346.t: har ma(n)dhar meh naam nidhaan hai naa boojheh mugadh gavaar ||
1346.e: The treasure of the Naam is within the Temple of the Lord. The idiotic fools do not realize this.

1346.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
1346.t: gur parasaadhee cheeni(h)aa har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||7||
1346.e: By Guru's Grace, I have realized this. I keep the Lord enshrined within my heart. ||7||

1346.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
1346.t: gur kee baanee gur te jaatee j sabadh rate ra(n)g lai ||
1346.e: Those who are attuned to the love of the Shabad know the Guru, through the Word of the Guru's Bani.

1346.g: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥
1346.t: pavit paavan se jan niramal har kai naam samai ||8||
1346.e: Sacred, pure and immaculate are those humble beings who are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||8||

1346.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਟੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
1346.t: har ma(n)dhar har kaa haaT hai rakhiaa sabadh savaar ||
1346.e: The Temple of the Lord is the Lord's Shop; He embellishes it with the Word of His Shabad.

1346.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
1346.t: tis vich saudhaa ek naam gurmukh lain savaar ||9||
1346.e: In that shop is the merchandise of the One Name; the Gurmukhs adorn themselves with it. ||9||

1346.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਹਟੁ ਹੈ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
1346.t: har ma(n)dhar meh man lohaT hai mohiaa dhoojai bhai ||
1346.e: The mind is like iron slag, within the Temple of the Lord; it is lured by the love of duality.

1346.g: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
1346.t: paaras bheTiaai ka(n)chan bhiaa keemat kahee na jai ||10||
1346.e: Meeting with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, the mind is transformed into gold. Its value cannot be described. ||10||

1346.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
1346.t: har ma(n)dhar meh har vasai sarab nira(n)tar soi ||
1346.e: The Lord abides within the Temple of the Lord. He is pervading in all.

1346.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧॥੧॥
1346.t: naanak gurmukh vanajeeaai sachaa saudhaa hoi ||11||1||
1346.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs trade in the merchandise of Truth. ||11||1||

1346.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1346.t: prabhaatee mahalaa teejaa ||
1346.e: Prabhaatee, Third Mehla:

1346.g: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗ੍ਰਣ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
1346.t: bhai bhai jaage se jan jaagran kareh haumai mail utaar ||
1346.e: Those who remain awake and aware in the Love and Fear of God, rid themselves of the filth and pollution of egotism.

1346.g: ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਕਾਢਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
1346.t: sadhaa jaageh ghar apanaa raakheh pa(n)ch tasakar kaaddeh maar ||1||
1346.e: They remain awake and aware forever, and protect their homes, by beating and driving out the five thieves. ||1||

1346.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
1346.t: man mere gurmukh naam dhiaai ||
1346.e: O my mind, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1346.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1346.t: jit maarag har paieeaai man seiee karam kamai ||1|| rahaau ||
1346.e: O mind, do only those deeds which will lead you to the Path of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1346.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
1346.t: gurmukh sahaj dhun uoopajai dhukh haumai vichahu jai ||
1346.e: The celestial melody wells up in the Gurmukh, and the pains of egotism are taken away.

1346.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
1346.t: har naamaa har man vasai sahaje har gun gai ||2||
1346.e: The Name of the Lord abides in the mind, as one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

1346.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1346.t: gurmatee mukh sohane har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
1346.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings - their faces are radiant and beautiful. They keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

1346.g: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
1346.t: aaithai othai sukh ghanaa jap har har utare paar ||3||
1346.e: Here and hereafter, they find absolute peace; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are carried across to the other shore. ||3||

1347.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਗ੍ਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
1347.t: haumai vich jaagran na hoviee har bhagat na paviee thai ||
1347.e: In egotism, one cannot remain awake and aware, and one's devotional worship of the Lord is not accepted.

1347.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਹਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
1347.t: manmukh dhar ddoiee naa laheh bhai dhoojai karam kamai ||4||
1347.e: The self-willed manmukhs find no place in the Court of the Lord; they do their deeds in the love of duality. ||4||

1347.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਾ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1347.t: dhirag khaanaa dhirag pain(h)naa jin(h)aa dhoojai bhai piaar ||
1347.e: Cursed is the food, and cursed are the clothes, of those who are attached to the love of duality.

1347.g: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥
1347.t: bisaTaa ke keeRe bisaTaa raate mar ja(n)meh hoh khuaar ||5||
1347.e: They are like maggots in manure, sinking into manure. In death and rebirth, they are wasted away to ruin. ||5||

1347.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
1347.t: jin kau satigur bheTiaa tinaa viTahu bal jaau ||
1347.e: I am a sacrifice to those who meet with the True Guru.

1347.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੬॥
1347.t: tin kee sa(n)gat mil rahaa(n) sache sach samaau ||6||
1347.e: I shall continue to associate with them; devoted to Truth, I am absorbed in Truth. ||6||

1347.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
1347.t: poorai bhaag gur paieeaai upai kitai na paiaa jai ||
1347.e: By perfect destiny, the Guru is found. He cannot be found by any efforts.

1347.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
1347.t: satigur te sahaj uoopajai haumai sabadh jalai ||7||
1347.e: Through the True Guru, intuitive wisdom wells up; through the Word of the Shabad, egotism is burnt away. ||7||

1347.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
1347.t: har saranaiee bhaj man mere sabh kichh karanai jog ||
1347.e: O my mind, hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord; He is Potent to do everything.

1347.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੭॥੨॥੯॥
1347.t: naanak naam na veesarai jo kichh karai su hog ||8||2||7||2||9||
1347.e: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Whatever He does, comes to pass. ||8||2||7||2||9||
Bibhaas, Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse
involved with them, people eat the food of bliss.
The mind is entangled in sweet emotional attachment.
Those who seek God's Glorious Virtues are the support of my breath of life. ||1||
My One Lord is the Inner-Knower, the Searcher of hearts.

1347.g: ਧਰ ਏਕਾ ਮੈ ਟਿਕ ਏਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1347.t: dhar ekaa mai Tik ekas kee sir saahaa vadd purakh suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
1347.e: He alone is my Support; He is my only Protection. My Great Lord and Master is over and above the heads of kings. ||1||Pause||

1347.g: ਛਲ ਨਾਗਨਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਟੂਟਨਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
1347.t: chhal naagan siau meree TooTan hoiee ||
1347.e: I have broken my ties to that deceitful serpent.
The Guru has told me that it is false and fraudulent.
Its face is sweet, but it tastes very bitter.
My mind remains satisfied with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
I have broken my ties with greed and emotional attachment.
The Merciful Guru has rescued me from them.
These cheating thieves have plundered so many homes.
The Merciful Guru has protected and saved me. ||3||

1347.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸਿਉ ਠਾਟੁ ਨ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
1347.t: kaam karodh siau ThaaT na baniaa ||
1347.e: I have no dealings whatsoever with sexual desire and anger.
I listen to the Guru's Teachings.
Wherever I look, I see the most horrible goblins.
My Guru, the Lord of the World, has saved me from them. ||4||
I have made widows of the ten sensory organs.
The Guru has told me that these pleasures are the fires of corruption.
Those who associate with them go to hell.

1347.g: ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
1347.t: ham gur raakhe har liv lai ||5||
1347.e: The Guru has saved me; I am lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||5||
I have forsaken the advice of my ego.
The Guru has told me that this is foolish stubbornness.

1347.g: ਇਹੁ ਨੀਘਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
1347.t: eih neeghar ghar kahee na paae ||
1347.e: This ego is homeless; it shall never find a home.

1347.g: ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
1347.t: ham gur raakh le'ee liv laae ||6||
1347.e: The Guru has saved me; I am lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||6||

1347.g: ਇਨ ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ ਹਮ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
1347.t: ein logan siau ham bhe bairaiee ||
1347.e: I have become alienated from these people.

1347.g: ਏਕ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਖਟਾਂਈ ॥
1347.t: ek gireh meh dhui na khaTaa(n)iee ||
1347.e: We cannot both live together in one home.
Grasping the hem of the Guru's Robe, I have come to God.
Please be fair with me, All-knowing Lord God. ||7||
God smiled at me and spoke, passing judgement.
He made all the demons perform service for me.

1347.g: ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
1347.t: too(n) Thaakur ih girahu sabh teraa ||
1347.e: You are my Lord and Master; all this home belongs to You.
Says Nanak, the Guru has passed judgement. ||8||1||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:

1348.e: Within the mind dwell anger and massive ego.
Worship services are performed with great pomp and ceremony.
Ritual cleansing baths are taken, and sacred marks are applied to the body.
