1348.g: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
1348.t: a(n)tar kee mal kab hee na jaae ||1||
1348.e: But still, the filth and pollution within never depart. ||1||

1348.g: ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1348.t: eit sa(n)jam prabh kin hee na paiaa ||
1348.e: No one has ever found God in this way.

1348.g: ਭਗਉਤੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1348.t: bhagautee mudhraa man mohiaa maiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1348.e: The sacred mudras - ritualistic hand gestures - are made, but the mind remains enticed by Maya. ||1||Pause||

1348.g: ਪਾਪ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੰਚਾਂ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
1348.t: paap kareh pa(n)chaa(n) ke bas re ||
1348.e: They commit sins, under the influence of the five thieves.
They bathe at sacred shrines, and claim that everything has been washed off.
Then they commit them again, without fear of the consequences.
The sinners are bound and gagged, and taken to the City of Death. ||2||
The ankle-bells shake and the cymbals vibrate,
but those who have deception within wander lost like demons.
By destroying its hole, the snake is not killed.

1348.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
1348.t: prabh sabh kichh jaanai jin too keeaa ||3||
1348.e: God, who created you, knows everything. ||3||
You worship fire and wear saffron colored robes.

1348.g: ਅਪਦਾ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤੇ ਨਸਤਾ ॥
1348.t: apadhaa kaa maariaa gireh te nasataa ||
1348.e: Stung by your misfortune, you abandon your home.
Leaving your own country, you wander in foreign lands.
But you bring the five rejects with you. ||4||
You have split your ears, and now you steal crumbs.

1348.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਨ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ ॥
1348.t: ghar ghar maa(n)gai tirapataavan te chookaa ||
1348.e: You beg from door to door, but you fail to be satisfied.

1348.g: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਦ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
1348.t: banitaa chhodd badh nadhar par naaree ||
1348.e: You have abandoned your own wife, but now you sneak glances at other women.
God is not found by wearing religious robes; you are utterly miserable! ||5||
He does not speak; he is on silence.
But he is filled with desire; he is made to wander in reincarnation.

1348.g: ਅੰਨ ਤੇ ਰਹਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
1348.t: a(n)n te rahataa dhukh dhehee sahataa ||
1348.e: Abstaining from food, his body suffers in pain.
He does not realize the Hukam of the Lord's Command; he is afflicted by possessiveness. ||6||

1348.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥
1348.t: bin satigur kinai na paiee param gate ||
1348.e: Without the True Guru, no one has attained the supreme status.
Go ahead and ask all the Vedas and the Simritees.
The self-willed manmukhs do useless deeds.

1348.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਈ ॥੭॥
1348.t: jiau baaloo ghar Thaur na Thaiee ||7||
1348.e: They are like a house of sand, which cannot stand. ||7||
One unto whom the Lord of the Universe becomes Merciful,

1348.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਪਾਲਾ ॥
1348.t: gur kaa bachan tin baadhio paalaa ||
1348.e: sews the Word of the Guru's Shabad into his robes.
Out of millions, it is rare that such a Saint is seen.
O Nanak, with him, we are carried across. ||8||

1348.g: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
1348.t: je hovai bhaag taa dharasan paieeaai ||
1348.e: If one has such good destiny, then the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained.

1348.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤਰਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
1348.t: aap tarai sabh kuTa(n)b taraieeaai ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||2||
1348.e: He saves himself, and carries across all his family as well. ||1||SECOND PAUSE||2||
Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehla:
Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, all the sins are erased.
The accounts held by the Righteous Judge of Dharma are torn up.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
I have found the Sublime Essence of the Lord. The Supreme Lord God has melted into my heart. ||1||

1348.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1348.t: raam ramat har har sukh paiaa ||
1348.e: Dwelling on the Lord, Har, Har, I have found peace.
Your slaves seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||Pause||
The cycle of reincarnation is ended, and darkness is dispelled.
The Guru has revealed the door of liberation.

1348.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਦ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
1348.t: har prem bhagat man tan sadh raataa ||
1348.e: My mind and body are forever imbued with loving devotion to the Lord.
Now I know God, because He has made me know Him. ||2||
He is contained in each and every heart.
Without Him, there is no one at all.
Hatred, conflict, fear and doubt have been eliminated.
God, the Soul of Pure Goodness, has manifested His Righteousness. ||3||
He has rescued me from the most dangerous waves.
Separated from Him for countless lifetimes, I am united with Him once again.
Chanting, intense meditation and strict self-discipline are the contemplation of the Naam.
My Lord and Master has blessed me with His Glance of Grace. ||4||
Bliss, peace and salvation are found in that place,

1349.e: where the servants of the Lord of the World abide.
God, the Lord of the World, is pleased and satisfied with me.
My disharmony with Him of so many lifetimes is ended. ||5||
Burnt offerings, sacred feasts, intense meditations with the body upside-down, worship services
and taking millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage
- the merits of all these are obtained by enshrining the Lord's Lotus Feet within the heart, even for an instant.
Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, all one's affairs are resolved. ||6||
God's Place is the highest of the high.
The Lord's humble servants intuitively focus their meditation on Him.
I long for the dust of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.
My Beloved Lord is overflowing with all powers. ||7||
My Beloved Lord, my Mother and Father, is always near.
O my Friend and Companion, You are my Trusted Support.
God takes His slaves by the hand, and makes them His Own.
Nanak lives by meditating on the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||8||3||2||7||12||

1349.g: ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ
1349.t: bibhaas prabhaatee baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee
1349.e: Bibhaas, Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
My anxious fears of death and rebirth have been taken away.
The Celestial Lord has shown His Love for me. ||1||
The Divine Light has dawned, and darkness has been dispelled.

1349.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1349.t: raam ratan paiaa karat beechaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
1349.e: Contemplating the Lord, I have obtained the Jewel of His Name. ||1||Pause||
Pain runs far away from that place where there is bliss.
The jewel of the mind is focused and attuned to the essence of reality. ||2||

1349.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
1349.t: jo kichh hoaa su teraa bhaanaa ||
1349.e: Whatever happens is by the Pleasure of Your Will.

1349.g: ਜੋ ਇਵ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
1349.t: jo iv boojhai su sahaj samaanaa ||3||
1349.e: Whoever understands this, is intuitively merged in the Lord. ||3||
Says Kabeer, my sins have been obliterated.
My mind has merged into the Lord, the Life of the World. ||4||1||
Prabhaatee:

1349.g: ਅਲਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਮੁਲਖੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
1349.t: alahu ek maseet basat hai avar mulakh kis keraa ||
1349.e: If the Lord Allah lives only in the mosque, then to whom does the rest of the world belong?

1349.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਦੁਹ ਮਹਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
1349.t: hi(n)dhoo moorat naam nivaasee dhuh meh tat na heraa ||1||
1349.e: According to the Hindus, the Lord's Name abides in the idol, but there is no truth in either of these claims. ||1||
O Allah, O Raam, I live by Your Name.
Please show mercy to me, O Master. ||1||Pause||

1349.g: ਦਖਨ ਦੇਸਿ ਹਰੀ ਕਾ ਬਾਸਾ ਪਛਿਮਿ ਅਲਹ ਮੁਕਾਮਾ ॥
1349.t: dhakhan dhes haree kaa baasaa pachhim aleh mukaamaa ||
1349.e: The God of the Hindus lives in the southern lands, and the God of the Muslims lives in the west.

1349.g: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਦਿਲੈ ਦਿਲਿ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਏਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਮੁਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
1349.t: dhil meh khoj dhilai dhil khojahu ehee Thaur mukaamaa ||2||
1349.e: So search in your heart - look deep into your heart of hearts; this is the home and the place where God lives. ||2||

1349.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨ ਗਿਆਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਉਬੀਸਾ ਕਾਜੀ ਮਹ ਰਮਜਾਨਾ ॥
1349.t: brahaman giaas kareh chaubeesaa kaajee meh ramajaanaa ||
1349.e: The Brahmins observe twenty-four fasts during the year, and the Muslims fast during the month of Ramadaan.

1349.g: ਗਿਆਰਹ ਮਾਸ ਪਾਸ ਕੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਏਕੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
1349.t: giaareh maas paas kai raakhe ekai maeh nidhaanaa ||3||
1349.e: The Muslims set aside eleven months, and claim that the treasure is only in the one month. ||3||

1349.g: ਕਹਾ ਉਡੀਸੇ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਂਏਂ ॥
1349.t: kahaa uddeese majan keeaa kiaa maseet sir naa(n)e(n) ||
1349.e: What is the use of bathing at Orissa? Why do the Muslims bow their heads in the mosque?

1349.g: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਂਏਂ ॥੪॥
1349.t: dhil meh kapaT nivaaj gujaarai kiaa haj kaabai jaa(n)e(n) ||4||
1349.e: If someone has deception in his heart, what good is it for him to utter prayers? And what good is it for him to go on pilgrimage to Mecca? ||4||

1349.g: ਏਤੇ ਅਉਰਤ ਮਰਦਾ ਸਾਜੇ ਏ ਸਭ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
1349.t: ete aaurat maradhaa saaje e sabh roop tum(h)aare ||
1349.e: You fashioned all these men and women, Lord. All these are Your Forms.

1349.g: ਕਬੀਰੁ ਪੂੰਗਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਅਲਹ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
1349.t: kabeer poo(n)garaa raam aleh kaa sabh gur peer hamaare ||5||
1349.e: Kabeer is the child of God, Allah, Raam. All the Gurus and prophets are mine. ||5||

1349.g: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਨਰਵੈ ਪਰਹੁ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
1349.t: kahat kabeer sunahu nar naravai parahu ek kee saranaa ||
1349.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O men and women: seek the Sanctuary of the One.

1349.g: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਨਿਹਚੈ ਤਰਨਾ ॥੬॥੨॥
1349.t: keval naam japahu re praanee tab hee nihachai taranaa ||6||2||
1349.e: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortals, and you shall surely be carried across. ||6||2||
Prabhaatee:

1349.g: ਅਵਲਿ ਅਲਹ ਨੂਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਬੰਦੇ ॥
1349.t: aval aleh noor upaiaa kudharat ke sabh ba(n)dhe ||
1349.e: First, Allah created the Light; then, by His Creative Power, He made all mortal beings.

1349.g: ਏਕ ਨੂਰ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਕਉਨ ਭਲੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
1349.t: ek noor te sabh jag upajiaa kaun bhale ko ma(n)dhe ||1||
1349.e: From the One Light, the entire universe welled up. So who is good, and who is bad? ||1||

1350.g: ਲੋਗਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
1350.t: logaa bharam na bhoolahu bhaiee ||
1350.e: O people, O Siblings of Destiny, do not wander deluded by doubt.

1350.g: ਖਾਲਿਕੁ ਖਲਕ ਖਲਕ ਮਹਿ ਖਾਲਿਕੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1350.t: khaalik khalak khalak meh khaalik poor rahio srab Thaa(n)iee ||1|| rahaau ||
1350.e: The Creation is in the Creator, and the Creator is in the Creation, totally pervading and permeating all places. ||1||Pause||

1350.g: ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸਾਜਨਹਾਰੈ ॥
1350.t: maaTee ek anek bhaa(n)t kar saajee saajanahaarai ||
1350.e: The clay is the same, but the Fashioner has fashioned it in various ways.

1350.g: ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ਕੁੰਭਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
1350.t: naa kachh poch maaTee ke bhaa(n)dde naa kachh poch ku(n)bhaarai ||2||
1350.e: There is nothing wrong with the pot of clay - there is nothing wrong with the Potter. ||2||

1350.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
1350.t: sabh meh sachaa eko soiee tis kaa keeaa sabh kachh hoiee ||
1350.e: The One True Lord abides in all; by His making, everything is made.

1350.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
1350.t: hukam pachhaanai su eko jaanai ba(n)dhaa kaheeaai soiee ||3||
1350.e: Whoever realizes the Hukam of His Command, knows the One Lord. He alone is said to be the Lord's slave. ||3||

1350.g: ਅਲਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਗੁੜੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
1350.t: alahu alakh na jaiee lakhiaa gur guR dheenaa meeThaa ||
1350.e: The Lord Allah is Unseen; He cannot be seen. The Guru has blessed me with this sweet molasses.

1350.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਕਾ ਨਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
1350.t: keh kabeer meree sa(n)kaa naasee sarab nira(n)jan ddeeThaa ||4||3||
1350.e: Says Kabeer, my anxiety and fear have been taken away; I see the Immaculate Lord pervading everywhere. ||4||3||

1350.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
1350.t: prabhaatee ||
1350.e: Prabhaatee:

1350.g: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਹਹੁ ਮਤ ਝੂਠੇ ਝੂਠਾ ਜੋ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ॥
1350.t: bedh kateb kahahu mat jhooThe jhooThaa jo na bichaarai ||
1350.e: Do not say that the Vedas, the Bible and the Koran are false. Those who do not contemplate them are false.

1350.g: ਜਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ ਤਉ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਰਗੀ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
1350.t: jau sabh meh ek khudhai kahat hau tau kiau muragee maarai ||1||
1350.e: You say that the One Lord is in all, so why do you kill chickens? ||1||

1350.g: ਮੁਲਾਂ ਕਹਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
1350.t: mulaa(n) kahahu niaau khudhaiee ||
1350.e: O Mullah, tell me: is this God's Justice?

1350.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1350.t: tere man kaa bharam na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1350.e: The doubts of your mind have not been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

1350.g: ਪਕਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਨਿਆ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਾਟੀ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
1350.t: pakar jeeau aaniaa dheh binaasee maaTee kau bisamil keeaa ||
1350.e: You seize a living creature, and then bring it home and kill its body; you have killed only the clay.

1350.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਨਾਹਤ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਹੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਆ ॥੨॥
1350.t: jot saroop anaahat laagee kahu halaal kiaa keeaa ||2||
1350.e: The light of the soul passes into another form. So tell me, what have you killed? ||2||

1350.g: ਕਿਆ ਉਜੂ ਪਾਕੁ ਕੀਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਧੋਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
1350.t: kiaa ujoo paak keeaa muh dhoiaa kiaa maseet sir laiaa ||
1350.e: And what good are your purifications? Why do you bother to wash your face? And why do you bother to bow your head in the mosque?

1350.g: ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1350.t: jau dhil meh kapaT nivaaj gujaarahu kiaa haj kaabai jaiaa ||3||
1350.e: Your heart is full of hypocrisy; what good are your prayers or your pilgrimage to Mecca? ||3||

1350.g: ਤੂੰ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ ਪਾਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
1350.t: too(n) naapaak paak nahee soojhiaa tis kaa maram na jaaniaa ||
1350.e: You are impure; you do not understand the Pure Lord. You do not know His Mystery.

1350.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
1350.t: keh kabeer bhisat te chookaa dhojak siau man maaniaa ||4||4||
1350.e: Says Kabeer, you have missed out on paradise; your mind is set on hell. ||4||4||

1350.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ॥
1350.t: prabhaatee ||
1350.e: Prabhaatee:

1350.g: ਸੁੰਨ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਕਰ ਅਧਪਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
1350.t: su(n)n sa(n)dhiaa teree dhev dhevaakar adhapat aadh samaiee ||
1350.e: Hear my prayer, Lord; You are the Divine Light of the Divine, the Primal, All-pervading Master.

1350.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
1350.t: sidh samaadh a(n)t nahee paiaa laag rahe saranaiee ||1||
1350.e: The Siddhas in Samaadhi have not found Your limits. They hold tight to the Protection of Your Sanctuary. ||1||

1350.g: ਲੇਹੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
1350.t: leh aaratee ho purakh nira(n)jan satigur poojahu bhaiee ||
1350.e: Worship and adoration of the Pure, Primal Lord comes by worshipping the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

1350.g: ਠਾਢਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਨਿਗਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1350.t: Thaaddaa brahamaa nigam beechaarai alakh na lakhiaa jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1350.e: Standing at His Door, Brahma studies the Vedas, but he cannot see the Unseen Lord. ||1||Pause||

1350.g: ਤਤੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤੀ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਦੇਹ ਉਜੵਾਰਾ ॥
1350.t: tat tel naam keeaa baatee dheepak dheh ujayeaaraa ||
1350.e: With the oil of knowledge about the essence of reality, and the wick of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, this lamp illluminates my body.

1350.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਜਗਾਇਆ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
1350.t: jot lai jagadhees jagaiaa boojhai boojhanahaaraa ||2||
1350.e: I have applied the Light of the Lord of the Universe, and lit this lamp. God the Knower knows. ||2||

1350.g: ਪੰਚੇ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਜੇ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
1350.t: pa(n)che sabadh anaahadh baaje sa(n)ge saari(n)gapaanee ||
1350.e: The Unstruck Melody of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrates and resounds. I dwell with the Lord of the World.

1350.g: ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੫॥
1350.t: kabeer dhaas teree aaratee keenee nira(n)kaar nirabaanee ||3||5||
1350.e: Kabeer, Your slave, performs this Aartee, this lamp-lit worship service for You, O Formless Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||3||5||

1350.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ
1350.t: prabhaatee baanee bhagat naamadhev jee kee
1350.e: Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

1350.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1350.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1350.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1350.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੈ ਬੂਝਲ ਆਗੈ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
1350.t: man kee birathaa man hee jaanai kai boojhal aagai kaheeaai ||
1350.e: The mind alone knows the state of the mind; I tell it to the Knowing Lord.

1350.g: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਾਂਈ ਮੈ ਡਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਚਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
1350.t: a(n)tarajaamee raam ravaa(n)iee mai ddar kaise chaheeaai ||1||
1350.e: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts - why should I be afraid? ||1||

1350.g: ਬੇਧੀਅਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਸਾਈ ॥
1350.t: bedheeale gopaal guosaiee ||
1350.e: My mind is pierced through by the love of the Lord of the World.

1350.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬੇ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1350.t: meraa prabh raviaa sarabe Thaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1350.e: My God is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

1350.g: ਮਾਨੈ ਹਾਟੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਪਾਟੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
1350.t: maanai haaT maanai paaT maanai hai paasaaree ||
1350.e: The mind is the shop, the mind is the town, and the mind is the shopkeeper.

1350.g: ਮਾਨੈ ਬਾਸੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਭੇਦੀ ਭਰਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
1350.t: maanai baasai naanaa bhedhee bharamat hai sa(n)saaree ||2||
1350.e: The mind abides in various forms, wandering all across the world. ||2||

1350.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
1350.t: gur kai sabadh eh man raataa dhubidhaa sahaj samaanee ||
1350.e: This mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and duality is easily overcome.

1351.g: ਸਭੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਮਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
1351.t: sabho hukam hukam hai aape nirabhau samat beechaaree ||3||
1351.e: He Himself is the Commander; all are under His Command. The Fearless Lord looks on all alike. ||3||

1351.g: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਜਹਿ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਤਾ ਚੀ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1351.t: jo jan jaan bhajeh purakhotam taa chee abigat baanee ||
1351.e: That humble being who knows, and meditates on the Supreme Primal Being - his word becomes eternal.

1351.g: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖ ਬਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
1351.t: naamaa kahai jagajeevan paiaa hiradhai alakh biddaanee ||4||1||
1351.e: Says Naam Dayv, I have found the Invisible, Wondrous Lord, the Life of the World, within my heart. ||4||1||
Prabhaatee:

1351.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੋ ਜੁਗੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
1351.t: aadh jugaadh jugaadh jugo jug taa kaa a(n)t na jaaniaa ||
1351.e: He existed in the beginning, in the primeval age, and all throughout the ages; His limits cannot be known.

1351.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਰਵਿ ਐਸਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਬਖਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
1351.t: sarab nira(n)tar raam rahiaa rav aaisaa roop bakhaaniaa ||1||
1351.e: The Lord is pervading and permeating amongst all; this is how His Form can be described. ||1||
The Lord of the Universe appears when the Word of His Shabad is chanted.
My Lord is the Embodiment of Bliss. ||1||Pause||

1351.g: ਬਾਵਨ ਬੀਖੂ ਬਾਨੈ ਬੀਖੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਗਿਲਾ ॥
1351.t: baavan beekhoo baanai beekhe baas te sukh laagilaa ||
1351.e: The beautiful fragrance of sandalwood emanates from the sandalwood tree, and attaches to the other trees of the forest.

1351.g: ਸਰਬੇ ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮਲਾਦਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਭੈਇਲਾ ॥੨॥
1351.t: sarabe aadh paramalaadh kaasaT cha(n)dhan bhaiilaa ||2||
1351.e: God, the Primal Source of everything, is like the sandalwood tree; He transforms us woody trees into fragrant sandalwood. ||2||

1351.g: ਤੁਮੑ ਚੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹਮ ਚੇ ਲੋਹਾ ਸੰਗੇ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭੈਇਲਾ ॥
1351.t: tum(h) che paaras ham che lohaa sa(n)ge ka(n)chan bhaiilaa ||
1351.e: You, O Lord, are the Philosopher's Stone, and I am iron; associating with You, I am transformed into gold.

1351.g: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਲਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
1351.t: too dhiaal ratan laal naamaa saach samailaa ||3||2||
1351.e: You are Merciful; You are the gem and the jewel. Naam Dayv is absorbed in the Truth. ||3||2||
Prabhaatee:
The Primal Being has no ancestry; He has staged this play.
God is hidden deep within each and every heart. ||1||

1351.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
1351.t: jeea kee jot na jaanai koiee ||
1351.e: No one knows the Light of the soul.

1351.g: ਤੈ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੁ ਮਾਲੂਮੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1351.t: tai mai keeaa su maaloom hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1351.e: Whatever I do, is known to You, Lord. ||1||Pause||
Just as the pitcher is made from clay,
everything is made from the Beloved Divine Creator Himself. ||2||
The mortal's actions hold the soul in the bondage of karma.

1351.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੁ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੈ ॥੩॥
1351.t: jo kichh keeaa su aapai aapai ||3||
1351.e: Whatever he does, he does on his own. ||3||

1351.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਸੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
1351.t: pranavat naamadheau ih jeeau chitavai su lahai ||
1351.e: Prays Naam Dayv, whatever this soul wants, it obtains.
Whoever abides in the Lord, becomes immortal. ||4||3||
Prabhaatee, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
You rub your body with sandalwood oil, and place basil leaves on your forehead.
But you hold a knife in the hand of your heart.
You look like a thug; pretending to meditate, you pose like a crane.
You try to look like a Vaishnaav, but the breath of life escapes through your mouth. ||1||
You pray for hours to God the Beautiful.

1351.g: ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਰਤਾ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਦੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1351.t: karaoor dhisaT rataa nis baadha(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
1351.e: But your gaze is evil, and your nights are wasted in conflict. ||1||Pause||
You perform daily cleansing rituals,
wear two loin-cloths, perform religious rituals and put only milk in your mouth.
But in your heart, you have drawn out the sword.
You routinely steal the property of others. ||2||
You worship the stone idol, and paint ceremonial marks of Ganesha.
You remain awake throughout the night, pretending to worship God.
You dance, but your consciousness is filled with evil.
You are lewd and depraved - this is such an unrighteous dance! ||3||
You sit on a deer-skin, and chant on your mala.
You put the sacred mark, the tilak, on your forehead.
You wear the rosary beads of Shiva around your neck, but your heart is filled with falsehood.
You are lewd and depraved - you do not chant God's Name. ||4||
Whoever does not realize the essence of the soul
all his religious actions are hollow and false.
Says Baynee, as Gurmukh, meditate.
Without the True Guru, you shall not find the Way. ||5||1||

1352.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1352.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
1352.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

1352.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1352.t: raag jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa nauvaa ||
1352.e: Raag Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehla:

1352.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਇਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਹੈ ॥
1352.t: raam simar raam simar ihai terai kaaj hai ||
1352.e: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord - meditate on the Lord; this alone shall be of use to you.

1352.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੂ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
1352.t: maiaa ko sa(n)g tiaag prabh joo kee saran laag ||
1352.e: Abandon your association with Maya, and take shelter in the Sanctuary of God.

1352.g: ਜਗਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਝੂਠੋ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1352.t: jagat sukh maan mithiaa jhooTho sabh saaj hai ||1|| rahaau ||
1352.e: Remember that the pleasures of the world are false; this whole show is just an illusion. ||1||Pause||

1352.g: ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜਿਉ ਧਨੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਪਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
1352.t: supane jiau dhan pachhaan kaahe par karat maan ||
1352.e: You must understand that this wealth is just a dream. Why are you so proud?

1352.g: ਬਾਰੂ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
1352.t: baaroo kee bheet jaise basudhaa ko raaj hai ||1||
1352.e: The empires of the earth are like walls of sand. ||1||

1352.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਬਾਤ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜੈਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਗਾਤੁ ॥
1352.t: naanak jan kahat baat binas jaihai tero gaat ||
1352.e: Servant Nanak speaks the Truth: your body shall perish and pass away.

1352.g: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਤੈਸੇ ਜਾਤੁ ਆਜੁ ਹੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
1352.t: chhin chhin kar gio kaal taise jaat aaj hai ||2||1||
1352.e: Moment by moment, yesterday passed. Today is passing as well. ||2||1||

1352.g: ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1352.t: jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa nauvaa ||
1352.e: Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehla:

1352.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
1352.t: raam bhaj raam bhaj janam siraat hai ||
1352.e: Meditate on the Lord - vibrate on the Lord; your life is slipping away.

1352.g: ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਹ ਕਿਉ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
1352.t: kahau kahaa baar baar samajhat neh kiau gavaar ||
1352.e: Why am I telling you this again and again? You fool - why don't you understand?

1352.g: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਨਹ ਲਗੈ ਬਾਰ ਓਰੇ ਸਮ ਗਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1352.t: binasat neh lagai baar ore sam gaat hai ||1|| rahaau ||
1352.e: Your body is like a hail-stone; it melts away in no time at all. ||1||Pause||

1352.g: ਸਗਲ ਭਰਮ ਡਾਰਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
1352.t: sagal bharam ddaar dheh gobi(n)dh ko naam leh ||
1352.e: So give up all your doubts, and utter the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1352.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਬਾਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਇਹੈ ਏਕੁ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
1352.t: a(n)t baar sa(n)g terai ihai ek jaat hai ||1||
1352.e: At the very last moment, this alone shall go along with you. ||1||

1352.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੌ ਜਸੁ ਹੀਏ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1352.t: bikhiaa bikh jiau bisaar prabh kau jas he'ee dhaar ||
1352.e: Forget the poisonous sins of corruption, and enshrine the Praises of God in your heart.

1352.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬਿਹਾਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
1352.t: naanak jan keh pukaar aausar bihaat hai ||2||2||
1352.e: Servant Nanak proclaims that this opportunity is slipping away. ||2||2||

1352.g: ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1352.t: jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa nauvaa ||
1352.e: Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehla:

1352.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਉਨ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
1352.t: re man kaun gat hoi hai teree ||
1352.e: O mortal, what will your condition be?

1352.g: ਇਹ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਤਉ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
1352.t: eeh jag meh raam naam so tau nahee sunio kaan ||
1352.e: In this world, you have not listened to the Lord's Name.

1352.g: ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਅਤਿ ਲੁਭਾਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1352.t: bikhian siau at lubhaan mat naahin feree ||1|| rahaau ||
1352.e: You are totally engrossed in corruption and sin; you have not turned your mind away from them at all. ||1||Pause||

1352.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਕੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੀਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਹ ਨਿਮਖ ਕੀਨੁ ॥
1352.t: maanas ko janam leen simaran neh nimakh keen ||
1352.e: You obtained this human life, but you have not remembered the Lord in meditation, even for an instant.

1352.g: ਦਾਰਾ ਸੁਖ ਭਇਓ ਦੀਨੁ ਪਗਹੁ ਪਰੀ ਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
1352.t: dhaaraa sukh bhio dheen pagahu paree beree ||1||
1352.e: For the sake of pleasure, you have become subservient to your woman, and now your feet are bound. ||1||

1352.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਗ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥
1352.t: naanak jan keh pukaar supanai jiau jag pasaar ||
1352.e: Servant Nanak proclaims that the vast expanse of this world is just a dream.

1352.g: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਹ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥
1352.t: simarat neh kiau muraar maiaa jaa kee cheree ||2||3||
1352.e: Why not meditate on the Lord? Even Maya is His slave. ||2||3||

1352.g: ਜੈਜਾਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1352.t: jaijaava(n)tee mahalaa nauvaa ||
1352.e: Jaijaavantee, Ninth Mehla:

1352.g: ਬੀਤ ਜੈਹੈ ਬੀਤ ਜੈਹੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਜੁ ਰੇ ॥
1352.t: beet jaihai beet jaihai janam akaaj re ||
1352.e: Slipping away - your life is uselessly slipping away.

1352.g: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਹ ਰੇ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
1352.t: nis dhin sun kai puraan samajhat neh re ajaan ||
1352.e: Night and day, you listen to the Puraanas, but you do not understand them, you ignorant fool!

1352.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਤਉ ਪਹੂਚਿਓ ਆਨਿ ਕਹਾ ਜੈਹੈ ਭਾਜਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1352.t: kaal tau pahoochio aan kahaa jaihai bhaaj re ||1|| rahaau ||
1352.e: Death has arrived; now where will you run? ||1||Pause||

1353.g: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜੋ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਦੇਹ ਸੋ ਤਉ ਤੇਰਉ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਖੇਹ ॥
1353.t: asathir jo maanio dheh so tau terau hoi hai kheh ||
1353.e: You believed that this body was permanent, but it shall turn to dust.

1353.g: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਨਿਲਾਜ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
1353.t: kiau na har ko naam leh moorakh nilaaj re ||1||
1353.e: Why don't you chant the Name of the Lord, you shameless fool? ||1||

1353.g: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਏ ਆਨਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਦੇ ਤੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
1353.t: raam bhagat he'ee aan chhaadd dhe tai man ko maan ||
1353.e: Let devotional worship of the Lord enter into your heart, and abandon the intellectualism of your mind.

1353.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਇਹ ਬਖਾਨਿ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਰਾਜੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥
1353.t: naanak jan ieh bakhaan jag meh biraaj re ||2||4||
1353.e: O Servant Nanak, this is the way to live in the world. ||2||4||

1353.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1353.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
1353.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

1353.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਸਹਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1353.t: salok sahasakiratee mahalaa pehilaa ||
1353.e: Shalok Sehskritee, First Mehla:

1353.g: ਪੜਿੑ ਪੁਸ੍ਤਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
1353.t: paRi(h) pustak sa(n)dhiaa baadha(n) ||
1353.e: You study the scriptures, say your prayers and argue;

1353.g: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੰ ॥
1353.t: sil poojas bagul samaadha(n) ||
1353.e: you worship stones and sit like a crane, pretending to meditate.

1353.g: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਬਿਭੂਖਨ ਸਾਰੰ ॥
1353.t: mukh jhooTh bibhookhan saara(n) ||
1353.e: You speak lies and well-ornamented falsehood,

1353.g: ਤ੍ਰੈਪਾਲ ਤਿਹਾਲ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
1353.t: traipaal tihaal bichaara(n) ||
1353.e: and recite your daily prayers three times a day.

1353.g: ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕ ਲਿਲਾਟੰ ॥
1353.t: gal maalaa tilak lilaaTa(n) ||
1353.e: The mala is around your neck, and the sacred tilak mark is on your forehead.

1353.g: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਪਾਟੰ ॥
1353.t: dhui dhotee basatr kapaaTa(n) ||
1353.e: You wear two loin cloths, and keep your head covered.

1353.g: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
1353.t: jo jaanas brahama(n) karama(n) ||
1353.e: If you know God and the nature of karma,

1353.g: ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ ਨਿਸਚੈ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
1353.t: sabh fokaT nisachai karama(n) ||
1353.e: you know that all these rituals and beliefs are useless.

1353.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਚੌ ਧੵਿਾਵੈ ॥
1353.t: kahu naanak nisachau dhiyeaavai ||
1353.e: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord with faith.

1353.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
1353.t: bin satigur baaT na paavai ||1||
1353.e: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||1||

1353.g: ਨਿਹਫਲੰ ਤਸੵ ਜਨਮਸੵ ਜਾਵਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨ ਬਿੰਦਤੇ ॥
1353.t: nihafala(n) tasaye janamasaye jaavadh braham na bi(n)dhate ||
1353.e: The mortal's life is fruitless, as long as he does not know God.

1353.g: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਸੰਸਾਰਸੵ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰਹਿ ਕੇ ॥
1353.t: saagara(n) sa(n)saarasaye gur parasaadhee tareh ke ||
1353.e: Only a few, by Guru's Grace, cross over the world-ocean.

1353.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1353.t: karan kaaran samarath hai kahu naanak beechaar ||
1353.e: The Creator, the Cause of causes, is All-powerful. Thus speaks Nanak, after deep deliberation.

1353.g: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਖੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
1353.t: kaaran karate vas hai jin kal rakhee dhaar ||2||
1353.e: The Creation is under the control of the Creator. By His Power, He sustains and supports it. ||2||

1353.g: ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦੰ ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ ਤ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਹ ॥
1353.t: jog sabadha(n) giaan sabadha(n) bedh sabadha(n) ta braahamaneh ||
1353.e: The Shabad is Yoga, the Shabad is spiritual wisdom; the Shabad is the Vedas for the Brahmin.

1353.g: ਖੵਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਪਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
1353.t: khayetree sabadha(n) soor sabadha(n) soodhr sabadha(n) paraa kirateh ||
1353.e: The Shabad is heroic bravery for the Khshaatriya; the Shabad is service to others for the Soodra.

1353.g: ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦੰ ਤ ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਭੇਉ ॥
1353.t: sarab sabadha(n) ta ek sabadha(n) je ko jaanas bheau ||
1353.e: The Shabad for all is the Shabad, the Word of the One God, for one who knows this secret.

1353.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
1353.t: naanak taa ko dhaas hai soiee nira(n)jan dheau ||3||
1353.e: Nanak is the slave of the Divine, Immaculate Lord. ||3||

1353.g: ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨੰ ਤ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਹ ॥ ਆਤਮੰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਾਸ੍ਵਦੇਵਸੵ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
1353.t: ek kirasana(n) ta sarab dhevaa dhev dhevaa ta aatameh || aatama(n) sree baasavaidhevasaye je koiee jaanas bhev ||
1353.e: The One Lord is the Divinity of all divinities. He is the Divinity of the soul.

1353.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੪॥
1353.t: naanak taa ko dhaas hai soiee nira(n)jan dhev ||4||
1353.e: Nanak is the slave of that one who knows the Secrets of the soul and the Supreme Lord God. He is the Divine Immaculate Lord Himself. ||4||

1353.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਸਹਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
1353.t: salok sahasakiratee mahalaa panjavaa
1353.e: Shalok Sehskritee , Fifth Mehla:

1353.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1353.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
1353.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

1353.g: ਕਤੰਚ ਮਾਤਾ ਕਤੰਚ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਤੰਚ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸੁਤਹ ॥
1353.t: kata(n)ch maataa kata(n)ch pitaa kata(n)ch banitaa binodh suteh ||
1353.e: Who is the mother, and who is the father? Who is the son, and what is the pleasure of marriage?

1353.g: ਕਤੰਚ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਹਿਤ ਬੰਧਵ ਕਤੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੵਤੇ ॥
1353.t: kata(n)ch bhraat meet hit ba(n)dhav kata(n)ch moh kuTa(n)bayete ||
1353.e: Who is the brother, friend, companion and relative? Who is emotionally attached to the family?

1353.g: ਕਤੰਚ ਚਪਲ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਰੂਪੰ ਪੇਖੰਤੇ ਤਿਆਗੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥
1353.t: kata(n)ch chapal mohanee roopa(n) pekha(n)te tiaaga(n) karot ||
1353.e: Who is restlessly attached to beauty? It leaves, as soon as we see it.

1353.g: ਰਹੰਤ ਸੰਗ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਤਨਹ ॥੧॥
1353.t: raha(n)t sa(n)g bhagavaan simaran naanak labadhaye(n) achut taneh ||1||
1353.e: Only the meditative remembrance of God remains with us. O Nanak, it brings the blessings of the Saints, the sons of the Imperishable Lord. ||1||

1354.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੰਤ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਨੇਹੰ ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਨੇਹੰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬਾਂਧਵਹ ॥
1354.t: dhiraga(n)t maat pitaa saneha(n) dhirag saneha(n) bhraat baa(n)dhaveh ||
1354.e: Cursed is loving attachment to one's mother and father; cursed is loving attachment to one's siblings and relatives.

1354.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸ੍ਨੇਹੰ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਤਹ ॥
1354.t: dhirag saneha(n) banitaa bilaas suteh ||
1354.e: Cursed is attachment to the joys of family life with one's spouse and children.

1354.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸ੍ਨੇਹੰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਾਰਥ ਕਹ ॥
1354.t: dhirag saneha(n) girahaarath keh ||
1354.e: Cursed is attachment to household affairs.

1354.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਸ੍ਨੇਹ ਸਤੵਿੰ ਸੁਖਯੰ ਬਸੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਹ ॥੨॥
1354.t: saadhasa(n)g saneh satiye(n) sukhaya(n) basa(n)t naanakeh ||2||
1354.e: Only loving attachment to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is True. Nanak dwells there in peace. ||2||

1354.g: ਮਿਥੵੰਤ ਦੇਹੰ ਖੀਣੰਤ ਬਲਨੰ ॥
1354.t: mithaye(n)t dheha(n) kheena(n)t balana(n) ||
1354.e: The body is false; its power is temporary.

1354.g: ਬਰਧੰਤਿ ਜਰੂਆ ਹਿਤੵੰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1354.t: baradha(n)t jarooaa hitaye(n)t maiaa ||
1354.e: It grows old; its love for Maya increases greatly.

1354.g: ਅਤੵੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਆਥਿਤੵ ਭਵਨੰ ॥
1354.t: ataye(n)t aasaa aathitaye bhavana(n) ||
1354.e: The human is only a temporary guest in the home of the body, but he has high hopes.

1354.g: ਗਨੰਤ ਸ੍ਵਾਸਾ ਭੈਯਾਨ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
1354.t: gana(n)t savaiaasaa bhaiyaan dharama(n) ||
1354.e: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is relentless; he counts each and every breath.

1354.g: ਪਤੰਤਿ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪ ਦੁਰਲਭੵ ਦੇਹੰ ਤਤ ਆਸ੍ਰਯੰ ਨਾਨਕ ॥
1354.t: pata(n)t moh koop dhuralabhaye dheha(n) tat aasraya(n) naanak ||
1354.e: The human body, so difficult to obtain, has fallen into the deep dark pit of emotional attachment. O Nanak, its only support is God, the Essence of Reality.

1354.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ॥੩॥
1354.t: gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh gopaal kirapaa ||3||
1354.e: O God, Lord of the World, Lord of the Universe, Master of the Universe, please be kind to me. ||3||

1354.g: ਕਾਚ ਕੋਟੰ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਤੋਯੰ ਲੇਪਨੰ ਰਕਤ ਚਰਮਣਹ ॥
1354.t: kaach koTa(n) racha(n)t toya(n) lepana(n) rakat charamaneh ||
1354.e: This fragile body-fortress is made up of water, plastered with blood and wrapped in skin.

1354.g: ਨਵੰਤ ਦੁਆਰੰ ਭੀਤ ਰਹਿਤੰ ਬਾਇ ਰੂਪੰ ਅਸਥੰਭਨਹ ॥
1354.t: nava(n)t dhuaara(n) bheet rahita(n) bai roopa(n) asatha(n)bhaneh ||
1354.e: It has nine gates, but no doors; it is supported by pillars of wind, the channels of the breath.

1354.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਨੰਤਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੰ ॥
1354.t: gobi(n)dh naama(n) neh simara(n)t agiaanee jaana(n)t asathira(n) ||
1354.e: The ignorant person does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe; he thinks that this body is permanent.

1354.g: ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਉਧਰੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ॥
1354.t: dhuralabh dheh udhara(n)t saadh saran naanak ||
1354.e: This precious body is saved and redeemed in the Sanctuary of the Holy, O Nanak,

1354.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਜਪੰਤਿ ॥੪॥
1354.t: har har har har har hare japa(n)t ||4||
1354.e: chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Haray. ||4||

1354.g: ਸੁਭੰਤ ਤੁਯੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਗੁਣਗੵੰ ਪੂਰਨੰ ਬਹੁਲੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
1354.t: subha(n)t tuya(n) achut gunagaye(n) poorana(n) bahulo kirapaalaa ||
1354.e: O Glorious, Eternal and Imperishable, Perfect and Abundantly Compassionate,

1354.g: ਗੰਭੀਰੰ ਊਚੈ ਸਰਬਗਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1354.t: ga(n)bheera(n) uoochai sarabag apaaraa ||
1354.e: Profound and Unfathomable, Lofty and Exalted, All-knowing and Infinite Lord God.

1354.g: ਭ੍ਰਿਤਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਅੰ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਚਰਣੰ ॥
1354.t: bhiratiaa pria(n) bisraam charana(n) ||
1354.e: O Lover of Your devoted servants, Your Feet are a Sanctuary of Peace.

1354.g: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣੰ ॥੫॥
1354.t: anaath naathe naanak sarana(n) ||5||
1354.e: O Master of the masterless, Helper of the helpless, Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||5||

1354.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀ ਪੇਖੰਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇਣ ਲਖੵ ਆਵਧਹ ॥
1354.t: miragee pekha(n)t badhik prahaaren lakhaye aavadheh ||
1354.e: Seeing the deer, the hunter aims his weapons.

1354.g: ਅਹੋ ਜਸੵ ਰਖੇਣ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਛੇਦੵਤੇ ॥੬॥
1354.t: aho jasaye rakhen gopaaleh naanak rom na chhedhayete ||6||
1354.e: But if one is protected by the Lord of the World, O Nanak, not a hair on his head will be touched. ||6||

1354.g: ਬਹੁ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਲਵੰਤ ਕਾਰੀ ਸੇਵੰਤ ਸੂਰਾ ਚਤੁਰ ਦਿਸਹ ॥
1354.t: bahu jatan karataa balava(n)t kaaree seva(n)t sooraa chatur dhiseh ||
1354.e: He may be surrounded on all four sides by servants and powerful warriors;

1354.g: ਬਿਖਮ ਥਾਨ ਬਸੰਤ ਊਚਹ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਮਰਣੰ ਕਦਾਂਚਹ ॥
1354.t: bikham thaan basa(n)t uoocheh neh simara(n)t marana(n) kadhaa(n)cheh ||
1354.e: he may dwell in a lofty place, difficult to approach, and never even think of death.

1354.g: ਹੋਵੰਤਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਟੀ ਸਾਸ ਅਕਰਖਤੇ ॥੭॥
1354.t: hova(n)t aagiaa bhagavaan purakheh naanak keeTee saas akarakhate ||7||
1354.e: But when the Order comes from the Primal Lord God, O Nanak, even an ant can take away his breath of life. ||7||

1354.g: ਸਬਦੰ ਰਤੰ ਹਿਤੰ ਮਇਆ ਕੀਰਤੰ ਕਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੁਆ ॥
1354.t: sabadha(n) rata(n) hita(n) miaa keerata(n) kalee karam kiratuaa ||
1354.e: To be imbued and attuned to the Word of the Shabad; to be kind and compassionate; to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - these are the most worthwhile actions in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

1354.g: ਮਿਟੰਤਿ ਤਤ੍ਰਾਗਤ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹੰ ॥
1354.t: miTa(n)t tatraagat bharam moha(n) ||
1354.e: In this way, one's inner doubts and emotional attachments are dispelled.

1354.g: ਭਗਵਾਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਥਾਨੵਿੰ ॥
1354.t: bhagavaan ramana(n) sarabatr thaaniye(n) ||
1354.e: God is pervading and permeating all places.

1354.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਤੁਯੰ ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨੰ ਬਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
1354.t: dhirasaT tuya(n) amogh dharasana(n) basa(n)t saadh rasanaa ||
1354.e: So obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; He dwells upon the tongues of the Holy.

1354.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅੰ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੮॥
1354.t: har har har hare naanak pria(n) jaap japanaa ||8||
1354.e: O Nanak, meditate and chant the Name of the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, Har, Haray. ||8||

1354.g: ਘਟੰਤ ਰੂਪੰ ਘਟੰਤ ਦੀਪੰ ਘਟੰਤ ਰਵਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਗਗਨੰ ॥
1354.t: ghaTa(n)t roopa(n) ghaTa(n)t dheepa(n) ghaTa(n)t rav saseear nakhayetr gagana(n) ||
1354.e: Beauty fades away, islands fade away, the sun, moon, stars and sky fade away.

1354.g: ਘਟੰਤ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਸਿਖੰਡੰ ॥
1354.t: ghaTa(n)t basudhaa gir tar sikha(n)dda(n) ||
1354.e: The earth, mountains, forests and lands fade away.

1354.g: ਘਟੰਤ ਲਲਨਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੀਤੰ ॥
1354.t: ghaTa(n)t lalanaa sut bhraat heeta(n) ||
1354.e: One's spouse, children, siblings and loved friends fade away.

1354.g: ਘਟੰਤ ਕਨਿਕ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪੰ ॥
1354.t: ghaTa(n)t kanik maanik maiaa savairoopa(n) ||
1354.e: Gold and jewels and the incomparable beauty of Maya fade away.

1354.g: ਨਹ ਘਟੰਤ ਕੇਵਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ॥
1354.t: neh ghaTa(n)t keval gopaal achut ||
1354.e: Only the Eternal, Unchanging Lord does not fade away.

1354.g: ਅਸਥਿਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ॥੯॥
1354.t: asathira(n) naanak saadh jan ||9||
1354.e: O Nanak, only the humble Saints are steady and stable forever. ||9||

1354.g: ਨਹ ਬਿਲੰਬ ਧਰਮੰ ਬਿਲੰਬ ਪਾਪੰ ॥
1354.t: neh bila(n)b dharama(n) bila(n)b paapa(n) ||
1354.e: Do not delay in practicing righteousness; delay in committing sins.

1354.g: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤ ਨਾਮੰ ਤਜੰਤ ਲੋਭੰ ॥
1354.t: dhiraRa(n)t naama(n) taja(n)t lobha(n) ||
1354.e: Implant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within yourself, and abandon greed.

1354.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤੰ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤੰ ਧਰਮ ਲਖੵਿਣ ॥
1354.t: saran sa(n)ta(n) kilabikh naasa(n) praapata(n) dharam lakhiyen ||
1354.e: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, the sins are erased. The character of righteousness is received by that person,

1354.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਮਾਧਵਹ ॥੧੦॥
1354.t: naanak jeh suprasa(n)n maadhaveh ||10||
1354.e: O Nanak, with whom the Lord is pleased and satisfied. ||10||

1354.g: ਮਿਰਤ ਮੋਹੰ ਅਲਪ ਬੁਧੵੰ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸਾਹੰ ॥
1354.t: mirat moha(n) alap budhaye(n) racha(n)t banitaa binodh saaha(n) ||
1354.e: The person of shallow understanding is dying in emotional attachment; he is engrossed in pursuits of pleasure with his wife.

1354.g: ਜੌਬਨ ਬਹਿਕ੍ਰਮ ਕਨਿਕ ਕੁੰਡਲਹ ॥
1354.t: jauaban bahikaram kanik ku(n)ddaleh ||
1354.e: With youthful beauty and golden earrings,

1354.g: ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਸੋਭੰਤਿ ਬਸਤ੍ਰਾ ਇਤੵੰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੵਾਪਿਤੰ ॥
1354.t: bachitr ma(n)dhir sobha(n)t basatraa itaye(n)t maiaa bayeaapita(n) ||
1354.e: wondrous mansions, decorations and clothes - this is how Maya clings to him.

1354.g: ਹੇ ਅਚੁਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋ ਭਗਵਾਨਏ ਨਮਹ ॥੧੧॥
1354.t: he achut saran sa(n)t naanak bho bhagavaane nameh ||11||
1354.e: O Eternal, Unchanging, Benevolent Lord God, O Sanctuary of the Saints, Nanak humbly bows to You. ||11||

1354.g: ਜਨਮੰ ਤ ਮਰਣੰ ਹਰਖੰ ਤ ਸੋਗੰ ਭੋਗੰ ਤ ਰੋਗੰ ॥
1354.t: janama(n) ta marana(n) harakha(n) ta soga(n) bhoga(n) ta roga(n) ||
1354.e: If there is birth, then there is death. If there is pleasure, then there is pain. If there is enjoyment, then there is disease.

1354.g: ਊਚੰ ਤ ਨੀਚੰ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਸੁ ਮੂਚੰ ॥
1354.t: uoocha(n) ta neecha(n) naan(h)aa su moocha(n) ||
1354.e: If there is high, then there is low. If there is small, then there is great.

1355.g: ਰਾਜੰ ਤ ਮਾਨੰ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੰ ਤ ਹੀਨੰ ॥
1355.t: raaja(n) ta maana(n) abhimaana(n) ta heena(n) ||
1355.e: If there is power, then there is pride. If there is egotistical pride, then there will be a fall.

1355.g: ਪ੍ਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਰਗੰ ਵਰਤੰਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੰ ॥
1355.t: pravirat maaraga(n) varata(n)t binaasana(n) ||
1355.e: Engrossed in worldly ways, one is ruined.

1355.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਅਸਥਿਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨਾਸਨੰ ॥੧੨॥
1355.t: gobi(n)dh bhajan saadh sa(n)gen asathira(n) naanak bhagava(n)t bhajanaasana(n) ||12||
1355.e: Meditating and vibrating on the Lord of the Universe in the Company of the Holy, you shall become steady and stable. Nanak vibrates and meditates on the Lord God. ||12||

1355.g: ਕਿਰਪੰਤ ਹਰੀਅੰ ਮਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੰ ॥
1355.t: kirapa(n)t hareea(n) mat tat giaana(n) ||
1355.e: By the Grace of God, genuine understanding comes to the mind.

1355.g: ਬਿਗਸੀਧੵਿ ਬੁਧਾ ਕੁਸਲ ਥਾਨੰ ॥
1355.t: bigaseedhiye budhaa kusal thaana(n) ||
1355.e: The intellect blossoms forth, and one finds a place in the realm of celestial bliss.

1355.g: ਬਸੵਿੰਤ ਰਿਖਿਅੰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੰ ॥
1355.t: basiye(n)t rikhia(n) tiaag maana(n) ||
1355.e: The senses are brought under control, and pride is abandoned.

1355.g: ਸੀਤਲੰਤ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸੰਤ ਗਿਆਨੰ ॥
1355.t: seetala(n)t ridhaya(n) dhiraR sa(n)t giaana(n) ||
1355.e: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the wisdom of the Saints is implanted within.

1355.g: ਰਹੰਤ ਜਨਮੰ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
1355.t: raha(n)t janama(n) har dharas leenaa ||
1355.e: Reincarnation is ended, and the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained.

1355.g: ਬਾਜੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਣਾਂ ॥੧੩॥
1355.t: baaja(n)t naanak sabadh beenaa(n) ||13||
1355.e: O Nanak, the musical instrument of the Word of the Shabad vibrates and resounds within. ||13||

1355.g: ਕਹੰਤ ਬੇਦਾ ਗੁਣੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਆ ਸੁਣੰਤ ਬਾਲਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
1355.t: kaha(n)t bedhaa guna(n)t guneeaa suna(n)t baalaa bahu bidh prakaaraa ||
1355.e: The Vedas preach and recount God's Glories; people hear them by various ways and means.

1355.g: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤ ਸੁਬਿਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
1355.t: dhiraRa(n)t subidhiaa har har kirapaalaa ||
1355.e: The Merciful Lord, Har, Har, implants spiritual wisdom within.

1355.g: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਾਚੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧੪॥
1355.t: naam dhaan jaacha(n)t naanak dhainahaar gur gopaalaa ||14||
1355.e: Nanak begs for the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Guru is the Great Giver, the Lord of the World. ||14||

1355.g: ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਹ ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਛੁ ਲੋਕ ਕਹ ॥
1355.t: neh chi(n)taa maat pit bhraateh neh chi(n)taa kachh lok keh ||
1355.e: Do not worry so much about your mother, father and siblings. Do not worry so much about other people.

1355.g: ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਨਬੰਧਨਹ ॥
1355.t: neh chi(n)taa banitaa sut meeteh pravirat maiaa sanaba(n)dhaneh ||
1355.e: Do not worry about your spouse, children and friends. You are obsessed with your involvements in Maya.

1355.g: ਦਇਆਲ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕਹ ॥੧੫॥
1355.t: dhiaal ek bhagavaan purakheh naanak sarab jeea pratipaalakeh ||15||
1355.e: The One Lord God is Kind and Compassionate, O Nanak. He is the Cherisher and Nurturer of all living beings. ||15||

1355.g: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਵਿਤੰ ਅਨਿਤੵ ਚਿਤੰ ਅਨਿਤੵ ਆਸਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
1355.t: anitaye vita(n) anitaye chita(n) anitaye aasaa bahu bidh prakaara(n) ||
1355.e: Wealth is temporary; conscious existence is temporary; hopes of all sorts are temporary.

1355.g: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਹੇਤੰ ਅਹੰ ਬੰਧੰ ਭਰਮ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲਨੰ ਬਿਕਾਰੰ ॥
1355.t: anitaye heta(n) aha(n) ba(n)dha(n) bharam maiaa malana(n) bikaara(n) ||
1355.e: The bonds of love, attachment, egotism, doubt, Maya and the pollution of corruption are temporary.

1355.g: ਫਿਰੰਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਠਰਾਗਨਿ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਮਲੀਣ ਬੁਧੵੰ ॥
1355.t: fira(n)t jon anek jaTharaagan neh simara(n)t maleen budhaye(n) ||
1355.e: The mortal passes through the fire of the womb of reincarnation countless times. He does not remember the Lord in meditation; his understanding is polluted.

1355.g: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਰਤ ਮਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧੬॥
1355.t: he gobi(n)dh karat miaa naanak patit udhaaran saadh sa(n)gameh ||16||
1355.e: O Lord of the Universe, when You grant Your Grace, even sinners are saved. Nanak dwells in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||16||

1355.g: ਗਿਰੰਤ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਤਾਲੰ ਜਲੰਤ ਦੇਦੀਪੵ ਬੈਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਰਹ ॥
1355.t: gira(n)t gir patit paataala(n) jala(n)t dhedheepaye baisavaiaa(n)tareh ||
1355.e: You may drop down from the mountains, and fall into the nether regions of the underworld, or be burnt in the blazing fire,

1355.g: ਬਹੰਤਿ ਅਗਾਹ ਤੋਯੰ ਤਰੰਗੰ ਦੁਖੰਤ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਨਮੰ ਤ ਮਰਣਹ ॥
1355.t: baha(n)t agaeh toya(n) tara(n)ga(n) dhukha(n)t greh chi(n)taa janama(n) ta maraneh ||
1355.e: or swept away by the unfathomable waves of water; but the worst pain of all is household anxiety, which is the source of the cycle of death and rebirth.

1355.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਧਨੰ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਸਬਦ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੧੭॥
1355.t: anik saadhana(n) na sidhayete naanak asatha(n)bha(n) asatha(n)bha(n) asatha(n)bha(n) sabadh saadh savaijaneh ||17||
1355.e: No matter what you do, you cannot break its bonds, O Nanak. Man's only Support, Anchor and Mainstay is the Word of the Shabad, and the Holy, Friendly Saints. ||17||

1355.g: ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖੵੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਹਤੵੰ ਜਨਮ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੵਾਦੰ ॥
1355.t: ghor dhukhaye(n) anik hataye(n) janam dhaaridhra(n) mahaa bikhayeaadha(n) ||
1355.e: Excruciating pain, countless killings, reincarnation, poverty and terrible misery

1355.g: ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾਸਟ ਭਸਮੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੧੮॥
1355.t: miTa(n)t sagal simara(n)t har naam naanak jaise paavak kaasaT bhasama(n) karot ||18||
1355.e: are all destroyed by meditating in remembrance on the Lord's Name, O Nanak, just as fire reduces piles of wood to ashes. ||18||

1355.g: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੰ ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨਹ ॥
1355.t: a(n)dhakaar simarat prakaasa(n) gun rama(n)t agh kha(n)ddaneh ||
1355.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the darkness is illuminated. Dwelling on His Glorious Praises, the ugly sins are destroyed.

1355.g: ਰਿਦ ਬਸੰਤਿ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਦੂਤਹ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਹ ॥
1355.t: ridh basa(n)t bhai bheet dhooteh karam karat mahaa niramaleh ||
1355.e: Enshrining the Lord deep within the heart, and with the immaculate karma of doing good deeds, one strikes fear into the demons.

1355.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰਹੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨਹ ॥
1355.t: janam maran raha(n)t srotaa sukh samooh amogh dharasaneh ||
1355.e: The cycle of coming and going in reincarnation is ended, absolute peace is obtained, and the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

1355.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗੰ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਖੇਮੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੧੯॥
1355.t: saran joga(n) sa(n)t pria naanak so bhagavaan khema(n) karot ||19||
1355.e: He is Potent to give Protection, He is the Lover of His Saints. O Nanak, the Lord God blesses all with bliss. ||19||

1355.g: ਪਾਛੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਅਗ੍ਰਣੀਵਹ ਨਿਰਾਸੰ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
1355.t: paachha(n) karot agraneeveh niraasa(n) aas pooraneh ||
1355.e: Those who were left behind - the Lord brings them to the front. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

1355.g: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਭਯੰ ਧਨਵੰਤਹ ਰੋਗੀਅੰ ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਨਹ ॥
1355.t: niradhan bhaya(n) dhanava(n)teh rogeea(n) rog kha(n)ddaneh ||
1355.e: He makes the poor rich, and cures the illnesses of the ill.

1355.g: ਭਗਤੵੰ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
1355.t: bhagataye(n) bhagat dhaana(n) raam naam gun keerataneh ||
1355.e: He blesses His devotees with devotion. They sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord's Name.

1355.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਤਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿੰ ਨ ਲਭੵਤੇ ॥੨੦॥
1355.t: paarabraham purakh dhaataareh naanak gur sevaa ki(n) na labhayete ||20||
1355.e: O Nanak, those who serve the Guru find the Supreme Lord God, the Great Giver||20||

1355.g: ਅਧਰੰ ਧਰੰ ਧਾਰਣਹ ਨਿਰਧਨੰ ਧਨ ਨਾਮ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥
1355.t: adhara(n) dhara(n) dhaaraneh niradhana(n) dhan naam narahareh ||
1355.e: He gives Support to the unsupported. The Name of the Lord is the Wealth of the poor.

1355.g: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਬਲਹੀਣ ਬਲ ਕੇਸਵਹ ॥
1355.t: anaath naath gobi(n)dheh balaheen bal kesaveh ||
1355.e: The Lord of the Universe is the Master of the masterless; the Beautiful-haired Lord is the Power of the weak.

1355.g: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਦਯਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ਦੀਨ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਦਾਮੋਦਰਹ ॥
1355.t: sarab bhoot dhayaal achut dheen baa(n)dhav dhaamodhareh ||
1355.e: The Lord is Merciful to all beings, Eternal and Unchanging, the Family of the meek and humble.

1355.g: ਸਰਬਗੵ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥
1355.t: sarabagaye pooran purakh bhagavaaneh bhagat vachhal karunaa mayeh ||
1355.e: The All-knowing, Perfect, Primal Lord God is the Lover of His devotees, the Embodiment of Mercy.

1356.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵਹ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
1356.t: ghaT ghaT basa(n)t baasudheveh paarabraham paramesureh ||
1356.e: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent, Luminous Lord, dwells in each and every heart.

1356.g: ਜਾਚੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੰ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥੨੧॥
1356.t: jaacha(n)t naanak kirapaal prasaadha(n) neh bisara(n)t neh bisara(n)t naaraineh ||21||
1356.e: Nanak begs for this blessing from the Merciful Lord, that he may never forget Him, never forget Him. ||21||

1356.g: ਨਹ ਸਮਰਥੰ ਨਹ ਸੇਵਕੰ ਨਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੰ ॥
1356.t: neh samaratha(n) neh sevaka(n) neh preet param purakhotama(n) ||
1356.e: I have no power; I do not serve You, and I do not love You, O Supreme Sublime Lord God.

1356.g: ਤਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਿਮਰਤੇ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੰ ॥੨੨॥
1356.t: tav prasaadh simarate naama(n) naanak kirapaal har har gura(n) ||22||
1356.e: By Your Grace, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Merciful Lord, Har, Har. ||22||

1356.g: ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣ ਕਰੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਛਾਦਨ ਦੇਵੰਤ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
1356.t: bharan pokhan kara(n)t jeeaa bisraam chhaadhan dheva(n)t dhaana(n) ||
1356.e: The Lord feeds and sustains all living beings; He blesses them gifts of restful peace and fine clothes.

1356.g: ਸ੍ਰਿਜੰਤ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਚਤੁਰ ਚੇਤਨਹ ॥
1356.t: siraja(n)t ratan janam chatur chetaneh ||
1356.e: He created the jewel of human life, with all its cleverness and intelligence.

1356.g: ਵਰਤੰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਹ ॥
1356.t: varata(n)t sukh aana(n)dh prasaadheh ||
1356.e: By His Grace, mortals abide in peace and bliss.

1356.g: ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
1356.t: simara(n)t naanak har har hare ||
1356.e: O Nanak, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, Haray,

1356.g: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਰਚਨਾ ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਤੇ ॥੨੩॥
1356.t: anitaye rachanaa niramoh te ||23||
1356.e: the mortal is released from attachment to the world. ||23||

1356.g: ਦਾਨੰ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬੇਣ ਭੁੰਚੰਤੇ ਮਹੀਪਤੇ ॥
1356.t: dhaana(n) paraa pooraben bhu(n)cha(n)te maheepate ||
1356.e: The kings of the earth are eating up the blessings of the good karma of their past lives.

1356.g: ਬਿਪਰੀਤ ਬੁਧੵੰ ਮਾਰਤ ਲੋਕਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੋਗਤੇ ॥੨੪॥
1356.t: bipareet budhaye(n) maarat lokeh naanak chira(n)kaal dhukh bhogate ||24||
1356.e: Those cruel-minded rulers who oppress the people, O Nanak, shall suffer in pain for a very long time. ||24||

1356.g: ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਜਸੵ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਹ ॥
1356.t: birathaa anugraha(n) gobi(n)dheh jasaye simaran ridha(n)tareh ||
1356.e: Those who meditate in remembrance on the Lord in their hearts, look upon even pain as God's Grace.

1356.g: ਆਰੋਗੵੰ ਮਹਾ ਰੋਗੵੰ ਬਿਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੇ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥੨੫॥
1356.t: aarogaye(n) mahaa rogaye(n) bisimrite karunaa mayeh ||25||
1356.e: The healthy person is very sick, if he does not remember the Lord, the Embodiment of Mercy. ||25||

1356.g: ਰਮਣੰ ਕੇਵਲੰ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਸੁਧਰਮੰ ਦੇਹ ਧਾਰਣਹ ॥
1356.t: ramana(n) kevala(n) keeratana(n) sudharama(n) dheh dhaaraneh ||
1356.e: To sing the Kirtan of God's Praises is the righteous duty incurred by taking birth in this human body.

1356.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਵਤੰ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੨੬॥
1356.t: a(n)mirat naam naarain naanak peevata(n) sa(n)t na tirapayete ||26||
1356.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak. The Saints drink it in, and never have enough of it. ||26||

1356.g: ਸਹਣ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੰ ਸਮ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਸੵ ਦੁਰਜਨਹ ॥
1356.t: sahan seel sa(n)ta(n) sam mitrasaye dhurajaneh ||
1356.e: The Saints are tolerant and good-natured; friends and enemies are the same to them.

1356.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੇਣ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਆਵਧ ਹੋਇ ਉਪਤਿਸਟਤੇ ॥੨੭॥
1356.t: naanak bhojan anik prakaaren ni(n)dhak aavadh hoi upatisaTate ||27||
1356.e: O Nanak, it is all the same to them, whether someone offers them all sorts of foods, or slanders them, or draws weapons to kill them. ||27||

1356.g: ਤਿਰਸਕਾਰ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਮਾਨ ਭੰਗਨਹ ॥
1356.t: tirasakaar neh bhava(n)t neh bhava(n)t maan bha(n)ganeh ||
1356.e: They pay no attention to dishonor or disrespect.

1356.g: ਸੋਭਾ ਹੀਨ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਪੋਹੰਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੁਖਨਹ ॥
1356.t: sobhaa heen neh bhava(n)t neh poha(n)t sa(n)saar dhukhaneh ||
1356.e: They are not bothered by gossip; the miseries of the world do not touch them.

1356.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਸਨਹ ॥੨੮॥
1356.t: gobi(n)dh naam japa(n)t mil saadh sa(n)geh naanak se praanee sukh baasaneh ||28||
1356.e: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and chant the Name of the Lord of the Universe - O Nanak, those mortals abide in peace. ||28||

1356.g: ਸੈਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੂਰ ਅਜਿਤੰ ਸੰਨਾਹੰ ਤਨਿ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾਹ ॥
1356.t: sainaa saadh samooh soor ajita(n) sa(n)naaha(n) tan ni(n)mrataeh ||
1356.e: The Holy people are an invincible army of spiritual warriors; their bodies are protected by the armor of humility.

1356.g: ਆਵਧਹ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਓਟ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਕਰ ਚਰਮਣਹ ॥
1356.t: aavadheh gun gobi(n)dh ramana(n) oT gur sabadh kar charamaneh ||
1356.e: Their weapons are the Glorious Praises of the Lord which they chant; their Shelter and Shield is the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1356.g: ਆਰੂੜਤੇ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਰਥ ਨਾਗਹ ਬੁਝੰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗਹ ॥
1356.t: aarooRate asavai rath naageh bujha(n)te prabh maarageh ||
1356.e: The horses, chariots and elephants they ride are their way to realize God's Path.

1356.g: ਬਿਚਰਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਯੰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੈਨਾ ਧਾਯੰਤੇ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
1356.t: bicharate nirabhaya(n) satr sainaa dhaaya(n)te guopaal keerataneh ||
1356.e: They walk fearlessly through the armies of their enemies; they attack them with the Kirtan of God's Praises.

1356.g: ਜਿਤਤੇ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰਹ ॥੨੯॥
1356.t: jitate bisavai sa(n)saareh naanak vasaye(n) karot pa(n)ch tasakareh ||29||
1356.e: They conquer the entire world, O Nanak, and overpower the five thieves. ||29||

1356.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਨਗਰੰ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਯਾ ਰਚਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿਹ ॥
1356.t: mirag tirasanaa ga(n)dharab nagara(n) dhrum chhaayaa rach dhuramateh ||
1356.e: Misled by evil-mindedness, mortals are engrossed in the mirage of the illusory world, like the passing shade of a tree.

1356.g: ਤਤਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮੋਹ ਮਿਥੵਾ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਹ ॥੩੦॥
1356.t: tateh kuTa(n)b moh mithayeaa simara(n)t naanak raam raam naameh ||30||
1356.e: Emotional attachment to family is false, so Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||30||

1356.g: ਨਚ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਗਮੰ ਨਚ ਗੁਣਗੵ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
1356.t: nach bidhiaa nidhaan nigama(n) nach gunagaye naam keerataneh ||
1356.e: I do not possess the treasure of the wisdom of the Vedas, nor do I possess the merits of the Praises of the Naam.

1356.g: ਨਚ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਕੰਠੰ ਨਹ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਤੁਰ ਚਾਤੁਰਹ ॥
1356.t: nach raag ratan ka(n)Tha(n) neh cha(n)chal chatur chaatureh ||
1356.e: I do not have a beautiful voice to sing jewelled melodies; I am not clever, wise or shrewd.

1356.g: ਭਾਗ ਉਦਿਮ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਖਲ ਪੰਡਿਤਹ ॥੩੧॥
1356.t: bhaag udhim labadhaye(n) maiaa naanak saadhasa(n)g khal pa(n)dditeh ||31||
1356.e: By destiny and hard work, the wealth of Maya is obtained. O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even fools become religious scholars. ||31||

1356.g: ਕੰਠ ਰਮਣੀਯ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮਾਲਾ ਹਸਤ ਊਚ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਧਾਰਣੀ ॥
1356.t: ka(n)Th ramaneey raam raam maalaa hasat uooch prem dhaaranee ||
1356.e: The mala around my neck is the chanting of the Lord's Name. The Love of the Lord is my silent chanting.

1356.g: ਜੀਹ ਭਣਿ ਜੋ ਉਤਮ ਸਲੋਕ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਨੈਨ ਨੰਦਨੀ ॥੩੨॥
1356.t: jeeh bhan jo utam salok udharana(n) nain na(n)dhanee ||32||
1356.e: Chanting this most Sublime Word brings salvation and joy to the eyes. ||32||

1356.g: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੀਣਸੵ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੰਤ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਸਟਣਹ ॥
1356.t: gur ma(n)tr heenasaye jo praanee dhiraga(n)t janam bhrasaTaneh ||
1356.e: That mortal who lacks the Guru's Mantra - cursed and contaminated is his life.

1356.g: ਕੂਕਰਹ ਸੂਕਰਹ ਗਰਧਭਹ ਕਾਕਹ ਸਰਪਨਹ ਤੁਲਿ ਖਲਹ ॥੩੩॥
1356.t: kookareh sookareh garadhabheh kaakeh sarapaneh tul khaleh ||33||
1356.e: That blockhead is just a dog, a pig, a jackass, a crow, a snake. ||33||

1356.g: ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨੰ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰਣਹ ॥
1356.t: charanaarabi(n)dh bhajana(n) ridhaya(n) naam dhaaraneh ||
1356.e: Whoever contemplates the Lord's Lotus Feet, and enshrines His Name within the heart,

1357.g: ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਤਿ ਜਮਦੂਤਨਹ ॥੩੪॥
1357.t: keeratana(n) saadhasa(n)gen naanak neh dhirasaTa(n)t jamadhootaneh ||34||
1357.e: and sings the Kirtan of His Praises in the Saadh Sangat, O Nanak, shall never see the Messenger of Death. ||34||

1357.g: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਧਨੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਰਾਜਨਹ ॥
1357.t: nach dhuralabha(n) dhana(n) roopa(n) nach dhuralabha(n) savairag raajaneh ||
1357.e: Wealth and beauty are not so difficult to obtain. Paradise and royal power are not so difficult to obtain.

1357.g: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਭੋਜਨੰ ਬਿੰਜਨੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸ੍ਵਛ ਅੰਬਰਹ ॥
1357.t: nach dhuralabha(n) bhojana(n) bi(n)jana(n) nach dhuralabha(n) savaichh a(n)bareh ||
1357.e: Foods and delicacies are not so difficult to obtain. Elegant clothes are not so difficuilt to obtain.

1357.g: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਸੁਤ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਲਾਸਹ ॥
1357.t: nach dhuralabha(n) sut mitr bhraat baa(n)dhav nach dhuralabha(n) banitaa bilaaseh ||
1357.e: Children, friends, siblings and relatives are not so difficult to obtain. The pleasures of woman are not so difficult to obtain.

1357.g: ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਣੰ ਨਚ ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਚਤੁਰ ਚੰਚਲਹ ॥
1357.t: nach dhuralabha(n) bidhiaa prabeena(n) nach dhuralabha(n) chatur cha(n)chaleh ||
1357.e: Knowledge and wisdom are not so difficult to obtain. Cleverness and trickery are not so difficult to obtain.

1357.g: ਦੁਰਲਭੰ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਨਾਮਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਬਧੵਿੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥੩੫॥
1357.t: dhuralabha(n) ek bhagavaan naameh naanak labadhiye(n) saadhasa(n)g kirapaa prabha(n) ||35||
1357.e: Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is difficult to obtain. O Nanak, it is only obtained by God's Grace, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||35||

1357.g: ਜਤ ਕਤਹ ਤਤਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਮਰਤ ਪਯਾਲ ਲੋਕਹ ॥
1357.t: jat kateh tateh dhirasaTa(n) savairag marat payaal lokeh ||
1357.e: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, whether in this world, in paradise, or the nether regions of the underworld.

1357.g: ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਪ ਛੇਪ ਨ ਲਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੩੬॥
1357.t: sarabatr ramana(n) gobi(n)dheh naanak lep chhep na lipayete ||36||
1357.e: The Lord of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. O Nanak, no blame or stain sticks to Him. ||36||

1357.g: ਬਿਖਯਾ ਭਯੰਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੰ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟਾਂ ਸਖਾ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥
1357.t: bikhayaa bhaya(n)t a(n)mrita(n) dhrusaTaa(n) sakhaa savaijaneh ||
1357.e: Poison is transformed into nectar, and enemies into friends and companions.

1357.g: ਦੁਖੰ ਭਯੰਤਿ ਸੁਖੵੰ ਭੈ ਭੀਤੰ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਯਹ ॥
1357.t: dhukha(n) bhaya(n)t sukhaye(n) bhai bheeta(n) ta nirabhayeh ||
1357.e: Pain is changed into pleasure, and the fearful become fearless.

1357.g: ਥਾਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਹ ॥੩੭॥
1357.t: thaan bihoon bisraam naama(n) naanak kirapaal har har gureh ||37||
1357.e: Those who have no home or place find their place of rest in the Naam, O Nanak, when the Guru, the Lord, becomes Merciful. ||37||

1357.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੀਲ ਮਮੰ ਸੀਲੰ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਵਨ ਮਮ ਪਾਵਨਹ ॥
1357.t: sarab seel mama(n) seela(n) sarab paavan mam paavaneh ||
1357.e: He blesses all with humility; He has blessed me with humility as well. He purifies all, and He has purified me as well.

1357.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਰਤਬ ਮਮੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਪ ਛੇਪ ਨ ਲਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੩੮॥
1357.t: sarab karatab mama(n) karataa naanak lep chhep na lipayete ||38||
1357.e: The Creator of all is the Creator of me as well. O Nanak, no blame or stain sticks to Him. ||38||

1357.g: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੇਵਹ ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨਹ ॥
1357.t: neh seetala(n) cha(n)dhr dheveh neh seetala(n) baavan cha(n)dhaneh ||
1357.e: The moon-god is not cool and calm, nor is the white sandalwood tree.

1357.g: ਨਹ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਸੀਤ ਰੁਤੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੀਤਲੰ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੩੯॥
1357.t: neh seetala(n) seet ruten naanak seetala(n) saadh savaijaneh ||39||
1357.e: The winter season is not cool; O Nanak, only the Holy friends, the Saints, are cool and calm. ||39||

1357.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੰ ਧੵਾਨੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
1357.t: ma(n)tra(n) raam raam naama(n) dhayeaana(n) sarabatr pooraneh ||
1357.e: Through the Mantra of the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one meditates on the All-pervading Lord.

1357.g: ਗੵਾਨੰ ਸਮ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖੰ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਣਹ ॥
1357.t: gayeaana(n) sam dhukh sukha(n) jugat niramal niravairaneh ||
1357.e: Those who have the wisdom to look alike upon pleasure and pain, live the immaculate lifestyle, free of vengeance.

1357.g: ਦਯਾਲੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਆ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਵਰਜਿਤਹ ॥
1357.t: dhayaala(n) sarabatr jeeaa pa(n)ch dhokh bivarajiteh ||
1357.e: They are kind to all beings; they have overpowered the five thieves.

1357.g: ਭੋਜਨੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਅਲਪ ਮਾਯਾ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਰਹਤਹ ॥
1357.t: bhojana(n) gopaal keeratana(n) alap maayaa jal kamal rahateh ||
1357.e: They take the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise as their food; they remain untouched by Maya, like the lotus in the water.

1357.g: ਉਪਦੇਸੰ ਸਮ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ॥
1357.t: aupadhesa(n) sam mitr satreh bhagava(n)t bhagat bhaavanee ||
1357.e: They share the Teachings with friend and enemy alike; they love the devotional worship of God.

1357.g: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਹ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੰ ਆਪੁ ਤੵਿਾਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਣੁਕਹ ॥
1357.t: par ni(n)dhaa neh srot sravana(n) aap tiyeaag sagal renukeh ||
1357.e: They do not listen to slander; renouncing self-conceit, they become the dust of all.

1357.g: ਖਟ ਲਖੵਣ ਪੂਰਨੰ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੪੦॥
1357.t: khaT lakhayen poorana(n) purakheh naanak naam saadh savaijaneh ||40||
1357.e: Whoever has these six qualities, O Nanak, is called a Holy friend. ||40||

1357.g: ਅਜਾ ਭੋਗੰਤ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੰ ਬਸੰਤੇ ਸਮੀਪਿ ਕੇਹਰਹ ॥
1357.t: ajaa bhoga(n)t ka(n)dh moola(n) basa(n)te sameep kehareh ||
1357.e: The goat enjoys eating fruits and roots, but if it lives near a tiger, it is always anxious.

1357.g: ਤਤ੍ਰ ਗਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖੰ ਬਿਆਪਤੇ ॥੪੧॥
1357.t: tatr gate sa(n)saareh naanak sog harakha(n) biaapate ||41||
1357.e: This is the condition of the world, O Nanak; it is afflicted by pleasure and pain. ||41||

1357.g: ਛਲੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨੰ ਅਪਰਾਧੰ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਮਲੰ ॥
1357.t: chhala(n) chhidhra(n) koT bighana(n) aparaadha(n) kilabikh mala(n) ||
1357.e: Fraud, false accusations, millions of diseases, sins and the filthy residues of evil mistakes;

1357.g: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹੰ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨੰ ਮਦੰ ਮਾਯਾ ਬਿਆਪਿਤੰ ॥
1357.t: bharam moha(n) maan apamaana(n) madha(n) maayaa biaapita(n) ||
1357.e: doubt, emotional attachment, pride, dishonor and intoxication with Maya

1357.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਤੵੁ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਿ ਨਰਕਹ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵੰ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ॥
1357.t: mritaye janam bhrama(n)t narakeh anik upaava(n) na sidhayete ||
1357.e: these lead mortals to death and rebirth, wandering lost in hell. In spite of all sorts of efforts, salvation is not found.

1357.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਹ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
1357.t: niramala(n) saadh sa(n)geh japa(n)t naanak gopaal naama(n) ||
1357.e: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, mortals become immaculate and pure.

1357.g: ਰਮੰਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਹ ॥੪੨॥
1357.t: rama(n)t gun gobi(n)dh nit prateh ||42||
1357.e: They continually dwell upon the Glorious Praises of God. ||42||

1357.g: ਤਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਮਣ ਸੀਲ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
1357.t: taran saran suaamee raman seel paramesureh ||
1357.e: In the Sanctuary of the Kind-hearted Lord, our Transcendent Lord and Master, we are carried across.

1357.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥਹ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
1357.t: karan kaaran samaratheh dhaan dhet prabh pooraneh ||
1357.e: God is the Perfect, All-powerful Cause of causes; He is the Giver of gifts.

1357.g: ਨਿਰਾਸ ਆਸ ਕਰਣੰ ਸਗਲ ਅਰਥ ਆਲਯਹ ॥
1357.t: niraas aas karana(n) sagal arath aalayeh ||
1357.e: He gives hope to the hopeless. He is the Source of all riches.

1357.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲ ਜਾਚੰਤ ਜਾਚਿਕਹ ॥੪੩॥
1357.t: gun nidhaan simara(n)t naanak sagal jaacha(n)t jaachikeh ||43||
1357.e: Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Treasure of Virtue; we are all beggars, begging at His Door. ||43||

1357.g: ਦੁਰਗਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਸੁਗਮੰ ਮਹਾ ਦੂਖ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖਣਹ ॥
1357.t: dhuragam sathaan sugama(n) mahaa dhookh sarab sookhaneh ||
1357.e: The most difficult place becomes easy, and the worst pain turns into pleasure.

1357.g: ਦੁਰਬਚਨ ਭੇਦ ਭਰਮੰ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਿਸਨੰ ਤ ਸੁਰਜਨਹ ॥
1357.t: dhurabachan bhedh bharama(n) saakat pisana(n) ta surajaneh ||
1357.e: Evil words, differences and doubts are obliterated, and even faithless cynics and malicious gossips become good people.

1357.g: ਅਸਥਿਤੰ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖੰ ਭੈ ਖੀਣੰ ਤ ਨਿਰਭਵਹ ॥
1357.t: asathita(n) sog harakha(n) bhai kheena(n) ta nirabhaveh ||
1357.e: They become steady and stable, whether happy or sad; their fears are taken away, and they are fearless.

1358.g: ਭੈ ਅਟਵੀਅੰ ਮਹਾ ਨਗਰ ਬਾਸੰ ਧਰਮ ਲਖੵਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
1358.t: bhai aTaveea(n) mahaa nagar baasa(n) dharam lakhayen prabh miaa ||
1358.e: The dreadful woods become a well-populated city; such are the merits of the righteous life of Dharma, given by God's Grace.

1358.g: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਣੰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਯਾਲ ਚਰਣੰ ॥੪੪॥
1358.t: saadh sa(n)gam raam raam ramana(n) saran naanak har har dhayaal charana(n) ||44||
1358.e: Chanting the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, the Lotus Feet of the Merciful Lord are found. ||44||

1358.g: ਹੇ ਅਜਿਤ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮੰ ਅਤਿ ਬਲਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਰਦਨਹ ॥
1358.t: he ajit soor sa(n)graama(n) at balanaa bahu maradhaneh ||
1358.e: O emotional attachment, you are the invincible warrior of the battlefield of life; you totally crush and destroy even the most powerful.

1358.g: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਦੇਵ ਮਾਨੁਖੵੰ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਮੋਹਨਹ ॥
1358.t: gan ga(n)dharab dhev maanukhaye(n) pas pa(n)khee bimohaneh ||
1358.e: You entice and fascinate even the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, gods, mortals, beasts and birds.

1358.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗਦੀਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥੪੫॥
1358.t: har karanahaara(n) namasakaara(n) saran naanak jagadheesavaireh ||45||
1358.e: Nanak bows in humble surrender to the Lord; he seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe. ||45||

1358.g: ਹੇ ਕਾਮੰ ਨਰਕ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੰ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵਣਹ ॥
1358.t: he kaama(n) narak bisraama(n) bahu jonee bhramaavaneh ||
1358.e: O sexual desire, you lead the mortals to hell; you make them wander in reincarnation through countless species.

1358.g: ਚਿਤ ਹਰਣੰ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਗੰਮੵੰ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੀਲ ਬਿਦਾਰਣਹ ॥
1358.t: chit harana(n) trai lok ga(n)maye(n) jap tap seel bidhaaraneh ||
1358.e: You cheat the consciousness, and pervade the three worlds. You destroy meditation, penance and virtue.

1358.g: ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਅਵਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਵਣਹ ॥
1358.t: alap sukh avit cha(n)chal uooch neech samaavaneh ||
1358.e: But you give only shallow pleasure, while you make the mortals weak and unsteady; you pervade the high and the low.

1358.g: ਤਵ ਭੈ ਬਿਮੁੰਚਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥੪੬॥
1358.t: tav bhai bimu(n)chit saadh sa(n)gam oT naanak naaraineh ||46||
1358.e: Your fear is dispelled in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, through the Protection and Support of the Lord. ||46||

1358.g: ਹੇ ਕਲਿ ਮੂਲ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੰ ਕਦੰਚ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨ ਉਪਰਜਤੇ ॥
1358.t: he kal mool karodha(n) kadha(n)ch karunaa na uparajate ||
1358.e: O anger, you are the root of conflict; compassion never rises up in you.

1358.g: ਬਿਖਯੰਤ ਜੀਵੰ ਵਸੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਨਿਰਤੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਜਥਾ ਮਰਕਟਹ ॥
1358.t: bikhaya(n)t jeeva(n) vasaye(n) karot nirataye(n) karot jathaa marakaTeh ||
1358.e: You take the corrupt, sinful beings in your power, and make them dance like monkeys.

1358.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਸਨ ਤਾੜੰਤਿ ਜਮਦੂਤਹ ਤਵ ਸੰਗੇ ਅਧਮੰ ਨਰਹ ॥
1358.t: anik saasan taaRa(n)t jamadhooteh tav sa(n)ge adhama(n) nareh ||
1358.e: Associating with you, mortals are debased and punished by the Messenger of Death in so many ways.

1358.g: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਰਖੵਾ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੪੭॥
1358.t: dheen dhukh bha(n)jan dhayaal prabh naanak sarab jeea rakhayeaa karot ||47||
1358.e: O Destroyer of the pains of the poor, O Merciful God, Nanak prays for You to protect all begins from such anger. ||47||

1358.g: ਹੇ ਲੋਭਾ ਲੰਪਟ ਸੰਗ ਸਿਰਮੋਰਹ ਅਨਿਕ ਲਹਰੀ ਕਲੋਲਤੇ ॥
1358.t: he lobhaa la(n)paT sa(n)g siramoreh anik laharee kalolate ||
1358.e: O greed, you cling to even the great, assaulting them with countless waves.

1358.g: ਧਾਵੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਡੋਲਤੇ ॥
1358.t: dhaava(n)t jeeaa bahu prakaara(n) anik bhaa(n)t bahu ddolate ||
1358.e: You cause them to run around wildly in all directions, wobbling and wavering unsteadily.

1358.g: ਨਚ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਨਚ ਇਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਬਾਧਵ ਨਚ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਤਵ ਲਜਯਾ ॥
1358.t: nach mitra(n) nach isaTa(n) nach baadhav nach maat pitaa tav lajayaa ||
1358.e: You have no respect for friends, ideals, relations, mother or father.

1358.g: ਅਕਰਣੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਅਖਾਦੵਿ ਖਾਦੵੰ ਅਸਾਜੵੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਮਜਯਾ ॥
1358.t: akarana(n) karot akhaadhiye khaadhaye(n) asaajaye(n) saaj samajayaa ||
1358.e: You make them do what they should not do. You make them eat what they should not eat. You make them accomplish what they should not accomplish.

1358.g: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਗੵਾਪ੍ਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥੪੮॥
1358.t: traeh traeh saran suaamee bigayeaapit naanak har narahareh ||48||
1358.e: Save me, save me - I have come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Nanak prays to the Lord. ||48||

1358.g: ਹੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮੂਲੰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੰ ਪਾਪਾਤਮਾ ॥
1358.t: he janam maran moola(n) aha(n)kaara(n) paapaatamaa ||
1358.e: O egotism, you are the root of birth and death and the cycle of reincarnation; you are the very soul of sin.

1358.g: ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਤਜੰਤਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਯਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਤੀਰਨਹ ॥
1358.t: mitra(n) taja(n)t satra(n) dhiraRa(n)t anik maayaa bisteeraneh ||
1358.e: You forsake friends, and hold tight to enemies. You spread out countless illusions of Maya.

1358.g: ਆਵੰਤ ਜਾਵੰਤ ਥਕੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗਣਹ ॥
1358.t: aava(n)t jaava(n)t thaka(n)t jeeaa dhukh sukh bahu bhoganeh ||
1358.e: You cause the living beings to come and go until they are exhausted. You lead them to experience pain and pleasure.

1358.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਯਾਨ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਰਮਣੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗਣਹ ॥
1358.t: bhram bhayaan udhiaan ramana(n) mahaa bikaT asaadh roganeh ||
1358.e: You lead them to wander lost in the terrible wilderness of doubt; you lead them to contract the most horrible, incurable diseases.

1358.g: ਬੈਦੵੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੪੯॥
1358.t: baidhaye(n) paarabraham paramesavair aaraadh naanak har har hare ||49||
1358.e: The only Physician is the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord God. Nanak worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||49||

1358.g: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਗਦ ਗੁਰੋ ॥
1358.t: he praan naath gobi(n)dheh kirapaa nidhaan jagadh guro ||
1358.e: O Lord of the Universe, Master of the Breath of life, Treasure of Mercy, Guru of the World.

1358.g: ਹੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਣਹ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੋ ॥
1358.t: he sa(n)saar taap haraneh karunaa mai sabh dhukh haro ||
1358.e: O Destroyer of the fever of the world, Embodiment of Compassion, please take away all my pain.

1358.g: ਹੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗ ਦਯਾਲਹ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਮਯਾ ਕਰੋ ॥
1358.t: he saran jog dhayaaleh dheenaa naath mayaa karo ||
1358.e: O Merciful Lord, Potent to give Sanctuary, Master of the meek and humble, please be kind to me.

1358.g: ਸਰੀਰ ਸ੍ਵਸਥ ਖੀਣ ਸਮਏ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧਵਹ ॥੫੦॥
1358.t: sareer savaisath kheen same simara(n)t naanak raam dhaamodhar maadhaveh ||50||
1358.e: Whether his body is healthy or sick, let Nanak meditate in remembrance on You, Lord. ||50||

1358.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣੰ ਰਮਣੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
1358.t: charan kamal sarana(n) ramana(n) gopaal keerataneh ||
1358.e: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet, where I sing the Kirtan of His Praises.

1358.g: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਤਰਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਭੈ ਦੁਤਰਹ ॥੫੧॥
1358.t: saadh sa(n)gen tarana(n) naanak mahaa saagar bhai dhutareh ||51||
1358.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak is carried across the utterly terrifying, difficult world-ocean. ||51||

1358.g: ਸਿਰ ਮਸ੍ਤਕ ਰਖੵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਹਸ੍ਤ ਕਾਯਾ ਰਖੵਾ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥
1358.t: sir mastak rakhayeaa paarabrahama(n) hast kaayaa rakhayeaa paramesavaireh ||
1358.e: The Supreme Lord God has procted my head and forehead; the Transcendent Lord has protected my hands and body.

1358.g: ਆਤਮ ਰਖੵਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਨ ਚਰਣ ਰਖੵਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ੍ਵਰਹ ॥
1358.t: aatam rakhayeaa gopaal suaamee dhan charan rakhayeaa jagadheesavaireh ||
1358.e: God, my Lord and Master, has saved my soul; the Lord of the Universe has saved my wealth and feet.

1358.g: ਸਰਬ ਰਖੵਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਯਾਲਹ ਭੈ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨਹ ॥
1358.t: sarab rakhayeaa gur dhayaaleh bhai dhookh binaasaneh ||
1358.e: The Merciful Guru has protected everything, and destroyed my fear and suffering.

1358.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਚੁਤਹ ॥੫੨॥
1358.t: bhagat vachhal anaath naathe saran naanak purakh achuteh ||52||
1358.e: God is the Lover of His devotees, the Master of the masterless. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Imperishable Primal Lord God. ||52||

1358.g: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਆਕਾਸੰ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੰ ਕਾਸਟ ਬੇਸਟੰ ॥
1358.t: jen kalaa dhaario aakaasa(n) baisa(n)tara(n) kaasaT besaTa(n) ||
1358.e: His Power supports the sky, and locks fire within wood.

1358.g: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਤੵਿੰ ਸਾਸੰ ਸਰੀਰ ਧਾਰਣੰ ॥
1358.t: jen kalaa sas soor nakhayetr jotiye(n) saasa(n) sareer dhaarana(n) ||
1358.e: His Power supports the moon, the sun and the stars, and infuses light and breath into the body.

1359.g: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੰ ਨਹ ਛੇਦੰਤ ਜਠਰ ਰੋਗਣਹ ॥
1359.t: jen kalaa maat garabh pratipaala(n) neh chhedha(n)t jaThar roganeh ||
1359.e: His Power provides nourishment in the womb of the mother, and does not let disease strike.

1359.g: ਤੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਸਰੋਵਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਛਿਜੰਤਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਤੋਯਣਹ ॥੫੩॥
1359.t: ten kalaa asatha(n)bha(n) sarovara(n) naanak neh chhija(n)t tara(n)g toyaneh ||53||
1359.e: His Power holds back the ocean, O Nanak, and does not allow the waves of water to destroy the land. ||53||

1359.g: ਗੁਸਾਂਈ ਗਰਿਸ੍ਟ ਰੂਪੇਣ ਸਿਮਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਵਣਹ ॥
1359.t: gusaa(n)iee garisaT roopen simarana(n) sarabatr jeevaneh ||
1359.e: The Lord of the World is Supremely Beautiful; His Meditation is the Life of all.

1359.g: ਲਬਧੵੰ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸ੍ਵਛ ਮਾਰਗ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਣਹ ॥੫੪॥
1359.t: labadhaye(n) sa(n)t sa(n)gen naanak savaichh maarag har bhagataneh ||54||
1359.e: In the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, He is found on the path of devotional worship of the Lord. ||54||

1359.g: ਮਸਕੰ ਭਗਨੰਤ ਸੈਲੰ ਕਰਦਮੰ ਤਰੰਤ ਪਪੀਲਕਹ ॥
1359.t: masaka(n) bhagana(n)t saila(n) karadhama(n) tara(n)t papeelakeh ||
1359.e: The mosquito pierces the stone, the ant crosses the swamp,

1359.g: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਲੰਘੰਤਿ ਪਿੰਗੰ ਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਅੰਧਕਹ ॥
1359.t: saagara(n) la(n)gha(n)t pi(n)ga(n) tam paragaas a(n)dhakeh ||
1359.e: the cripple crosses the ocean, and the blind sees in the darkness,

1359.g: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੫੫॥
1359.t: saadh sa(n)gen simara(n)t gobi(n)dh saran naanak har har hare ||55||
1359.e: meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat. Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||55||

1359.g: ਤਿਲਕ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਬਿਪ੍ਰਾ ਅਮਰ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਰਾਜਨਹ ॥
1359.t: tilak heena(n) jathaa bipraa amar heena(n) jathaa raajaneh ||
1359.e: Like a Brahmin without a sacred mark on his forehead, or a king without the power of command,

1359.g: ਆਵਧ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਸੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਰਮ ਹੀਣੰ ਤਥਾ ਬੈਸ੍ਨਵਹ ॥੫੬॥
1359.t: aavadh heena(n) jathaa sooraa naanak dharam heena(n) tathaa baisanaveh ||56||
1359.e: or a warrior without weapons, so is the devotee of God without Dharmic Faith. ||56||

1359.g: ਨ ਸੰਖੰ ਨ ਚਕ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਗਦਾ ਨ ਸਿਆਮੰ ॥
1359.t: n sa(n)kha(n) na chakara(n) na gadhaa na siaama(n) ||
1359.e: God has no conch-shell, no religious mark, no paraphernalia; he does not have blue skin.

1359.g: ਅਸ੍ਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੰ ਰਹੰਤ ਜਨਮੰ ॥
1359.t: ascharaj roopa(n) raha(n)t janama(n) ||
1359.e: His Form is Wondrous and Amazing. He is beyond incarnation.

1359.g: ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕਥੰਤਿ ਬੇਦਾ ॥
1359.t: net net katha(n)t bedhaa ||
1359.e: The Vedas say that He is not this, and not that.

1359.g: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ॥
1359.t: uooch mooch apaar gobi(n)dheh ||
1359.e: The Lord of the Universe is Lofty and High, Great and Infinite.

1359.g: ਬਸੰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਬੁਝੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਅਹ ॥੫੭॥
1359.t: basa(n)t saadh ridhaya(n) achut bujha(n)t naanak baddabhaage'eeh ||57||
1359.e: The Imperishable Lord abides in the hearts of the Holy. He is understood, O Nanak, by those who are very fortunate. ||57||

1359.g: ਉਦਿਆਨ ਬਸਨੰ ਸੰਸਾਰੰ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਸਿਆਲ ਖਰਹ ॥
1359.t: audhiaan basana(n) sa(n)saara(n) sanaba(n)dhee savaiaan siaal khareh ||
1359.e: Living in the world, it is like a wild jungle. One's relatives are like dogs, jackals and donkeys.

1359.g: ਬਿਖਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਮਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਦਿਰੰ ਮਹਾਂ ਅਸਾਧ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰਹ ॥
1359.t: bikham sathaan man moh madhira(n) mahaa(n) asaadh pa(n)ch tasakareh ||
1359.e: In this difficult place, the mind is intoxicated with the wine of emotional attachment; the five unconquered thieves lurk there.

1359.g: ਹੀਤ ਮੋਹ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਣੰ ਅਹੰ ਫਾਂਸ ਤੀਖੵਣ ਕਠਿਨਹ ॥
1359.t: heet moh bhai bharam bhramana(n) aha(n) faa(n)s teekhayen kaThineh ||
1359.e: The mortals wander lost in love and emotional attachment, fear and doubt; they are caught in the sharp, strong noose of egotism.

1359.g: ਪਾਵਕ ਤੋਅ ਅਸਾਧ ਘੋਰੰ ਅਗਮ ਤੀਰ ਨਹ ਲੰਘਨਹ ॥
1359.t: paavak toa asaadh ghora(n) agam teer neh la(n)ghaneh ||
1359.e: The ocean of fire is terrifying and impassable. The distant shore is so far away; it cannot be reached.

1359.g: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਉਧਰਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ॥੫੮॥
1359.t: bhaj saadhasa(n)g guopaal naanak har charan saran udharan kirapaa ||58||
