1391.t: sabadh soor balava(n)t kaam ar karodh binaasan ||
1391.e: You are the Heroic Warrior of the Shabad, the Word of God. Your Power destroys sexual desire and anger.

1391.g: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਣ ॥
1391.t: lobh moh vas karan saran jaachik pratipaalan ||
1391.e: You have overpowered greed and emotional attachment; You nurture and cherish those who seek Your Sanctuary.

1391.g: ਆਤਮ ਰਤ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਣ ਕਹਣ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਲ ਢਾਲਣ ॥
1391.t: aatam rat sa(n)grahan kahan a(n)mirat kal ddaalan ||
1391.e: You gather in the joyful love of the soul; Your Words have the Potency to bring forth Ambrosial Nectar.

1391.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸਤਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਪੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
1391.t: satiguroo kal satigur tilak sat laagai so pai tarai ||
1391.e: You are appointed the True Guru, the True Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; whoever is truly attached to You is carried across.

1391.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਜਗਤ ਫਿਰਣਸੀਹ ਅੰਗਰਉ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਲਹਣਾ ਕਰੈ ॥੫॥
1391.t: gur jagat firanaseeh a(n)garau raaj jog lahanaa karai ||5||
1391.e: The lion, the son of Pheru, is Guru Angad, the Guru of the World; Lehnaa practices Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||5||

1392.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਕਲ ਲਿਵ ਰਹੈ ਕਰਨ ਸਿਉ ਇਛਾ ਚਾਰਹ ॥
1392.t: sadhaa akal liv rahai karan siau ichhaa chaareh ||
1392.e: Your mind remains lovingly attuned to the Lord forever; You do whatever you desire.

1392.g: ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਸਪੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਵੈ ਖਵੈ ਕਸੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੀਚਾਰਹ ॥
1392.t: dhrum sapoor jiau nivai khavai kas bimal beechaareh ||
1392.e: Like the tree heavy with fruit, You bow in humility, and endure the pain of it; You are pure of thought.

1392.g: ਇਹੈ ਤਤੁ ਜਾਣਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਗਤਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਬਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
1392.t: eihai tat jaanio sarab gat alakh biddaanee ||
1392.e: You realize this reality, that the Lord is All-pervading, Unseen and Amazing.

1392.g: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਲ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1392.t: sahaj bhai sa(n)chio kiran a(n)mirat kal baanee ||
1392.e: With intuitive ease, You send forth the rays of the Ambrosial Word of power.

1392.g: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜਿ ਲਯੌ ॥
1392.t: gur gam pramaan tai paio sat sa(n)tokh graahaj layau ||
1392.e: You have risen to the state of the certified Guru; you grasp truth and contentment.

1392.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਰਸਿਓ ਕਲੁ ਸਮੁਲਵੈ ਜਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਲਹਣੇ ਭਯੌ ॥੬॥
1392.t: har parasio kal samulavai jan dharasan lahane bhayau ||6||
1392.e: KAL proclaims, that whoever attains the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of Lehnaa, meets with the Lord. ||6||

1392.g: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗਹਰਿ ਗਹੁ ਹਦਰਥਿ ਦੀਓ ॥
1392.t: man bisaas paio gahar gahu hadharath dheeo ||
1392.e: My mind has faith, that the Prophet has given You access to the Profound Lord.

1392.g: ਗਰਲ ਨਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਠਯੋ ਅਮਿਉ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਪੀਓ ॥
1392.t: garal naas tan naThayo amiau a(n)taragat peeo ||
1392.e: Your body has been purged of the deadly poison; You drink the Ambrosial Nectar deep within.

1392.g: ਰਿਦਿ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ਜਾਗਿਓ ਅਲਖਿ ਕਲ ਧਰੀ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ॥
1392.t: ridh bigaas jaagio alakh kal dharee juga(n)tar ||
1392.e: Your Heart has blossomed forth in awareness of the Unseen Lord, who has infused His Power throughout the ages.

1392.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਸਾਮਾਨਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥
1392.t: satigur sahaj samaadh ravio saamaan nira(n)tar ||
1392.e: O True Guru, You are intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi, with continuity and equality.

1392.g: ਉਦਾਰਉ ਚਿਤ ਦਾਰਿਦ ਹਰਨ ਪਿਖੰਤਿਹ ਕਲਮਲ ਤ੍ਰਸਨ ॥
1392.t: audhaarau chit dhaaridh haran pikha(n)teh kalamal trasan ||
1392.e: You are open-minded and large-hearted, the Destroyer of poverty; seeing You, sins are afraid.

1392.g: ਸਦ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਲੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਜਸੁ ਜੰਪਉ ਲਹਣੇ ਰਸਨ ॥੭॥
1392.t: sadh ra(n)g sahaj kal ucharai jas ja(n)pau lahane rasan ||7||
1392.e: Says KAL, I lovingly, continually, intuitively chant the Praises of Lehnaa with my tongue. ||7||

1392.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
1392.t: naam avakhadh naam aadhaar ar naam samaadh sukh sadhaa naam neesaan sohai ||
1392.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our medicine; the Naam is our support; the Naam is the peace of Samaadhi. The Naam is the insignia which embellishes us forever.

1392.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੌ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰਹ ਬੋਹੈ ॥
1392.t: ra(n)g ratau naam siau kal naam sur nareh bohai ||
1392.e: KAL is imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Naam which is the fragrance of gods and human beings.

1392.g: ਨਾਮ ਪਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਰਵਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
1392.t: naam paras jin paio sat pragaTio rav loi ||
1392.e: Whoever obtains the Naam, the Philosopher's Stone, becomes the embodiment of Truth, manifest and radiant throughout the world.

1392.g: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥
1392.t: dharasan parasiaai guroo kai aThasaTh majan hoi ||8||
1392.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, it is as if one has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||8||

1392.g: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੰਤੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
1392.t: sach teerath sach isanaan ar bhojan bhaau sach sadhaa sach bhaakha(n)t sohai ||
1392.e: The True Name is the sacred shrine, the True Name is the cleansing bath of purification and food. The True Name is eternal love; chant the True Name, and be embellished.

1392.g: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਬੋਹੈ ॥
1392.t: sach paio gur sabadh sach naam sa(n)gatee bohai ||
1392.e: The True Name is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, is fragrant with the True Name.

1392.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਵਰਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਕਲ ਵਖਾਣੁ ॥
1392.t: jis sach sa(n)jam varat sach kab jan kal vakhaan ||
1392.e: KAL the poet utters the Praises of the one whose self-discipline is the True Name, and whose fast is the True Name.

1392.g: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੯॥
1392.t: dharasan parasiaai guroo kai sach janam paravaan ||9||
1392.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, one's life is approved and certified in the True Name. ||9||

1392.g: ਅਮਿਅ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਭ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਅਘ ਪਾਪ ਸਕਲ ਮਲ ॥
1392.t: amia dhirasaT subh karai harai agh paap sakal mal ||
1392.e: When You bestow Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace, You eradicate all wickedness, sin and filth.

1392.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਵਸਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਬਲ ॥
1392.t: kaam karodh ar lobh moh vas karai sabhai bal ||
1392.e: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - You have overcome all these powerful passions.

1392.g: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
1392.t: sadhaa sukh man vasai dhukh sa(n)saareh khovai ||
1392.e: Your mind is filled with peace forever; You banish the sufferings of the world.

1392.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਜਨਮ ਹਮ ਕਾਲਖ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
1392.t: gur nav nidh dhareeaau janam ham kaalakh dhovai ||
1392.e: The Guru is the river of the nine treasures, washing off the dirt of our lives.

1392.g: ਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਟਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
1392.t: s kahu Tal gur seveeaai ahinis sahaj subhai ||
1392.e: So speaks TAL the poet: serve the Guru, day and night, with intuitive love and affection.

1392.g: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
1392.t: dharasan parasiaai guroo kai janam maran dhukh jai ||10||
1392.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru, the pains of death and rebirth are taken away. ||10||

1392.g: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਤੀਜੇ ਕੇ ੩
1392.t: savie'ee mahale teeje ke 3
1392.e: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Third Mehla:

1392.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1392.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1392.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1392.g: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਿਵਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
1392.t: soiee purakh sivar saachaa jaa kaa ik naam achhal sa(n)saare ||
1392.e: Dwell upon that Primal Being, the True Lord God; in this world, His One Name is Undeceivable.

1392.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਭਗਤ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
1392.t: jin bhagat bhavajal taare simarahu soiee naam paradhaan ||
1392.e: He carries His devotees across the terrifying world-ocean; meditate in remembrance on His Naam, Supreme and Sublime.

1392.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿਕੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਹਣਾ ਥਪਿਓ ਜੇਨ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸਿਧੀ ॥
1392.t: tit naam rasik naanak lahanaa thapio jen srab sidhee ||
1392.e: Nanak delighted in the Naam; He established Lehnaa as Guru, who was imbued with all supernatural spiritual powers.

1392.g: ਕਵਿ ਜਨ ਕਲੵ ਸਬੁਧੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਨ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਬਿਸ੍ਤਰੀਯਾ ॥
1392.t: kav jan kalaye sabudhee keerat jan amaradhaas bistareeyaa ||
1392.e: So speaks KALL the poet: the glory of the wise, sublime and humble Amar Daas is spread throughout the world.

1392.g: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰਵਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਸਾਖ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਮਵਲਸਰਾ ॥
1392.t: keerat rav kiran pragaT sa(n)saareh saakh tarovar mavalasaraa ||
1392.e: His Praises radiate throughout the world, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the maulsar (fragrant) tree.

1392.g: ਉਤਰਿ ਦਖਿਣਹਿ ਪੁਬਿ ਅਰੁ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪੰਥਿ ਨਰਾ ॥
1392.t: autar dhakhineh pub ar pascham jai jai kaar japa(n)th naraa ||
1392.e: In the north, south, east and west, people proclaim Your Victory.

1393.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਰਦਾਯਉ ਉਲਟਿ ਗੰਗ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਧਰੀਆ ॥
1393.t: har naam rasan gurmukh baradhaayau ulaT ga(n)g pascham dhareeaa ||
1393.e: The Guru spoke the Lord's Name with His mouth and broadcast it throughout the world, to turn the tide of the hearts of men.

1393.g: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
1393.t: soiee naam achhal bhagateh bhav taaran amaradhaas gur kau furiaa ||1||
1393.e: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||1||

1393.g: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਖੵ ਅਰੁ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹਰਾ ॥
1393.t: simareh soiee naam jakhaye ar ki(n)nar saadhik sidh samaadh haraa ||
1393.e: The gods and heavenly heralds, the Siddhas and seekers and Shiva in Samaadhi meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1393.g: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਅਵਰ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦਿ ਵਰਾ ॥
1393.t: simareh nakhayetr avar dhraoo ma(n)ddal naaradhaadh prahalaadh varaa ||
1393.e: The stars and the realms of Dhroo, and devotees like Naaraad and Prahlaad meditate on the Naam.

1393.g: ਸਸੀਅਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ ਸੈਲ ਲੋਅ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ॥
1393.t: saseear ar soor naam ulaaseh sail loa jin udhariaa ||
1393.e: The moon and the sun long for the Naam; it has saved even mountain ranges.

1393.g: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
1393.t: soiee naam achhal bhagateh bhav taaran amaradhaas gur kau furiaa ||2||
1393.e: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||2||

1393.g: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਵਰਿ ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਸਮੁਧਰਿਆ ॥
1393.t: soiee naam sivar nav naath nira(n)jan siv sanakaadh samudhariaa ||
1393.e: Dwelling upon that Immaculate Naam, the nine Yogic masters, Shiva and Sanak and many others have been emancipated.

1393.g: ਚਵਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
1393.t: chavaraaseeh sidh budh jit raate a(n)bareek bhavajal tariaa ||
1393.e: The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of supernatural spiritual powers, and the Buddhas are imbued with the Naam; it carried Ambreek across the terrifying world-ocean.

1393.g: ਉਧਉ ਅਕ੍ਰੂਰੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਲਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
1393.t: audhau akaraoor tilochan naamaa kal kabeer kilavikh hariaa ||
1393.e: It has erased the sins of Oodho, Akroor, Trilochan, Naam Dayv and Kabeer, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

1393.g: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
1393.t: soiee naam achhal bhagateh bhav taaran amaradhaas gur kau furiaa ||3||
1393.e: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||3||

1393.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
1393.t: tit naam laag tetees dhiaaveh jatee tapeesur man vasiaa ||
1393.e: The three hundred thirty million angels meditate, attached to the Naam; it is enshrined within the minds of the celibates and ascetics.

1393.g: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੰਗੇਵ ਪਿਤਾਮਹ ਚਰਣ ਚਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿਆ ॥
1393.t: soiee naam simar ga(n)gev pitaameh charan chit a(n)mirat rasiaa ||
1393.e: Bhisham Pitama, the son of the Ganges, meditated on that Naam; his consciousness delighted in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Feet.

1393.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਗਰੂਅ ਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਉਧਰੀਆ ॥
1393.t: tit naam guroo ga(n)bheer garooa mat sat kar sa(n)gat udhareeaa ||
1393.e: The great and profound Guru has brought forth the Naam; accepting the teachings as true, the Holy Congregation has been saved.

1393.g: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
1393.t: soiee naam achhal bhagateh bhav taaran amaradhaas gur kau furiaa ||4||
1393.e: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||4||

1393.g: ਨਾਮ ਕਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਵਿ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਸਾਖਹ ॥
1393.t: naam kit sa(n)saar kiran rav suratar saakheh ||
1393.e: The Glory of the Naam shines forth, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the Elysian Tree.

1393.g: ਉਤਰਿ ਦਖਿਣਿ ਪੁਬਿ ਦੇਸਿ ਪਸ੍ਚਮਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਾਖਹ ॥
1393.t: autar dhakhin pub dhes pascham jas bhaakheh ||
1393.e: In the countries of the north, south, east and west, the Praises of the Naam are chanted.

1393.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਸਕਯਥੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੈ ॥
1393.t: janam ta ih sakayath jit naam har ridhai nivaasai ||
1393.e: Life is fruitful, when the Name of the Lord abides in the heart.

1393.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਆਸਾਸੈ ॥
1393.t: sur nar gan ga(n)dharab chhia dharasan aasaasai ||
1393.e: The angelic beings, heavenly heralds, celestial singers and the six Shaastras yearn for the Naam.

1393.g: ਭਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧੁ ਤੇਜੋ ਤਨੌ ਕਲੵ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਧੵਾਇਅਓ ॥
1393.t: bhalau prasidh tejo tanau kalaye joR kar dhayeaiao ||
1393.e: The son of Tayj Bhaan of the Bhalla dynasty is noble and famous; with his palms pressed together, KALL meditates on Him.

1393.g: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਭਵਜਲ ਹਰਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
1393.t: soiee naam bhagat bhavajal haran gur amaradhaas tai paio ||5||
1393.e: The Naam takes away the fears of the devotees about the word-ocean; Guru Amar Daas has obtained it. ||5||

1393.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨਰ ਨਾਮਿ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
1393.t: naam dhiaaveh dhev tetees ar saadhik sidh nar naam kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd dhaare ||
1393.e: The thirty-one million gods meditate on the Naam, along with the Siddhas and seekers; the Naam supports solar systems and galaxies.

1393.g: ਜਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਧਿਓ ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਾਰੇ ॥
1393.t: jeh naam samaadhio harakh sog sam kar sahaare ||
1393.e: One who meditates on the Naam in Samaadhi, endures sorrow and joy as one and the same.

1393.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਰੋਮਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਭਗਤ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1393.t: naam siroman sarab mai bhagat rahe liv dhaar ||
1393.e: The Naam is the most sublime of all; the devotees remain lovingly attuned to it.

1393.g: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮਰ ਗੁਰ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੀਓ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
1393.t: soiee naam padhaarath amar gur tus dheeo karataar ||6||
1393.e: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the treasure of the Naam, by the Creator Lord, in His Pleasure. ||6||

1393.g: ਸਤਿ ਸੂਰਉ ਸੀਲਿ ਬਲਵੰਤੁ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਘਨ ਗਰੂਅ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
1393.t: sat soorau seel balava(n)t sat bhai sa(n)gat saghan garooa mat niravair leenaa ||
1393.e: He is the Warrior Hero of Truth, humility is His Power. His Loving Nature inspires the Congregation with deep and profound understanding; He is absorbed in the Lord, free of hate and vengeance.

1393.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਧਵਲੁ ਧੁਜਾ ਸੇਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਬੀਣਾ ॥
1393.t: jis dheeraj dhur dhaval dhujaa set baiku(n)Th beenaa ||
1393.e: Patience has been His white banner since the beginning of time, planted on the bridge to heaven.

1393.g: ਪਰਸਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਜਿਹ ਕਰਤਾਰਹ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
1393.t: paraseh sa(n)t piaar jeh karataareh sa(n)jog ||
1393.e: The Saints meet their Beloved Guru, who is united with the Creator Lord.

1393.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਮਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਤਉ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੭॥
1393.t: satiguroo sev sukh paio amar gur keetau jog ||7||
1393.e: Serving the True Guru, they find peace; Guru Amar Daas has given them this ability. ||7||

1393.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸ ਖਾਣੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਯ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਸ੍ਟ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1393.t: naam naavan naam ras khaan ar bhojan naam ras sadhaa chaay mukh misaT baanee ||
1393.e: The Naam is His cleansing bath; the Naam is the food He eats; the Naam is the taste He enjoys. With deep yearning, He chants the Sweet Bani of the Guru's Word forever.

1393.g: ਧਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਸਾਇ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
1393.t: dhan satigur sevio jis pasai gat agam jaanee ||
1393.e: Blessed is service to the True Guru; by His Grace, the State of the Unfathomable Lord is known.

1393.g: ਕੁਲ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਸਮੁਧਰੇ ਪਾਯਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
1393.t: kul sa(n)booh samudhare paayau naam nivaas ||
1393.e: All Your generations are totally saved; You dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1394.g: ਸਕਯਥੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸੵਿਉ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੮॥
1394.t: sakayath janam kalayeucharai gur parasiyeau amar pragaas ||8||
1394.e: So speaks KALL: fruitful is the life of one who meets with Guru Amar Daas, radiant with the Light of God. ||8||

1394.g: ਬਾਰਿਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਹਿਣੈ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਵੈ ॥
1394.t: baarij kar dhaahinai sidh sanamukh mukh jovai ||
1394.e: On His right hand is the sign of the lotus; the Siddhis, the supernatural spiritual powers, await His Command.

1394.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਬਸੈ ਬਾਂਵਾਂਗਿ ਜੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕਾਂਤਰ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
1394.t: ridh basai baa(n)vaa(n)g ju teen lokaa(n)tar mohai ||
1394.e: On His left are worldly powers, which fascinate the three worlds.

1394.g: ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਅਕਹੀਉ ਸੋਇ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਉ ॥
1394.t: ridhai basai akaheeau soi ras tin hee jaatau ||
1394.e: The Inexpressible Lord abides in His Heart; He alone knows this joy.

1394.g: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਉ ॥
1394.t: mukhahu bhagat ucharai amar gur it ra(n)g raatau ||
1394.e: Guru Amar Daas utters the words of devotion, imbued with the Love of the Lord.

1394.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸਚਉ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਲੵ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਧੵਾਇਅਉ ॥
1394.t: masatak neesaan sachau karam kalaye joR kar dhayeaiaau ||
1394.e: On His forehead is the true insignia of the Lord's Mercy; with his palms pressed together, KALL meditates on Him.

1394.g: ਪਰਸਿਅਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਇਛ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੯॥
1394.t: parasiaau guroo satigur tilak sarab ichh tin paiaau ||9||
1394.e: Whoever meets with the Guru, the certified True Guru, has all his desires fulfilled. ||9||

1394.g: ਚਰਣ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪਵਲਿ ਰਯ ॥
1394.t: charan ta par sakayath charan gur amar paval ray ||
1394.e: Supremely fruitful are the feet which walk upon the path of Guru Amar Daas.

1394.g: ਹਥ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਹਥ ਲਗਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪਯ ॥
1394.t: hath ta par sakayath hath lageh gur amar pay ||
1394.e: Supremely fruitful are the hands which touch the feet of Guru Amar Daas.

1394.g: ਜੀਹ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਜੀਹ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਣਿਜੈ ॥
1394.t: jeeh ta par sakayath jeeh gur amar bhanijai ||
1394.e: Supremely fruitful is the tongue which utters the praises of Guru Amar Daas.

1394.g: ਨੈਣ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਨਯਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਪਿਖਿਜੈ ॥
1394.t: nain ta par sakayath nayan gur amar pikhijai ||
1394.e: Supremely fruitful are the eyes which behold Guru Amar Daas.

1394.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਤ ਪਰ ਸਕਯਥ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਜੈ ॥
1394.t: sravan ta par sakayath sravan gur amar sunijai ||
1394.e: Supremely fruitful are the ears which hear the Praises of Guru Amar Daas.

1394.g: ਸਕਯਥੁ ਸੁ ਹੀਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੀਅ ਬਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ॥
1394.t: sakayathu su heeau jit heea basai gur amaradhaas nij jagat pit ||
1394.e: Fruitful is the heart in which Guru Amar Daas, the Father of the world, Himself abides.

1394.g: ਸਕਯਥੁ ਸੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਜਾਲਪੁ ਭਣੈ ਜੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਿਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਨਿਤ ॥੧॥੧੦॥
1394.t: sakayathu su sir jaalap bhanai ju sir nivai gur amar nit ||1||10||
1394.e: Fruitful is the head, says Jaalap, which bows forever before Guru Amar Daas. ||1||10||

1394.g: ਤਿ ਨਰ ਦੁਖ ਨਹ ਭੁਖ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਨਿਧਨ ਨਹੁ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ॥
1394.t: t nar dhukh neh bhukh ta nar nidhan nahu kahe'eeh ||
1394.e: They do not suffer pain or hunger, and they cannot be called poor.

1394.g: ਤਿ ਨਰ ਸੋਕੁ ਨਹੁ ਹੁਐ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਅਹਿ ॥
1394.t: t nar sok nahu huaai ta nar se a(n)t na lahe'eeh ||
1394.e: They do not grieve, and their limits cannot be found.

1394.g: ਤਿ ਨਰ ਸੇਵ ਨਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਸਯ ਸਹਸ ਸਮਪਹਿ ॥
1394.t: t nar sev nahu kareh ta nar say sahas samapeh ||
1394.e: They do not serve anyone else, but they give gifts to hundreds and thousands.

1394.g: ਤਿ ਨਰ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬਹਹਿ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਉਥਪਿ ਬਿਥਪਹਿ ॥
1394.t: t nar dhuleechai baheh ta nar uthap bithapeh ||
1394.e: They sit on beautiful carpets; they establish and disestablish at will.

1394.g: ਸੁਖ ਲਹਹਿ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਅਭੈ ਪਟੁ ਰਿਪ ਮਧਿ ਤਿਹ ॥
1394.t: sukh laheh ta nar sa(n)saar meh abhai paT rip madh teh ||
1394.e: They find peace in this world, and live fearlessly amidst their enemies.

1394.g: ਸਕਯਥ ਤਿ ਨਰ ਜਾਲਪੁ ਭਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਜਿਹ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
1394.t: sakayath ta nar jaalap bhanai gur amaradhaas suprasa(n)n jeh ||2||11||
1394.e: They are fruitful and prosperous, says Jaalap. Guru Amar Daas is pleased with them. ||2||11||

1394.g: ਤੈ ਪਢਿਅਉ ਇਕੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਰਿਅਉ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ॥
1394.t: tai paddiaau ik man dhariaau ik kar ik pachhaanio ||
1394.e: You read about the One Lord, and enshrine Him in Your mind; You realize the One and Only Lord.

1394.g: ਨਯਣਿ ਬਯਣਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਠਾਂਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
1394.t: nayan bayan muh ik ik dhuh Thaa(n)i na jaanio ||
1394.e: With Your eyes and the words You speak, You dwell upon the One Lord; You do not know any other place of rest.

1394.g: ਸੁਪਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕਸ ਮਹਿ ਲੀਣਉ ॥
1394.t: supan ik paratakh ik ikas meh leenau ||
1394.e: You know the One Lord while dreaming, and the One Lord while awake. You are absorbed in the One.

1394.g: ਤੀਸ ਇਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਪੰਜਿ ਸਿਧੁ ਪੈਤੀਸ ਨ ਖੀਣਉ ॥
1394.t: tees ik ar pa(n)j sidh paitees na kheenau ||
1394.e: At the age of seventy-one, You began to march towards the Indestructible Lord.

1394.g: ਇਕਹੁ ਜਿ ਲਾਖੁ ਲਖਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨਿਅਉ ॥
1394.t: eikahu j laakh lakhahu alakh hai ik ik kar varaniaau ||
1394.e: The One Lord, who takes hundreds of thousands of forms, cannot be seen. He can only be described as One.

1394.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਜਾਲਪੁ ਭਣੈ ਤੂ ਇਕੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਮੰਨਿਅਉ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
1394.t: gur amaradhaas jaalap bhanai too ik loReh ik ma(n)niaau ||3||12||
1394.e: So speaks Jaalap: O Guru Amar Daas, You long for the One Lord, and believe in the One Lord alone. ||3||12||

1394.g: ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਗਹੀ ਜੈਦੇਵਿ ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੰਮਾਣੀ ॥
1394.t: j mat gahee jaidhev j mat naamai sa(n)maanee ||
1394.e: The understanding which Jai Dayv grasped, the understanding which permeated Naam Dayv,

1394.g: ਜਿ ਮਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਗਤ ਕੰਬੀਰਹਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
1394.t: j mat tiralochan chit bhagat ka(n)beereh jaanee ||
1394.e: the understanding which was in the consciousness of Trilochan and known by the devotee Kabeer,

1394.g: ਰੁਕਮਾਂਗਦ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੰਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
1394.t: rukamaa(n)gadh karatoot raam ja(n)pahu nit bhaiee ||
1394.e: by which Rukmaangad constantly meditated on the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny,

1394.g: ਅੰਮਰੀਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
1394.t: a(n)mareek prahalaadh saran gobi(n)dh gat paiee ||
1394.e: which brought Ambreek and Prahlaad to seek the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe, and which brought them to salvation

1394.g: ਤੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜੀ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਲੵ ਜਾਣੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
1394.t: tai lobh karodh tirasanaa tajee su mat jalaye jaanee jugat ||
1394.e: says JALL that sublime understanding has brought You to renounce greed, anger and desire, and to know the way.

1394.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
1394.t: gur amaradhaas nij bhagat hai dhekh dharas paavau mukat ||4||13||
1394.e: Guru Amar Daas is the Lord's own devotee; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is liberated. ||4||13||

1394.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਪੁਹਮਿ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਬਿਨਾਸਹਿ ॥
1394.t: gur amaradhaas paraseeaai puham paatik binaaseh ||
1394.e: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the earth is purged of its sin.

1394.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਆਸਾਸਹਿ ॥
1394.t: gur amaradhaas paraseeaai sidh saadhik aasaaseh ||
1394.e: The Siddhas and seekers long to meet with Guru Amar Daas.

1394.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਹੀਐ ਪਉ ਮੁਕਿਹਿ ॥
1394.t: gur amaradhaas paraseeaai dhiaan laheeaai pau mukeh ||
1394.e: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the mortal meditates on the Lord, and his journey comes to its end.

1394.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਅਭਉ ਲਭੈ ਗਉ ਚੁਕਿਹਿ ॥
1394.t: gur amaradhaas paraseeaai abhau labhai gau chukeh ||
1394.e: Meeting with Guru Amar Daas, the Fearless Lord is obtained, and the cycle of reincarnation is brought to an end.

1395.g: ਇਕੁ ਬਿੰਨਿ ਦੁਗਣ ਜੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਸੁਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਾਨਵਹਿ ਲਹਿ ॥
1395.t: eik bi(n)n dhugan ju tau rahai jaa suma(n)tr maanaveh leh ||
1395.e: Realizing the One Lord, love of duality ceases, and one comes to accept the Sublime Mantra of the Guru.

1395.g: ਜਾਲਪਾ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਇਤੜੇ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
1395.t: jaalapaa padhaarath itaRe gur amaradhaas ddiThai mileh ||5||14||
1395.e: So speaks Jaalap: countless treasures are obtained, by the sight of Guru Amar Daas. ||5||14||

1395.g: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿਅਉ ॥
1395.t: sach naam karataaru su dhiraR naanak sa(n)grahiaau ||
1395.e: Guru Nanak gathered up the True Name of the Creator Lord, and implanted it within.

1395.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਲਹਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਣਹ ਲਿਵ ਰਹਿਅਉ ॥
1395.t: taa te a(n)gadh lahanaa pragaT taas charaneh liv rahiaau ||
1395.e: Through Him, Lehnaa became manifest in the form of Guru Angad, who remained lovingly attuned to His Feet.

1395.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਕੁਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਆਸਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਵਣ ਵਖਾਣਉ ॥
1395.t: tit kul gur amaradhaas aasaa nivaas taas gun kavan vakhaanau ||
1395.e: Guru Amar Daas of that dynasty is the home of hope. How can I express His Glorious Virtues?

1395.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਅਲਖ ਅਗੰਮ ਤਿਨਹ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਉ ॥
1395.t: jo gun alakh aga(n)m tineh gun a(n)t na jaanau ||
1395.e: His Virtues are unknowable and unfathomable. I do not know the limits of His Virtues.

1395.g: ਬੋਹਿਥਉ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਨਿਰਮਯੌ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰਣ ॥
1395.t: bohithau bidhaatai niramayau sabh sa(n)gat kul udharan ||
1395.e: The Creator, the Architect of Destiny, has made Him a boat to carry all His generations across, along with the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

1395.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕੀਰਤੁ ਕਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤੁਅ ਪਾ ਸਰਣ ॥੧॥੧੫॥
1395.t: gur amaradhaas keerat kahai traeh traeh tua paa saran ||1||15||
1395.e: So speaks Keerat: O Guru Amar Daas, please protect me and save me; I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||15||

1395.g: ਆਪਿ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵਰਿਯਉ ॥
1395.t: aap narain kalaa dhaar jag meh paravariyau ||
1395.e: The Lord Himself wielded His Power and entered the world.

1395.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਕਰਿਯਉ ॥
1395.t: nira(n)kaar aakaar jot jag ma(n)ddal kariyau ||
1395.e: The Formless Lord took form, and with His Light He illuminated the realms of the world.

1395.g: ਜਹ ਕਹ ਤਹ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਪਕਿ ਦੀਪਾਯਉ ॥
1395.t: jeh keh teh bharapoor sabadh dheepak dheepaayau ||
1395.e: He is All-pervading everywhere; the Lamp of the Shabad, the Word, has been lit.

1395.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਖਹ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਮਿਲਾਯਉ ॥
1395.t: jeh sikheh sa(n)grahio tat har charan milaayau ||
1395.e: Whoever gathers in the essence of the teachings shall be absorbed in the Feet of the Lord.

1395.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲਿ ਨਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਵਤਰੵਿਉ ਅੰਗਦ ਲਹਣੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੁਅ ॥
1395.t: naanak kul ni(n)mal avatariyeau a(n)gadh lahane sa(n)g hua ||
1395.e: Lehnaa, who became Guru Angad, and Guru Amar Daas, have been reincarnated into the pure house of Guru Nanak.

1395.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਪਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਅ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
1395.t: gur amaradhaas taaran taran janam janam paa saran tua ||2||16||
1395.e: Guru Amar Daas is our Saving Grace, who carries us across; in lifetime after lifetime, I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||2||16||

1395.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਹ ॥
1395.t: jap tap sat sa(n)tokh pikh dharasan gur sikheh ||
1395.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the Gursikh is blessed with chanting and deep meditation, truth and contentment.

1395.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਮ ਪੁਰ ਕੀ ਲਿਖਹ ॥
1395.t: saran pareh te ubareh chhodd jam pur kee likheh ||
1395.e: Whoever seeks His Sanctuary is saved; his account is cleared in the City of Death.

1395.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਚਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੈ ॥
1395.t: bhagat bhai bharapoor ridhai ucharai karataarai ||
1395.e: His heart is totally filled with loving devotion; he chants to the Creator Lord.

1395.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਪਲਕ ਡੁਬੰਤੵਹ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
1395.t: gur gauhar dhareeaau palak dduba(n)tayeh taarai ||
1395.e: The Guru is the river of pearls; in an instant, he carries the drowning ones across.

1395.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲਿ ਨਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਵਤਰੵਿਉ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਤਾਰੈ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
1395.t: naanak kul ni(n)mal avatariyeau gun karataarai ucharai ||
1395.e: He was reincarnated into the House of Guru Nanak; He chants the Glorious Praises of the Creator Lord.

1395.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਅਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੩॥੧੭॥
1395.t: gur amaradhaas jin(h) seviaau tin(h) dhukh dharidhr parahar parai ||3||17||
1395.e: Those who serve Guru Amar Daas - their pains and poverty are taken away, far away. ||3||17||

1395.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਹਉ ਪਰੁ ਕਹਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥
1395.t: chit chitavau aradhaas kahau par keh bh na sakau ||
1395.e: I consciously pray within my consciousness, but I cannot express it in words.

1395.g: ਸਰਬ ਚਿੰਤ ਤੁਝੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਉ ਤਕਉ ॥
1395.t: sarab chi(n)t tujh paas saadhasa(n)gat hau takau ||
1395.e: I place all my worries and anxieties before You; I look to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, for help.

1395.g: ਤੇਰੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਤਉ ਕਰਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
1395.t: terai hukam pavai neesaan tau karau saahib kee sevaa ||
1395.e: By the Hukam of Your Command, I am blessed with Your Insignia; I serve my Lord and Master.

1395.g: ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਵਾ ॥
1395.t: jab gur dhekhai subh dhisaT naam karataa mukh mevaa ||
1395.e: When You, O Guru, gaze at me with Your Glance of Grace, the fruit of the Naam, the Name of the Creator, is placed within my mouth.

1395.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਲਖ ਕਾਰਣ ਪੁਰਖ ਜੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਹਉ ॥
1395.t: agam alakh kaaran purakh jo furamaaveh so kahau ||
1395.e: The Unfathomable and Unseen Primal Lord God, the Cause of causes - as He orders, so do I speak.

1395.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਜਿਵ ਤੂ ਰਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਰਹਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
1395.t: gur amaradhaas kaaran karan jiv too rakheh tiv rahau ||4||18||
1395.e: O Guru Amar Daas, Doer of deeds, Cause of causes, as You keep me, I remain; as You protect me, I survive. ||4||18||

1395.g: ਭਿਖੇ ਕੇ ॥
1395.t: bhikhe ke ||
1395.e: Of Bhikhaa:

1395.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
1395.t: gur giaan ar dhiaan tat siau tat milaavai ||
1395.e: In deep meditation, and the spiritual wisdom of the Guru, one's essence merges with the essence of reality.

1395.g: ਸਚਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
1395.t: sach sach jaaneeaai ik chiteh liv laavai ||
1395.e: In truth, the True Lord is recognized and realized, when one is lovingly attuned to Him, with one-pointed consciousness.

1395.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਵਸਿ ਕਰੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਉਡੰਤ ਨ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
1395.t: kaam karodh vas karai pavan udda(n)t na dhaavai ||
1395.e: Lust and anger are brought under control, when the breath does not fly around, wandering restlessly.

1395.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਵਸੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1395.t: nira(n)kaar kai vasai dhes hukam bujh beechaar paavai ||
1395.e: Dwelling in the land of the Formless Lord, realizing the Hukam of His Command, His contemplative wisdom is attained.

1395.g: ਕਲਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਅਉ ॥
1395.t: kal maeh roop karataa purakh so jaanai jin kichh keeaau ||
1395.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Guru is the Form of the Creator, the Primal Lord God; he alone knows, who has tried it.

1395.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੵਿਉ ਸੋਇ ਭਿਖਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਹਜ ਰੰਗਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਅਉ ॥੧॥੧੯॥
1395.t: gur miliyeau soi bhikhaa kahai sahaj ra(n)g dharasan dheeaau ||1||19||
1395.e: So speaks Bhikhaa: I have met the Guru. With love and intuitive affection, He has bestowed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||19||

1395.g: ਰਹਿਓ ਸੰਤ ਹਉ ਟੋਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਡਿਠੇ ॥
1395.t: rahio sa(n)t hau Tol saadh bahutere ddiThe ||
1395.e: I have been searching for the Saints; I have seen so many Holy and spiritual people.

1395.g: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਤਪਸੀਅਹ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਏ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮਿਠੇ ॥
1395.t: sa(n)niaasee tapase'eeh mukhahu e pa(n)ddit miThe ||
1395.e: The hermits, Sannyaasees, ascetics, penitents, fanatics and Pandits all speak sweetly.

1395.g: ਬਰਸੁ ਏਕੁ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਕਿਨੈ ਨਹੁ ਪਰਚਉ ਲਾਯਉ ॥
1395.t: baras ek hau firio kinai nahu parachau laayau ||
1395.e: I wandered around lost for a year, but no one touched my soul.

1396.g: ਕਹਤਿਅਹ ਕਹਤੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਰਹਤ ਕੋ ਖੁਸੀ ਨ ਆਯਉ ॥
1396.t: kahatieh kahatee sunee rahat ko khusee na aayau ||
1396.e: I listened to preachers and teachers, but I could not be happy with their lifestyles.

1396.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ॥
1396.t: har naam chhodd dhoojai lage tin(h) ke gun hau kiaa kahau ||
1396.e: Those who have abandoned the Lord's Name, and become attached to duality - why should I speak in praise of them?

1396.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਯਿ ਮਿਲਾਯਉ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਜਿਵ ਤੂ ਰਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਰਹਉ ॥੨॥੨੦॥
1396.t: gur dhay milaayau bhikhiaa jiv too rakheh tiv rahau ||2||20||
1396.e: So speaks Bhikhaa: the Lord has led me to meet the Guru. As You keep me, I remain; as You protect me, I survive. ||2||20||

1396.g: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਨਾਹੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਚੜਿਅਉ ॥
1396.t: pahir samaadh sanaahu giaan hai aasan chaRiaau ||
1396.e: Wearing the armor of Samaadhi, the Guru has mounted the saddled horse of spiritual wisdom.

1396.g: ਧ੍ਰੰਮ ਧਨਖੁ ਕਰ ਗਹਿਓ ਭਗਤ ਸੀਲਹ ਸਰਿ ਲੜਿਅਉ ॥
1396.t: dhra(n)m dhanakh kar gahio bhagat seeleh sar laRiaau ||
1396.e: Holding the bow of Dharma in His Hands, He has shot the arrows of devotion and humility.

1396.g: ਭੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਅਟਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਨੇਜਾ ਗਡਿਓ ॥
1396.t: bhai nirabhau har aTal man sabadh gur nejaa gaddio ||
1396.e: He is fearless in the Fear of the Eternal Lord God; He has thrust the spear of the Word of the Guru's Shabad into the mind.

1396.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਤੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਬਿਖੰਡਿਓ ॥
1396.t: kaam karodh lobh moh apat pa(n)ch dhoot bikha(n)ddio ||
1396.e: He has cut down the five demons of unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger, unsatisfied greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit.

1396.g: ਭਲਉ ਭੂਹਾਲੁ ਤੇਜੋ ਤਨਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਰਿ ॥
1396.t: bhalau bhoohaal tejo tanaa nirapat naath naanak bar ||
1396.e: Guru Amar Daas, the son of Tayj Bhaan, of the noble Bhalla dynasty, blessed by Guru Nanak, is the Master of kings.

1396.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਸਚੁ ਸਲੵ ਭਣਿ ਤੈ ਦਲੁ ਜਿਤਉ ਇਵ ਜੁਧੁ ਕਰਿ ॥੧॥੨੧॥
1396.t: gur amaradhaas sach salaye bhan tai dhal jitau iv judh kar ||1||21||
1396.e: SALL speaks the truth; O Guru Amar Daas, you have conquered the army of evil, fighting the battle this way. ||1||21||

1396.g: ਘਨਹਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਸੁਅ ਰੋਮਾਵਲਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਸੰਤ ਗਨੰਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
1396.t: ghanahar boo(n)dh basua romaaval kusam basa(n)t gana(n)t na aavai ||
1396.e: The raindrops of the clouds, the plants of the earth, and the flowers of the spring cannot be counted.

1396.g: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੋ ਗੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ ਅੰਤੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1396.t: rav sas kiran udhar saagar ko ga(n)g tara(n)g a(n)t ko paavai ||
1396.e: Who can know the limits of the rays of the sun and the moon, the waves of the ocean and the Ganges?

1396.g: ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਭਲੵ ਉਨਹ ਜੋੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
1396.t: rudhr dhiaan giaan satigur ke kab jan bhalaye uneh juo gaavai ||
1396.e: With Shiva's meditation and the spiritual wisdom of the True Guru, says BHALL the poet, these may be counted.

1396.g: ਭਲੇ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥੨੨॥
1396.t: bhale amaradhaas gun tere teree upamaa toh ban aavai ||1||22||
1396.e: O Guru Amar Daas, Your Glorious Virtues are so sublime; Your Praises belong only to You. ||1||22||

1396.g: ਸਵਈਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਚਉਥੇ ਕੇ ੪
1396.t: savie'ee mahale chauthe ke 4
1396.e: Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fourth Mehla:

1396.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1396.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1396.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1396.g: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
1396.t: eik man purakh nira(n)jan dhiaavau ||
1396.e: Meditate single-mindedly on the Immaculate Primal Lord God.

1396.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
1396.t: gur prasaadh har gun sadh gaavau ||
1396.e: By Guru's Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

1396.g: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ॥
1396.t: gun gaavat man hoi bigaasaa ||
1396.e: Singing His Praises, the mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.

1396.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਨਹ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
1396.t: satigur poor janeh kee aasaa ||
1396.e: The True Guru fulfills the hopes of His humble servant.

1396.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਯਉ ॥
1396.t: satigur sev param padh paayau ||
1396.e: Serving the True Guru, the supreme status is obtained.

1396.g: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਧਿਆਯਉ ॥
1396.t: abinaasee abigat dhiaayau ||
1396.e: Meditate on the Imperishable, Formless Lord God.

1396.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਚੰਪੈ ॥
1396.t: tis bheTe dhaaridhr na cha(n)pai ||
1396.e: Meeting with Him, one escapes poverty.

1396.g: ਕਲੵ ਸਹਾਰੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਜੰਪੈ ॥
1396.t: kalaye sahaar taas gun ja(n)pai ||
1396.e: Kal Sahaar chants His Glorious Praises.

1396.g: ਜੰਪਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਮਲ ਸੁਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੇ ਅਮਿਅ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥
1396.t: ja(n)pau gun bimal sujan jan kere amia naam jaa kau furiaa ||
1396.e: I chant the pure praises of that humble being who has been blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1396.g: ਇਨਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਬਦ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਯਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
1396.t: ein satagur sev sabadh ras paayaa naam nira(n)jan ur dhariaa ||
1396.e: He served the True Guru and was blessed with the sublime essence of the Shabad, the Word of God. The Immaculate Naam has been enshrined in his heart.

1396.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿਕੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਚਾਹਕੁ ਤਤ ਸਮਤ ਸਰੇ ॥
1396.t: har naam rasik gobi(n)dh gun gaahak chaahak tat samat sare ||
1396.e: He enjoys and savors the Lord's Name, and purchases the Glorious Virtues of the Lord of the Universe. He seeks the essence of reality; he is the Fountain of even-handed justice.

1396.g: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੧॥
1396.t: kav kalaye Thakur haradhaas tane gur raamadhaas sar abhar bhare ||1||
1396.e: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||1||

1396.g: ਛੁਟਤ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਅਮਿਅ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਸਦ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
1396.t: chhuTat paravaeh amia amaraa padh a(n)mirat sarovar sadh bhariaa ||
1396.e: The stream of ambrosial nectar flows and the immortal status is obtained; the pool is forever overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.

1396.g: ਤੇ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਪੁਬ ਜਿਨਹੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
1396.t: te peeveh sa(n)t kareh man majan pub jinahu sevaa kareeaa ||
1396.e: Those Saints who have served the Lord in the past drink in this Nectar, and bathe their minds in it.

1396.g: ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਅਨਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਸਬਦ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰ ਧਰੇ ॥
1396.t: tin bhau nivaar anabhai padh dheenaa sabadh maatr te udhar dhare ||
1396.e: God takes their fears away, and blesses them with the state of fearless dignity. Through the Word of His Shabad, He has saved them.

1396.g: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੨॥
1396.t: kav kalaye Thakur haradhaas tane gur raamadhaas sar abhar bhare ||2||
1396.e: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||2||

1396.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਗੂੜੑ ਬਿਮਲ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੁ ਭਯਾ ॥
1396.t: satagur mat gooR(h) bimal satasa(n)gat aatam ra(n)g chalool bhayaa ||
1396.e: The True Guru's understanding is deep and profound. The Sat Sangat is His Pure Congregation. His Soul is drenched in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.

1396.g: ਜਾਗੵਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਵਲੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਰਕਾਸੵਾ ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਘਰਹਿ ਲਹਾ ॥
1396.t: jaagayeaa man kaval sahaj parakaasayeaa abhai nira(n)jan ghareh lahaa ||
1396.e: The Lotus of His mind remains awake and aware, illuminated with intuitive wisdom. In His own home, He has obtained the Fearless, Immaculate Lord.

1397.g: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦਯਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਯਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਰੇ ॥
1397.t: satagur dhayaal har naam dhiraR(h)aayaa tis prasaadh vas pa(n)ch kare ||
1397.e: The Merciful True Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me, and by His Grace, I have overpowered the five thieves.

1397.g: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੩॥
1397.t: kav kalaye Thakur haradhaas tane gur raamadhaas sar abhar bhare ||3||
1397.e: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||3||

1397.g: ਅਨਭਉ ਉਨਮਾਨਿ ਅਕਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੇ ॥
1397.t: anabhau unamaan akal liv laagee paaras bheTiaa sahaj ghare ||
1397.e: With intuitive detachment, He is lovingly attuned to the Fearless, Unmanifest Lord; He met with Guru Amar Daas, the Philosopher's Stone, within his own home.

1397.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਯਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ॥
1397.t: satagur parasaadh param padh paayaa bhagat bhai bha(n)ddaar bhare ||
1397.e: By the Grace of the True Guru, He attained the supreme status; He is overflowing with the treasures of loving devotion.

1397.g: ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਨਮਾਂਤੁ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੇ ॥
1397.t: meTiaa janamaa(n)t maran bhau bhaagaa chit laagaa sa(n)tokh sare ||
1397.e: He was released from reincarnation, and the fear of death was taken away. His consciousness is attached to the Lord, the Ocean of contentment.

1397.g: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੪॥
1397.t: kav kalaye Thakur haradhaas tane gur raamadhaas sar abhar bhare ||4||
1397.e: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||4||

1397.g: ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਪਾਯਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
1397.t: abhar bhare paayau apaar ridh a(n)tar dhaario ||
1397.e: He fills the empty to overflowing; He has enshrined the Infinite within His heart.

1397.g: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਆਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
1397.t: dhukh bha(n)jan aatam prabodh man tat beechaario ||
1397.e: Within His mind, He contemplates the essence of reality, the Destroyer of pain, the Enlightener of the soul.

1397.g: ਸਦਾ ਚਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਇ ॥
1397.t: sadhaa chai har bhai prem ras aape jaani ||
1397.e: He yearns for the Lord's Love forever; He Himself knows the sublime essence of this Love.

1397.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਇ ॥
1397.t: satagur kai parasaadh sahaj setee ra(n)g maani ||
1397.e: By the Grace of the True Guru, He intuitively enjoys this Love.

1397.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਗਦ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ ॥
1397.t: naanak prasaadh a(n)gadh sumat gur amar amar varataio ||
1397.e: By the Grace of Guru Nanak, and the sublime teachings of Guru Angad, Guru Amar Daas broadcast the Lord's Command.

1397.g: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈਂ ਅਟਲ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
1397.t: gur raamadhaas kalayeucharai tai(n) aTal amar padh paio ||5||
1397.e: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the status of eternal and imperishable dignity. ||5||

1397.g: ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਅਮਿਅ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੈ ॥
1397.t: sa(n)tokh sarovar basai amia ras rasan prakaasai ||
1397.e: You abide in the pool of contentment; Your tongue reveals the Ambrosial Essence.

1397.g: ਮਿਲਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਦੂਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
1397.t: milat saa(n)t upajai dhurat dhoora(n)tar naasai ||
1397.e: Meeting with You, a tranquil peace wells up, and sins run far away.

1397.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਦਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਗਿ ਨ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
1397.t: sukh saagar paiaau dhi(n)t har mag na huTai ||
1397.e: You have attained the Ocean of peace, and You never grow tired on the Lord's path.

1397.g: ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਨਾਹੁ ਮਫੁਟੈ ॥
1397.t: sa(n)jam sat sa(n)tokh seel sa(n)naahu mafuTai ||
1397.e: The armor of self-restraint, truth, contentment and humility can never be pierced.

1397.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਬਿਧ ਨੈ ਸਿਰਿਉ ਜਗਿ ਜਸ ਤੂਰੁ ਬਜਾਇਅਉ ॥
1397.t: satigur pramaan bidh nai siriau jag jas toor bajaiaau ||
1397.e: The Creator Lord certified the True Guru, and now the world blows the trumpet of His Praises.

1397.g: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਅਭੈ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੬॥
1397.t: gur raamadhaas kalayeucharai tai abhai amar padh paiaau ||6||
1397.e: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the state of fearless immortality. ||6||

1397.g: ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਯਉ ॥
1397.t: jag jitau satigur pramaan man ek dhiaayau ||
1397.e: O certified True Guru, You have conquered the world; You meditate single-mindedly on the One Lord.

1397.g: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਯਉ ॥
1397.t: dhan dhan satigur amaradhaas jin naam dhiraRaayau ||
1397.e: Blessed, blessed is Guru Amar Daas, the True Guru, who implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within.

1397.g: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦਾਸੀ ॥
1397.t: nav nidh naam nidhaan ridh sidh taa kee dhaasee ||
1397.e: The Naam is the wealth of the nine treasures; prosperity and supernatural spiritual powers are His slaves.

1397.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
1397.t: sahaj sarovar milio purakh bheTio abinaasee ||
1397.e: He is blessed with the ocean of intuitive wisdom; He has met with the Imperishable Lord God.

1397.g: ਆਦਿ ਲੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰੇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਅਉ ॥
1397.t: aadh le bhagat jit lag tare so gur naam dhiraRaiaau ||
1397.e: The Guru has implanted the Naam deep within; attached to the Naam, the devotees have been carried across since ancient times.

1397.g: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੭॥
1397.t: gur raamadhaas kalayeucharai tai har prem padhaarath paiaau ||7||
1397.e: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Love. ||7||

1397.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪੁਬਲੀ ਨ ਹੁਟਇ ॥
1397.t: prem bhagat paravaeh preet pubalee na huTi ||
1397.e: The flow of loving devotion and primal love does not stop.

1397.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਅ ਧਾਰਾ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਟਇ ॥
1397.t: satigur sabadh athaahu amia dhaaraa ras guTi ||
1397.e: The True Guru drinks in the stream of nectar, the sublime essence of the Shabad, the Infinite Word of God.

1397.g: ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਯਉ ॥
1397.t: mat maataa sa(n)tokh pitaa sar sahaj samaayau ||
1397.e: Wisdom is His mother, and contentment is His father; He is absorbed in the ocean of intuitive peace and poise.

1397.g: ਆਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਵਿਅਉ ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਤਰਾਯਉ ॥
1397.t: aajonee sa(n)bhaviaau jagat gur bachan taraayau ||
1397.e: The Guru is the Embodiment of the Unborn, Self-illumined Lord; by the Word of His Teachings, the Guru carries the world across.

1397.g: ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰਪਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਅਉ ॥
1397.t: abigat agochar aparapar man gur sabadh vasaiaau ||
1397.e: Within His mind, the Guru has enshrined the Shabad, the Word of the Unseen, Unfathomable, Infinite Lord.

1397.g: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੮॥
1397.t: gur raamadhaas kalayeucharai tai jagat udhaaran paiaau ||8||
1397.e: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the Lord, the Saving Grace of the world. ||8||

1397.g: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ॥
1397.t: jagat udhaaran nav nidhaan bhagateh bhav taaran ||
1397.e: The Saving Grace of the world, the nine treasures, carries the devotees across the world-ocean.

1397.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸੁ ਕੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ॥
1397.t: a(n)mirat boo(n)dh har naam bis kee bikhai nivaaran ||
1397.e: The Drop of Ambrosial Nectar, the Lord's Name, is the antidote to the poison of sin.

1397.g: ਸਹਜ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਫਲਿਓ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
1397.t: sahaj tarovar falio giaan a(n)mirat fal laage ||
1397.e: The tree of intuitive peace and poise blossoms and bears the ambrosial fruit of spiritual wisdom.

1397.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਬਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
1397.t: gur prasaadh paie'eeh dha(n)n te jan baddabhaage ||
1397.e: Blessed are those fortunate people who receive it, by Guru's Grace.

1397.g: ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥
1397.t: te mukate bhe satigur sabadh man gur parachaa paiaau ||
1397.e: They are liberated through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru; their minds are filled with the Guru's Wisdom.

1397.g: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਸਬਦ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਾਇਅਉ ॥੯॥
1397.t: gur raamadhaas kalayeucharai tai sabadh neesaan bajaiaau ||9||
1397.e: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You beat the drum of the Shabad. ||9||

1398.g: ਸੇਜ ਸਧਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਛਾਵਾਣੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਾਇਚਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਨਾਹੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
1398.t: sej sadhaa sahaj chhaavaan sa(n)tokh saraichau sadhaa seel sa(n)naahu sohai ||
1398.e: On the bed of faith, with the blankets of intuitive peace and poise and the canopy of contentment, You are embellished forever with the armor of humility.

1398.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਚਰਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਟੇਕ ਸੰਗਾਦਿ ਬੋਹੈ ॥
1398.t: gur sabadh samaachario naam Tek sa(n)gaadh bohai ||
1398.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you practice the Naam; You lean on its Support, and give Your Fragrance to Your companions.

1398.g: ਅਜੋਨੀਉ ਭਲੵੁ ਅਮਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
1398.t: ajoneeau bhalaye amal satigur sa(n)g nivaas ||
1398.e: You abide with the Unborn Lord, the Good and Pure True Guru.

1398.g: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੁਅ ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥੧੦॥
1398.t: gur raamadhaas kalayeucharai tua sahaj sarovar baas ||10||
1398.e: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You abide in the sacred pool of intuitive peace and poise. ||10||

1398.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੈ ॥
1398.t: gur jin(h) kau suprasa(n)n naam har ridhai nivaasai ||
1398.e: The Lord's Name abides in the hearts of those who are pleasing to the Guru.

1398.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਦੂਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
1398.t: jin(h) kau gur suprasa(n)n dhurat dhoora(n)tar naasai ||
1398.e: Sins run far away from those who are pleasing to the Guru.

1398.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
1398.t: gur jin(h) kau suprasa(n)n maan abhimaan nivaarai ||
1398.e: Those who are pleasing to the Guru eradicate pride and egotism from within.

1398.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
1398.t: jin(h) kau gur suprasa(n)n sabadh lag bhavajal taarai ||
1398.e: Those who are pleasing to the Guru are attached to the Shadad, the Word of God; they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean.

1398.g: ਪਰਚਉ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਤਿਨ ਸਕਯਥਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ॥
1398.t: parachau pramaan gur paiaau tin sakayathau janam jag ||
1398.e: Those who are blessed with the wisdom of the certified Guru - blessed and fruitful is their birth into the world.

1398.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਭਜੁ ਕਲੵ ਕਬਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਭ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਗਿ ॥੧੧॥
1398.t: sree guroo saran bhaj kalaye kab bhugat mukat sabh guroo lag ||11||
1398.e: KALL the poet runs to the Sanctuary of the Great Guru; attached to the Guru, they are blessed with worldly enjoyments, liberation and everything. ||11||

1398.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖੇਮਾ ਤਾਣਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਜੂਥ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
1398.t: satigur khemaa taaniaa jug jooth samaane ||
1398.e: The Guru has pitched the tent; under it, all the ages are gathered.

1398.g: ਅਨਭਉ ਨੇਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਟੇਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਗਤ ਅਘਾਣੇ ॥
1398.t: anabhau nejaa naam Tek jit bhagat aghaane ||
1398.e: He carries the spear of intuition, and takes the Support of Naam, the Name of the Lord, through which the devotees are fulfilled.

1398.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
1398.t: gur naanak a(n)gadh amar bhagat har sa(n)g samaane ||
1398.e: Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amar Daas, through devotional worship, have merged into the Lord.

1398.g: ਇਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੂ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣੇ ॥੧੨॥
1398.t: eih raaj jog gur raamadhaas tum(h) hoo ras jaane ||12||
1398.e: O Guru Raam Daas, You alone know the taste of this Raja Yoga. ||12||

1398.g: ਜਨਕੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਥੁ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
1398.t: janak soi jin jaaniaa unaman rath dhariaa ||
1398.e: He alone is enlightened like Janaka, who links the chariot of his mind to the state of ecstatic realization.

1398.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਮਾਚਰੇ ਅਭਰਾ ਸਰੁ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
1398.t: sat sa(n)tokh samaachare abharaa sar bhariaa ||
1398.e: He gathers in truth and contentment, and fills up the empty pool within.

1398.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਮਰਾ ਪੁਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1398.t: akath kathaa amaraa puree jis dhei su paavai ||
1398.e: He speaks the Unspoken Speech of the eternal city. He alone obtains it, unto whom God gives it.

1398.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਬਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧੩॥
1398.t: eih janak raaj gur raamadhaas tujh hee ban aavai ||13||
1398.e: O Guru Raam Daas, Your sovereign rule, like that of Janak, is Yours alone. ||13||

1398.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
1398.t: satigur naam ek liv man japai dhiraR(h) tin(h) jan dhukh paap kahu kat hovai jeeau ||
1398.e: Tell me, how can sin and suffering cling to that humble being who chants the Naam, given by the Guru, with single-minded love and firm faith?

1398.g: ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਧਾਰੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਖੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
1398.t: taaran taran khin maatr jaa kau dhirasiT dhaarai sabadh ridh beechaarai kaam karodh khovai jeeau ||
1398.e: When the Lord, the Boat to carry us across, bestows His Glance of Grace, even for an instant, the mortal contemplates the Shabad within his heart; unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger are eradicated.

1398.g: ਜੀਅਨ ਸਭਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਗੵਾਨ ਬਿਖੵਾਤਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਧੵਾਨ ਧਾਵੈ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
1398.t: jeean sabhan dhaataa agam gayeaan bikhayeaataa ahinis dhayeaan dhaavai palak na sovai jeeau ||
1398.e: The Guru is the Giver to all beings; He speaks the spiritual wisdom of the Unfathomable Lord, and meditates on Him day and night. He never sleeps, even for an instant.

1398.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੵਾਨਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
1398.t: jaa kau dhekhat dharidhr jaavai naam so nidhaan paavai gurmukh gayeaan dhuramat mail dhovai jeeau ||
1398.e: Seeing Him, poverty vanishes, and one is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The spiritual wisdom of the Guru's Word washes away the filth of evil-mindedness.

1398.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
1398.t: satigur naam ek liv man japai dhiraR tin jan dhukh paap kahu kat hovai jeeau ||1||
1398.e: Tell me, how can sin and suffering cling to that humble being who chants the Naam, given by the Guru, with single-minded love and firm faith? ||1||

1398.g: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
1398.t: dharam karam poorai satigur paiee hai ||
1398.e: Dharmic faith and the karma of good deeds are obtained from the Perfect True Guru.

1398.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸਬਦ ਸਾਰੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
1398.t: jaa kee sevaa sidh saadh mun jan sur nar jaacheh sabadh saar ek liv laiee hai ||
1398.e: The Siddhas and Holy Saadhus, the silent sages and angelic beings, yearn to serve Him; through the most excellent Word of the Shabad, they are lovingly attuned to the One Lord.

1398.g: ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
1398.t: fun jaanai ko teraa apaar nirabhau nira(n)kaar akath kathanahaar tujheh bujhaiee hai ||
1398.e: Who can know Your limits? You are the Embodiment of the Fearless, Formless Lord. You are the Speaker of the Unspoken Speech; You alone understand this.

1398.g: ਭਰਮ ਭੂਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਛੁਟਹੁ ਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਨ ਡੰਡ ਕਾਲ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧੵਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
1398.t: bharam bhoole sa(n)saar chhuTahu joonee sa(n)ghaar jam ko na dda(n)dd kaal gurmat dhayeaiee hai ||
1398.e: O foolish worldly mortal, you are deluded by doubt; give up birth and death, and you shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death. Meditate on the Guru's Teachings.

1398.g: ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਗਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਪੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
1398.t: man praanee mugadh beechaar ahinis jap dharam karam poorai satigur paiee hai ||2||
1398.e: You foolish mortal being, reflect on this in your mind; chant and meditate day and night. Dharmic faith and the karma of good deeds are obtained from the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

1398.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਪਰ ॥
1398.t: hau bal bal jaau satigur saache naam par ||
1398.e: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, to the True Name, O my True Guru.

1398.g: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰੇਉ ਏਕ ਮੁਖ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਰਿ ਕਰ ॥
1398.t: kavan upamaa dheau kavan sevaa sareau ek mukh rasanaa rasahu jug jor kar ||
1398.e: What Praises can I offer to You? What service can I do for You? I have only one mouth and tongue; with my palms pressed together, I chant to You with joy and delight.

1398.g: ਫੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਾਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਦੂਜਾ ਨ ਮਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਧਰ ॥
1398.t: fun man bach karam jaan anat dhoojaa na maan naam so apaar saar dheeno gur ridh dhar ||
1398.e: In thought, word and deed, I know the Lord; I do not worship any other. The Guru has enshrined the most excellent Name of the Infinite Lord within my heart.

1399.g: ਨਲੵ ਕਵਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਕਚ ਕੰਚਨਾ ਹੁਇ ਚੰਦਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨ ਤਰ ॥
1399.t: nalaye kav paaras paras kach ka(n)chanaa hui cha(n)dhanaa subaas jaas simarat an tar ||
1399.e: So speaks NALL the poet: touching the Philosopher's Stone, glass is transformed into gold, and the sandalwood tree imparts its fragrance to other trees; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am transformed.

1399.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਦੇਖਤ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਹੀ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਪਰ ॥੩॥
1399.t: jaa ke dhekhat dhuaare kaam karodh hee nivaare jee hau bal bal jaau satigur saache naam par ||3||
1399.e: Seeing His Door, I am rid of sexual desire and anger. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, to the True Name, O my True Guru. ||3||

1399.g: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਦੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ॥
1399.t: raaj jog takhat dheean gur raamadhaas ||
1399.e: Guru Raam Daas was blessed with the Throne of Raja Yoga.

1399.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਚੰਦੁ ਜਗਤ ਭਯੋ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਤਾਰਨਿ ਮਨੁਖੵ ਜਨ ਕੀਅਉ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
1399.t: prathame naanak cha(n)dh jagat bhayo aana(n)dh taaran manukhaye jan keeaau pragaas ||
1399.e: First, Guru Nanak illuminated the world, like the full moon, and filled it with bliss. To carry humanity across, He bestowed His Radiance.

1399.g: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਦੀਅਉ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਮਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
1399.t: gur a(n)gadh dheeaau nidhaan akath kathaa giaan pa(n)ch bhoot bas keene jamat na traas ||
1399.e: He blessed Guru Angad with the treasure of spiritual wisdom, and the Unspoken Speech; He overcame the five demons and the fear of the Messenger of Death.

1399.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਤਿ ਅਘਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਗਤੁ ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਜਾਸ ॥
1399.t: gur amar guroo sree sat kalijug raakhee pat aghan dhekhat gat charan kaval jaas ||
1399.e: The Great and True Guru, Guru Amar Daas, has preserved honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. Seeing His Lotus Feet, sin and evil are destroyed.

1399.g: ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਨੵਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਭਯਉ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਦੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ॥੪॥
1399.t: sabh bidh maaniyeau man tab hee bhayau prasa(n)n raaj jog takhat dheean gur raamadhaas ||4||
1399.e: When His mind was totally satisfied in every way, when He was totally pleased, He bestowed upon Guru Raam Daas the Throne of Raja Yoga. ||4||

1399.g: ਰਡ ॥
1399.t: radd ||
1399.e: Radd:

1399.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਧਾਰੵਿਉ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਵਿਉਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਪਵਣੁ ਤੇ ਨੀਰ ਸਰ ਅਵਰ ਅਨਲ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਕੀਅਉ ॥
1399.t: jiseh dhaariyeau dharat ar viaum ar pavan te neer sar avar anal anaadh keeaau ||
1399.e: He established the earth, the sky and the air, the water of the oceans, fire and food.

1399.g: ਸਸਿ ਰਿਖਿ ਨਿਸਿ ਸੂਰ ਦਿਨਿ ਸੈਲ ਤਰੂਅ ਫਲ ਫੁਲ ਦੀਅਉ ॥
1399.t: sas rikh nis soor dhin sail tarooa fal ful dheeaau ||
1399.e: He created the moon, the stars and the sun, night and day and mountains; he blessed the trees with flowers and fruits.

1399.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸਪਤ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਕਿਅ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
1399.t: sur nar sapat samudhr kia dhaario tirabhavan jaas ||
1399.e: He created the gods, human beings and the seven seas; He established the three worlds.

1399.g: ਸੋਈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥੫॥
1399.t: soiee ek naam har naam sat paio gur amar pragaas ||1||5||
1399.e: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the Light of the One Name, the True Name of the Lord. ||1||5||

1399.g: ਕਚਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਅਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਹਿ ਸੁਣਿਓ ॥
1399.t: kachahu ka(n)chan bhiaau sabadh gur sravaneh sunio ||
1399.e: Glass is transformed into gold, listening to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1399.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੁਯਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਿਅਉ ॥
1399.t: bikh te a(n)mrit huyau naam satigur mukh bhaniaau ||
1399.e: Poison is transformed into ambrosial nectar, speaking the Name of the True Guru.

1399.g: ਲੋਹਉ ਹੋਯਉ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਦਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
1399.t: lohau hoyau laal nadhar satigur jadh dhaarai ||
1399.e: Iron is transformed into jewels, when the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace.

1399.g: ਪਾਹਣ ਮਾਣਕ ਕਰੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਹਿਅਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
1399.t: paahan maanak karai giaan gur kahiaau beechaarai ||
1399.e: Stones are transformed into emeralds, when the mortal chants and contemplates the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

1399.g: ਕਾਠਹੁ ਸ੍ਰੀਖੰਡ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਅਉ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਗਇਅ ॥
1399.t: kaaThahu sreekha(n)dd satigur keeaau dhukh dharidhr tin ke gia ||
1399.e: The True Guru transforms ordinary wood into sandalwood, eradicating the pains of poverty.

1399.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਚਰਨ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਰਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਪਰੇਤ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਭਇਅ ॥੨॥੬॥
1399.t: satiguroo charan jin(h) parasiaa se pas paret sur nar bhia ||2||6||
1399.e: Whoever touches the Feet of the True Guru, is transformed from a beast and a ghost into an angelic being. ||2||6||

1399.g: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਧਨਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਾਰਵੁ ਦਿਜਇ ॥
1399.t: jaam guroo hoi val dhaneh kiaa gaarav dhiji ||
1399.e: One who has the Guru on his side - how could he be proud of his wealth?

1399.g: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਜਇ ॥
1399.t: jaam guroo hoi val lakh baahe kiaa kiji ||
1399.e: One who has the Guru on his side - what would hundreds of thousands of supporters do for him?

1399.g: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਰੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਨਨ ਪਰਿ ॥
1399.t: jaam guroo hoi val giaan ar dhiaan anan par ||
1399.e: One who has the Guru on his side, does not depend on anyone else for spiritual wisdom and meditation.

1399.g: ਜਾਮਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਵਲਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਸੁ ਸਚਹ ਘਰਿ ॥
1399.t: jaam guroo hoi val sabadh saakhee su sacheh ghar ||
1399.e: One who has the Guru on his side contemplates the Shabad and the Teachings, and abides in the Home of Truth.

1399.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਪੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਭਟੁ ਬੇਨਤਿ ਕਹੈ ॥
1399.t: jo guroo guroo ahinis japai dhaas bhaT benat kahai ||
1399.e: The Lord's humble slave and poet utters this prayer: whoever chants to the Guru night and day,

1399.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਧਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹ ਥੇ ਰਹੈ ॥੩॥੭॥
1399.t: jo guroo naam ridh meh dharai so janam maran dhuh the rahai ||3||7||
1399.e: whoever enshrines the Name of the Guru within his heart, is rid of both birth and death. ||3||7||

1399.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
1399.t: gur bin ghor a(n)dhaar guroo bin samajh na aavai ||
1399.e: Without the Guru, there is utter darkness; without the Guru, understanding does not come.

1399.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1399.t: gur bin surat na sidh guroo bin mukat na paavai ||
1399.e: Without the Guru, there is no intuitive awareness or success; without the Guru, there is no liberation.

1399.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
1399.t: gur kar sach beechaar guroo kar re man mere ||
1399.e: So make Him your Guru, and contemplate the Truth; make Him your Guru, O my mind.

1399.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸਪੁੰਨ ਅਘਨ ਕਟਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
1399.t: gur kar sabadh sapu(n)n aghan kaTeh sabh tere ||
1399.e: Make Him your Guru, who is embellished and exalted in the Word of the Shabad; all your sins shall be washed away.

1399.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਯਣਿ ਬਯਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿ ਕਵਿ ਨਲੵ ਕਹਿ ॥
1399.t: gur nayan bayan gur gur karahu guroo sat kav nalaye keh ||
1399.e: So speaks NALL the poet: with your eyes, make Him your Guru; with the words you speak, make Him your Guru, your True Guru.

1399.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਅਉ ਨਹੁ ਕੀਅਉ ਤੇ ਅਕਯਥ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ॥੪॥੮॥
1399.t: jin guroo na dhekhiaau nahu keeaau te akayath sa(n)saar meh ||4||8||
1399.e: Those who have not seen the Guru, who have not made Him their Guru, are useless in this world. ||4||8||

1399.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
1399.t: guroo guroo gur kar man mere ||
1399.e: Dwell upon the Guru, the Guru, the Guru, O my mind.

1400.g: ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ਸਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਬਦ ਜਿਸੁ ਕੇਰੇ ॥
1400.t: taaran taran samrath kalijug sunat samaadh sabadh jis kere ||
1400.e: The All-powerful Guru is the Boat to carry us across in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. Hearing the Word of His Shabad, we are transported into Samaadhi.

1400.g: ਫੁਨਿ ਦੁਖਨਿ ਨਾਸੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਯਕੁ ਸੂਰਉ ਜੋ ਧਰਤ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਬਸਤ ਤਿਹ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
1400.t: fun dhukhan naas sukhadhaayak soorau jo dharat dhiaan basat teh nere ||
1400.e: He is the Spiritual Hero who destroys pain and brings peace. Whoever meditates on Him, dwells near Him.

1400.g: ਪੂਰਉ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮੁਖੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਅਘ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਰੇਰੇ ॥
1400.t: poorau purakh ridhai har simarat mukh dhekhat agh jaeh parere ||
1400.e: He is the Perfect Primal Being, who meditates in remembrance on the Lord within his heart; seeing His Face, sins run away.

1400.g: ਜਉ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚਾਹਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੫॥੯॥
1400.t: jau har budh ridh sidh chaahat guroo guroo gur kar man mere ||5||9||
1400.e: If you long for wisdom, wealth, spiritual perfection and properity, O my mind, dwell upon the Guru, the Guru, the Guru. ||5||9||

1400.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਯਉ ॥
1400.t: guroo mukh dhekh garoo sukh paayau ||
1400.e: Gazing upon the Face of the Guru, I find peace.

1400.g: ਹੁਤੀ ਜੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਪਿਊਸ ਪਿਵੰਨ ਕੀ ਬੰਛਤ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਯਉ ॥
1400.t: hutee ju piaas piuoos piva(n)n kee ba(n)chhat sidh kau bidh milaayau ||
1400.e: I was thirsty, yearning to drink in the Nectar; to fulfill that wish, the Guru laid out the way.

1400.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਭੋ ਮਨ ਠਉਰ ਬਸੋ ਰਸ ਬਾਸਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੁ ਦਹੰ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਯਉ ॥
1400.t: pooran bho man Thaur baso ras baasan siau ju dhaha(n) dhis dhaayau ||
1400.e: My mind has become perfect; it dwells in the Lord's Place; it had been wandering in all directions, in its desire for tastes and pleasures.

1400.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਵਾਲੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਮ ਜਲੵਨ ਤੀਰਿ ਬਿਪਾਸ ਬਨਾਯਉ ॥
1400.t: gobi(n)dh vaal gobi(n)dh puree sam jalayen teer bipaas banaayau ||
1400.e: Goindwal is the City of God, built on the bank of the Beas River.

1400.g: ਗਯਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਬਰਖਨ ਕੋ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਯਉ ॥੬॥੧੦॥
1400.t: gayau dhukh dhoor barakhan ko su guroo mukh dhekh garoo sukh paayau ||6||10||
1400.e: The pains of so many years have been taken away; gazing upon the Face of the Guru, I find peace. ||6||10||

1400.g: ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰੵਉ ॥
1400.t: samarath guroo sir hath dharayeau ||
1400.e: The All-powerful Guru placed His hand upon my head.

1400.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਅਉ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਰੰਨ ਅਘੰਨ ਹਰੵਉ ॥
1400.t: gur keenee kirapaa har naam dheeaau jis dhekh chara(n)n agha(n)n harayeau ||
1400.e: The Guru was kind, and blessed me with the Lord's Name. Gazing upon His Feet, my sins were dispelled.

1400.g: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੁ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਨੇ ਸੁਤੁ ਭਾਨ ਡਰੵਉ ॥
1400.t: nis baasur ek samaan dhiaan su naam sune sut bhaan ddarayeau ||
1400.e: Night and day, the Guru meditates on the One Lord; hearing His Name, the Messenger of Death is scared away.

1400.g: ਭਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਸੁ ਆਸ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਪਰਸੁ ਕਰੵਉ ॥
1400.t: bhan dhaas su aas jagatr guroo kee paaras bheT paras karayeau ||
1400.e: So speaks the Lord's slave: Guru Raam Daas placed His Faith in Guru Amar Daas, the Guru of the World; touching the Philosopher's Stone, He was transformed into the Philosopher's Stone.

1400.g: ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਕੀਯਉ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰੵਉ ॥੭॥੧੧॥
1400.t: raamadhaas guroo har sat keeyau samarath guroo sir hath dharayeau ||7||11||
1400.e: Guru Raam Daas recognized the Lord as True; the All-powerful Guru placed His hand upon His head. ||7||11||

1400.g: ਅਬ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਭਾਟ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ॥
1400.t: ab raakhahu dhaas bhaaT kee laaj ||
1400.e: Now, please preserve the honor of Your humble slave.

1400.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਰਾਖੀ ਲਾਜ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਕੀ ਹਰਨਾਖਸ ਫਾਰੇ ਕਰ ਆਜ ॥
1400.t: jaisee raakhee laaj bhagat prahilaadh kee haranaakhas faare kar aaj ||
1400.e: God saved the honor of the devotee Prahlaad, when Harnaakhash tore him apart with his claws.

1400.g: ਫੁਨਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਛੀਨਤ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਦੀਨ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਜ ॥
1400.t: fun dhropatee laaj rakhee har prabh jee chheenat basatr dheen bahu saaj ||
1400.e: And the Dear Lord God saved the honor of Dropadi; when her clothes were stripped from her, she was blessed with even more.

1400.g: ਸੋਦਾਮਾ ਅਪਦਾ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪੜ੍ਹਤ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਿਹ ਕਾਜ ॥
1400.t: sodhaamaa apadhaa te raakhiaa ganikaa paRhat poore teh kaaj ||
1400.e: Sudaamaa was saved from misfortune; and Ganikaa the prostitute - when she chanted Your Name, her affairs were perfectly resolved.

1400.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਕਲਜੁਗ ਹੋਇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਭਾਟ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
1400.t: sree satigur suprasa(n)n kalajug hoi raakhahu dhaas bhaaT kee laaj ||8||12||
1400.e: O Great True Guru, if it pleases You, please save the honor of Your slave in this Dark Age of kali Yuga. ||8||12||

1400.g: ਝੋਲਨਾ ॥
1400.t: jholanaa ||
1400.e: Jholnaa:

1400.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
1400.t: guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap praaneeahu ||
1400.e: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O mortal beings.

1400.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਅਪੈ ਰਸਨਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਸੈ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
1400.t: sabadh har har japai naam nav nidh apai rasan ahinis rasai sat kar jaaneeahu ||
1400.e: Chant the Shabad, the Word of the Lord, Har, Har; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, brings the nine treasures. With your tongue, taste it, day and night, and know it as true.

1400.g: ਫੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰੰਗ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਹਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਨ ਮਾਰਗ ਤਜਹੁ ਭਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੵਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
1400.t: fun prem ra(n)g paieeaai gurmukheh dhiaaieeaai a(n)n maarag tajahu bhajahu har gayeaaneeahu ||
1400.e: Then, you shall obtain His Love and Affection; become Gurmukh, and meditate on Him. Give up all other ways; vibrate and meditate on Him, O spiritual people.

1400.g: ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਰਿਦਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥
1400.t: bachan gur ridh dharahu pa(n)ch bhoo bas karahu janam kul udharahu dhavaiaar har maaneeahu ||
1400.e: Enshrine the Word of the Guru's Teachings within your heart, and overpower the five passions. Your life, and your generations, shall be saved, and you shall be honored at the Lord's Door.

1400.g: ਜਉ ਤ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਮ ਬੰਛਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥੧॥੧੩॥
1400.t: jau ta sabh sukh it ut tum ba(n)chhavahu guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap praaneeahu ||1||13||
1400.e: If you desire all the peace and comforts of this world and the next, then chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, O mortal beings. ||1||13||

1400.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
1400.t: guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap sat kar ||
1400.e: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, and know Him as true.

1400.g: ਅਗਮ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਰਿ ॥
1400.t: agam gun jaan nidhaan har man dharahu dhayeaan ahinis karahu bachan gur ridhai dhar ||
1400.e: Know that the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Enshrine Him in your mind, and meditate on Him. Enshrine the Word of the Guru's Teachings within your heart.

1400.g: ਫੁਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਲ ਬਿਮਲ ਅਥਾਹ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਤਰਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਸਚ ਰੰਗ ਸਰਿ ॥
1400.t: fun guroo jal bimal athaeh majan karahu sa(n)t gursikh tarahu naam sach ra(n)g sar ||
1400.e: Then, cleanse yourself in the Immaculate and Unfathomable Water of the Guru; O Gursikhs and Saints, cross over the Ocean of Love of the True Name.

1400.g: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਪੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਰਸਿ ਕਰਤ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
1400.t: sadhaa niravair nira(n)kaar nirabhau japai prem gur sabadh ras karat dhiraR bhagat har ||
1400.e: Meditate lovingly forever on the Lord, free of hate and vengeance, Formless and Fearless; lovingly savor the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and implant devotional worship of the Lord deep within.

1400.g: ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੪॥
1400.t: mugadh man bhram tajahu naam gurmukh bhajahu guroo gur guroo gur guroo jap sat kar ||2||14||
1400.e: O foolish mind, give up your doubts; as Gurmukh, vibrate and meditate on the Naam. Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, and know Him as true. ||2||14||
